verses.text: Hahiriwe umuntu adakurikiza impanuro z’abanyakibi, ntahagarare mu nzira y’abanyavyaha, canke ngo yicarane n’abacokoranyi,
ahubwo agahimbarwa n’Ivyagezwe vy’ Uhoraho , akaba ari vyo ashirako umutima ku murango no mw’ijoro.
Ameze nk’igiti catewe i ruhande y’imigezi y’amazi, kikama mu gihe caco, kandi amababi yaco ntiyuma. Ico akoze cose kiratera imbere.
Ariko abanyakibi si ko bameze! Bo bameze nk’umuguruka utumurwa n’umuyaga.
Ni co gituma abanyakibi batazohagarara ku musi w’urubanza, canke abanyavyaha mw’ikoraniro ry’abagororotsi.
Kuko Uhoraho arinda inzira y’abagororotsi, ariko inzira y’abanyakibi ijana mu mahonero.

headings.text: Igitabu ca mbere Zaburi 1–41|loc="PSA 1-41" Zaburi ya 1

verses.text: Ni kuki amahanga ateye umuvurungano n’amoko akagira inama z’ubusa?
Abami bo mw’isi bahagurutse n’abatware bagiye hamwe ngo bagwanye Uhoraho n’uwo yarobanuje amavuta, bavuga bati:
“Nimuze ducagagure ivyo batubohesheje, twiyambure iminyororo yabo.”
Umwe ari ku ntebe y’ubwami mw’ijuru aritwengera; Uhoraho abatwengera mw’ijigo.
Abakankamirana uburake bwiwe, akabatera ubwoba mu bushangashirwe bwiwe, ati:
“Niyimikiye umwami wanje i Siyoni, umusozi wanje wera.”
Ndavuga ivyo Uhoraho yashinze. Yambwiye ati: “Uri umwana wanje; uwu musi ndakuvyaye.
Nsaba, nanje nzohindura amahanga umugabane wawe, n’impera z’isi zibe inyegu yawe.
Uzoyamenaguza inkoni y’icuma; uyagire ubunywenywe nk’inkono y’ibumba.”
Nuko rero, yemwe bami nimuce ubwenge; mwemere kuburirwa, yemwe batware bo kw’isi.
Mukorere Uhoraho muhinda agashitsi, munezerererwe ibikorwa vyiwe muhinda agashitsi.
Nimuce bugufi imbere y’uwo mwana kugira ngo ntarake maze mugahonera mu nzira, kuko uburake bwiwe buduga mu kanya isase. Hahiriwe abamuhungirako bose.
Uhoraho , abanyanka ni benshi! Abampagurukiye baragwiriye!
Benshi bamvugako bati: “Imana ntizomukiza.”
Ariko wewe Uhoraho , uri inkinzo inkingira impande zose, uri icubahiro canje, uwutuma mpagarara nemye.
Nambaza Uhoraho , na we akanyishura ari ku musozi wiwe wera.
Ndaryama ngasinzira; nkongera nkikangura, kuko Uhoraho ari we anshigikiye.
Sinzotinya naho ingabo ibihumbi vyinshi zonyugariza impande zose.
Haguruka, ewe Uhoraho ! Ntabara, ewe Mana yanje! Kubita abansi banje bose mu musaya; uhongore amenyo y’abanyakibi.
Ugutabarwa kuva k’ Uhoraho . Umugisha wawe nube ku bantu bawe.

headings.text: Zaburi Dawidi yanditse igihe yahunga umuhungu wiwe Abusalomu.

verses.text: Uze unyishure ninakwambaza, Mana yanje igororotse. Unkure mu magorwa; ngutere ikigongwe, wumve ugusenga kwanje.
Muzogeza ryari ga mwa bantu guhindura icubahiro canje ibiteterwe? Muzogeza ryari gukunda ibitagira ikimazi no kurondera imana z’ibinyoma?
Mumenye ko Uhoraho yirobanuriye umusavyi wiwe w’umwizigirwa; Uhoraho aranyumva iyo ndamutakambiye.
Nimuhinde agashitsi ntimukore icaha; muri ku buriri bwanyu, nimusuzume imitima yanyu mucereje.
Nimutange ibimazi vy’abagororotsi kandi mwizigire Uhoraho .
Ewe Uhoraho , benshi barabaza bati: “Ni nde azotuma tugira amahirwe?” Umuco wo mu nyonga zawe nuturasire.
Wuzuza umutima wanje umunezero uruta uwo bagira mu gihe c’umusesekara w’ingano n’umuvinyu.
Nzoryama mu mahoro nsinzire, kuko wewe wenyene, Uhoraho , ari wewe umpa kuba mu mutekano.

headings.text: Yahawe umukuru w’abacuraranzi b’ibicurarangisho vy’imirya. Ni Zaburi ya Dawidi.

verses.text: Niwumvirize amajambo yanje, ewe Uhoraho , witeho ugucura intimba kwanje.
Wumve ugutaka kwanje untabare, Mwami wanje kandi Mana yanje, kuko ari wewe nsenga.
Mu gitondo wumve ijwi ryanje; mu gitondo nzana imbere yawe ivyo ngusaba nkarindira niteze inyishu yawe.
Nturi Imana ihimbarwa n’ikibi; kandi abanyakibi nta kibanza bafise imbere yawe.
Abibone ntibazohagarara imbere y’inyonga zawe. Wanka abakora ibibi bose;
uherengeteza abavuga ibinyoma bose. Abasesa amaraso n’ingunge Wewe, Uhoraho , ubanka urunuka.
Ariko jewe, ku bw’urukundo rwawe rwinshi, ndashobora kuza mu Ngoro yawe; nkunama nubashe, ntumbereye urusengero rwawe rwera.
Ndongorera mu kugororoka kwawe, ewe Uhoraho , kuko mfise abansi. Utumbereze inzira yawe imbere yanje.
Nta kuri kuva mu kanwa kabo; umutima wabo wuzuyemwo ubugunge, umuhogo wabo ni nk’imva irangaye; indimi zabo bazivugisha ibinyoma.
Bamenyeshe ko batsinzwe, ewe Mana! Ubugunge bwabo nibubabere umutego. Ubirukane kubera ivyaha vyabo vyinshi, kuko bakugararije.
Ariko abaguhungiyeko bose banezerwe; baririmbishwe n’umunezero ibihe bidashira. Bapfuke ubakingire, kugira ngo abakunda izina ryawe bakunezerererwe.
Ni ukuri, ewe Uhoraho , ni wewe uhezagira abagororotsi; ubakikiza ukugira neza kwawe nk’inkinzo.

headings.text: Yahawe umukuru w’abacuraranzi bakoresha imyironge. Ni Zaburi ya Dawidi.

verses.text: Uhoraho ntunkankamirane uburake canke ngo umpanane ubushangashirwe.
Ngirira imbabazi, Uhoraho , kuko ncitse intege; unkize, Uhoraho , kuko amagufa yanje ajugumiye.
Umutima wanje unshongeyemwo. Uzogeza ryari, ewe Uhoraho , uzogeza ryari?
Hindukira, Uhoraho , maze untabare; unkize ku bw’urukundo rwawe rudashira.
Mu bapfuye nta n’umwe yamamaza izina ryawe. Ni nde azogutazirira i kuzimu?
Nciwe intege n’ukuniha kwanje. Mara ijoro ryose nuzuza uburiri bwanje amarira, aho ndyama nkahatotesha amosozi.
Amaso yanje ararushe ku bw’umubabaro; ntakibona neza kubera abansi banje.
Nimuje kure yanje, mwa nkozi z’ibibi mwe, kuko Uhoraho yumvise ukurira kwanje.
Uhoraho yumvise ugutakamba kwanje; Uhoraho yakiriye ugusenga kwanje.
Abansi banje bose bazorengerwa n’ubumaramare n’uguhinda agashitsi; bazosubira inyuma maze bamaramare giturumbuka.

headings.text: Yahawe umukuru w’abaririmvyi bacurarangisha ibicurarangisho vy’imirya. Iririmbwa mu mudiho witwa Sheminite . Ni Zaburi ya Dawidi.

verses.text: Uhoraho Mana yanje, muri wewe ni ho mpungiye; untabare kandi unkize abampiga bose,
kugira ngo ntibantabagure nk’intambwe ngo bampimbaguremwo ibihimba ata wo kuntabara.
Uhoraho Mana yanje, ninaba narakoze ivyo bavuga, hakaba hari icagira amaboko yanje;
ninaba nishuye ikibi umugenzi yankoreye iciza, canke naranyaze umwansi wanje ata nyanduruko,
umwansi wanje nampige maze anshikire; umureke ahonyangire ubugingo bwanje hasi, maze aryamike icubahiro canje mu mukungungu.
Haguruka mu burake bwawe, ewe Uhoraho , ugwanye ubushangashirwe bw’abansi banje. Ikangure Mana yanje, uce urubanza.
Amahanga yose nagukikuze, maze uyaganze uvyagiye mw’ijuru.
Uhoraho , cira urubanza amahanga. Mburanira ewe Uhoraho , nk’uko ukugororoka kwanje kuri, nk’uko ubwizigirwa bwanje buri, ewe Iyisumbavyose.
Herengeteza ububi bw’umunyakibi, utabare umugororotsi; wewe Mana igororotse, wewe usuzuma ivyiyumviro n’imitima.
Imana Musumbavyose ni yo nkinzo yanje, ni yo ikiza imitima igororotse.
Imana ni umucamanza agororotse, Imana yama yerekana uburake bwayo.
Umuntu natihana, Imana izokarisha inkota yayo; izofora umuheto wayo.
Yateguye ibigwanisho vyayo vyica yegeranije imyampi yayo yaka umuriro.
Uwutwaye inda y’ikibi yibungenga ivyago, akavyara ikinyoma.
Uwimba ikinogo akakigira kirekire, ni we nyene akigwamwo.
Ivyago atera bimugarukako, kandi ububisha ategura bugwa ku mutwe wiwe.
Nzoha ishimwe Uhoraho ku bw’ukugororoka kwiwe, nzotazira izina ry’ Uhoraho Musumbavyose.

headings.text: Ni Shigayoni ya Dawidi, iyo yaririmbiye Uhoraho yerekeye Kushi, Umubenyamini.

verses.text: Uhoraho Mana yacu, ese ingene izina ryawe ari iry’icubahiro mw’isi yose! Washize icubahiro cawe hejuru y’amajuru.
Mu kanwa k’abana bato n’inzoya ni ho washinze igihome gikinga abansi bawe, ngo uzibe akanwa k’abansi bakugwanya.
Iyo niyumviriye ku majuru yawe, igikorwa c’intoke zawe, ukwezi n’inyenyeri, ivyo wewe washizeho,
mbega umuntu ni iki kugira ngo umwibuke, canke umwana w’umuntu ni iki kugira ngo umwiteho?
Habuze gato ngo umunganye n’abamarayika; kandi wamwambitse ubwiza n’icubahiro.
Wamugize uwo kuganza ibikorwa vy’amaboko yawe; washize vyose musi y’ububasha bwiwe:
imikuku yose n’amasho, n’ibikoko vyo mw’ishamba,
inyoni zo mu kirere, n’amafi yo mu kiyaga, ibigendera mu mazi yo mu biyaga vyose.
Uhoraho , Mana yacu, ese ingene izina ryawe rihambaye mw’isi yose!

headings.text: Yahawe umukuru w’abaririmvyi. Iririmbwa mu mudiho witwa gitite. Ni Zaburi ya Dawidi.

verses.text: Nzogushima, Uhoraho , n’umutima wanje wose; nzokwamamaza ibihambaye wakoze.
Nzonezerwa mpimbarirwe muri wewe; nzoririmba amatazirano y’izina ryawe, ewe Iyisumbavyose.
Abansi banje basubiye inyuma; baranyereye baratemvye imbere yawe.
Kuko wampagarariye, ukamburanira, uvyagiye ku ntebe yawe nk’umucamanza agororotse.
Wakankamiye amahanga, uhonya abanyakibi; wasibanganije izina ryabo ibihe bidashira.
Abansi banje bararandutse ibihe bidashira, waranduranye n’imizi ibisagara vyabo; nta n’ico kubibukirako kigisigaye.
Uhoraho aganje ibihe bidashira; yashinze intebe yiwe y’ubwami ngo ace imanza.
Aganza isi mu bugororotsi kandi acira imanza amoko mu kuri.
Uhoraho abera ubuhungiro impahazwa, ni igihome co guhungiramwo mu gihe c’ivyago.
Abazi izina ryawe bazokwizigira, kuko wewe, Uhoraho , ntiwigeze uheba abakurondera.
Muririmbe amashimwe y’ Uhoraho , avyagiye i Siyoni; mumenyekanishe mu mahanga ivyo yakoze.
Kuko uwuhora amaraso yasheshwe aribuka; ntiyirengagiza ugutakamba kw’abari mu marushwa.
Uhoraho , raba ingene abansi banje bampama! Ngirira ikigongwe maze unkure mu vyara vy’urupfu,
kugira ngo nze mvuge amashimwe yawe mu marembo y’Umukobwa Siyoni, kugira ngo nezerererwe agakiza kawe.
Amahanga yakorokeye mu cobo yimvye; ibirenge vyabo vyaguye mu mutego bateze ubwabo.
Uhoraho yimenyekanishije mu bikorwa vyo kugororoka yakoze; abanyakibi bafashwe n’umutego w’ibikorwa vy’intoke zabo.
Abanyakibi bamanuka baja ahantu h’abapfuye, co kimwe n’amahanga yose yibagira Imana.
Ariko Imana ntizokwibagira na rimwe abakene; ivyizigiro vy’impahazwa ntibizokwigera bikurwaho.
Haguruka, ewe Uhoraho , ntureke ngo abantu buntu baneshe; amahanga nacirirwe urubanza imbere yawe.
Batere ubwoba, ewe Uhoraho ; abanyamahanga nibamenye ko ari abantu buntu.

headings.text: Yahawe umukuru w’abaririmvyi. Iririmbwa mw’ijwi ryitwa “Urupfu rw’umwana w’umuhungu.” Ni Zaburi ya Dawidi.

verses.text: Ni kuki wihagarariye kure, ewe Uhoraho ? Ni kuki winyegeza mu gihe c’ivyago?
Umunyakibi mu bwibone bwiwe ahiga abanyantegenke, abafashwe mu mitego yateze.
Yirata ivyo yipfuza mu mutima wiwe; ashima uwipfuza inyungu mbi agakengera Uhoraho .
Umunyakibi mu bwishime bwiwe ntarondera Imana; mu vyiyumviro vyiwe nta kibanza afitiye Uhoraho .
Ivyo akora vyose vyama bitera imbere; atera akagere ivyagezwe vyawe; abansi biwe abahuhisha impwemu ziwe.
Yibwira mu mutima wiwe ati: “Nta kintu na kimwe kizonyiganyiza.” Arahira avuga ati: “Nta kibi kizonshikira.”
Akanwa kiwe kuzuye imivumo, ibinyoma n’imihigo; ivyago n’ibibi biri musi y’ururimi rwiwe.
Abunda i ruhande y’imihana; akavunduruka aho abunze yica umugororotsi. Amaso yiwe arabira mu mpisho abo agomba kwica;
abunda afise ico ateze nk’intambwe. Abundira gufata abatagira gitabara; afata abatagira gitabara maze akabakwegera mu mutego wiwe.
Abatagira gitabara baratemba, akabafyonyora; bakagwa musi y’ububasha bwiwe.
Yibwira mu mutima wiwe ati: “Imana ntizobibona; yipfutse mu nyonga zayo nta co yigera ibona.”
Haguruka, Uhoraho ! Ramvura ukuboko kwawe, ewe Mana. Ntiwibagire abatagira gitabara.
Ni kuki umunyakibi akengera Imana? Ni kuki yibwira mu mutima ngo: “Nta co izombaza?”
Ariko wewe, Mana, raba ivyago vy’abari mu mubabaro; witegereze uburibwe bwabo maze ivyabo uvyishinge. Abagirirwa nabi barakwituye; ni wewe utabara impfuvyi.
Vuna ukuboko kw’umunyakibi; hamagaza uwakoze nabi umuhanire ibibi yakoze kugira ngo ntibisubire kuboneka.
Uhoraho ni Umwami ibihe bitazoshira; amahanga atamwubaha azohona mu gihugu ciwe.
Wewe, Uhoraho , wumva ivyo impahazwa zifuza; urabaremesha, ukumva ugutakamba kwabo,
ugutabara impfuvyi n’impahazwa, kugira ngo abantu buntu ntibasubire kubatera ubwoba.
Uhoraho ni we mpungirako. None ni kuki mwombwira muti: “Guruka uhungire ku musozi nk’inyoni kugira ngo ukire!
Kuko raba abanyakibi bafoye imiheto yabo; batumbereje imyampi yabo ngo barasire mu mwijima uwutunganye mu mutima.
Nimba amatanguriro asambuwe, mbega umugororotsi yokora iki?”
Uhoraho ari mu Ngoro yiwe yera; Uhoraho avyagiye ku ntebe yiwe y’ubwami yo mw’ijuru. Araba abantu bose bari mw’isi; inyonga ziwe zirabagenzura.
Uhoraho agenzura abagororotsi, ariko abanyakibi, bamwe bakunda umuryano, abanka urunuka.
Abanyakibi azobacukumburirako amakara arurumba n’amazuku yaka umuriro; umuyaga uturira ni wo uzoba umugabane wabo.
Kuko Uhoraho agororotse, akunda ubutungane; abatunganye bazobona mu nyonga hiwe.

headings.text: Yahawe umukuru w’abaririmvyi. Ni Zaburi ya Dawidi.

verses.text: Tabara, ewe Uhoraho , kuko ata mwizigirwa agisigaye; abizigirwa baheze mu bantu.
Umuntu wese ahenda mugenziwe; bahendanisha iminwa yabo ariko imitima yabo yuzuye ubugunge.
Icompa Uhoraho akazibiza iminwa ihendana n’ururimi rwose rwishira hejuru.
Bavuga bati: “Tuzotsinda ku bw’indimi zacu; iminwa yacu ubwacu ni yo izotuburanira; ni nde atuganza?”
Ariko Uhoraho avuze ati: “Kubera abakene banyazwe ivyabo n’abagorwa baniha, ngira mve hasi ndabakize ababasuzugura.”
Kandi amajambo y’ Uhoraho ni ay’ukuri, nk’ifeza zavugutiwe mu ruganda, nk’inzahabu zavugutiwe incuro indwi.
Ewe, Uhoraho , uzozigama umugorwa amahoro, kandi uzoturinda umunyakibi ibihe vyose.
Abantu nk’abo bigenza ahantu hose iyo ikibi cahawe intebe mu bantu.

headings.text: Yahawe umukuru w’abaririmvyi. Ni Sheminite. Ni Zaburi ya Dawidi.

verses.text: Uzogeza ryari, ewe Uhoraho ? Mbega uzonyibagira ibihe bidashira? Uzogeza ryari kumpisha mu nyonga hawe?
Nzogeza ryari kwama ngwana n’ivyiyumviro vyanje no kwama mfise umubabaro wo mu mutima ku musi ku musi? Umwansi wanje azogeza ryari kunyitamba ku muvyimba?
Ndaba maze unyishure, ewe Uhoraho Mana yanje. Umurikire amaso yanje, kugira ngo sinsinzirire mu rupfu,
maze umwansi wanje akavuga ati: “Ndamunesheje,” abangwanya bakanezerezwa n’uko ntevye.
Ariko nizigiye urukundo rwawe rudashira; umutima wanje unezerererwa agakiza kawe.
Nzoririmba ishimwe ry’ Uhoraho , kuko yangiriye neza.

headings.text: Yahawe umukuru w’abaririmvyi. Ni Zaburi ya Dawidi.

verses.text: Igipfu cibwira mu mutima kiti: “Nta Mana iriho.” Abantu nk’abo barononekaye, ibikorwa vyabo biteye isoni, nta n’umwe muri bo akora ivyiza.
Uhoraho arunguruka ari mw’ijuru akitegereza abana b’abantu ngo arabe ko hari n’umwe atahura, canke ko hari n’umwe arondera Imana.
Bose barazimiye, bose barononekaye; nta wukora ivyiza, eka nta n’umwe.
Mbega abo bantu b’inkozi z’ikibi bose nta co bazi? Barya abantu banje nk’abarya umutsima; ntibigera bambaza Uhoraho .
Ariko aho nyene ni ho ubwoba bubafatiye, kuko Imana iri mw’ikoraniro ry’abagororotsi.
Mwebwe abakora ibibi mwica imigambi y’abakene, ariko Uhoraho ni ubuhungiro bwabo.
Ese icompa agakiza ka Isirayeli kakaza kavuye i Siyoni! Aho Uhoraho azosubirira guhezagira abantu biwe; aba Yakobo baze banezerwe, Abisirayeli bahimbarwe!

headings.text: Yahawe umukuru w’abaririmvyi: ni Zaburi ya Dawidi.

verses.text: Uhoraho , ni nde azoba mw’ihema ryawe ryera? Ni nde ashobora kuba ku musozi wawe wera?
Ni uwutagira umugayo mu buzima bwiwe, akora ibigororotse, akavuga ukuri kuvuye mu mutima;
ururimi rwiwe ntiruvuge nabi abandi, ntagirire nabi mugenziwe, ntavuge ibibi ku bandi.
Akengera abakora ibibi ariko akubaha abubaha Uhoraho . Yubahiriza ico yarahiye naho comugirira nabi, ntiyihindukize mw’ijambo;
agurana abakene atiteze inyungu; ntiyemera igiturire ngo arenganye uwuri mu kuri. Uwukora ivyo ntazokwigera anyiganyizwa.

headings.text: Ni Zaburi ya Dawidi.

verses.text: Unzigame, Mana yanje, kuko nguhungiyeko.
Ndabwira Uhoraho nti: “Uri Umwami wanje; nta ciza mfise atari wewe.”
Ndavuga ku bera bari mu gihugu nti: “Ni bo ntore nezerererwa.”
Abahurumbira izindi mana bazokwama bababazwa. Sinzoshikanira ishikanwa ry’amaraso imana nk’izo canke ngo ncishe no mu kanwa kanje amazina yazo.
Uhoraho , ni wewe wenyene mugabane wanje n’igikombe canje; ubuzima bwanje buzigamiwe mu kuboko kwawe.
Urubibe rwanje ruca mu bibanza biteye igomwe; ni ukuri naronse umugabane mwiza.
Nzohimbaza Uhoraho , we mujenama wanje; no mw’ijoro umutima wanje uranyigisha.
Amaso yanje ndayahanga Uhoraho imisi yose. Ko ari i buryo bwanje, sinzonyiganyizwa.
Ni co gituma umutima wanje unezerewe, ururimi rwanje rugahimbarwa; n’umubiri wanje ukaruhukana ivyizigiro,
kuko utazondekera i kuzimu mu kibanza c’abapfuye, kandi ntuzokwemera ko uwera wawe abora.
Umenyesha inzira y’ubugingo; uzonyuzuza umunezero ndi imbere yawe, n’agahimbare kadashira ndi i buryo bwawe.

headings.text: Mikitamu ya Dawidi.

verses.text: Nyumviriza, ewe Uhoraho , kuko ukwinginga kwanje ari ukw’ukuri; niwumve ukurira kwanje. Niwumve ugusenga kwanje; ntikuva mu minwa y’ibinyoma.
Intsinzi yanje nive iwawe; inyonga zawe nizirabe ibibereye.
Naho worondera mu mutima wanje, naho wonsesa mw’ijoro ukangeza, uzosanga ata kibi nateguye gukora; n’akanwa kanje katagabitanije.
Ku bijanye n’ibikorwa vy’abantu, ku bw’ijambo ryo mu kanwa kawe, naririnze inzira z’abahohotera abandi.
Intambuko zanje zagumye mu nzira zawe; ibirenge vyanje ntivyatirimutse.
Ndakwambaje, Mana yanje, kuko uzonyishura; ntega ugutwi wumve ugusenga kwanje.
Unyereke ibitangaza vy’urukundo rwawe rwinshi, wewe ukirisha ukuboko kwawe kw’i buryo abahungira abansi babo muri wewe.
Undinde nk’imbone y’ijisho ryawe; umpishe mu gitutu c’amababa yawe.
Undinde abanyakibi barondera kunyica, abansi banje b’abicanyi bankikuje.
Bugaye imitima yabo itagira ikigongwe, n’iminwa yabo ivugana ubwibone.
Barampize, none ehe raba barankikuje, barangenza ngo bantsinde hasi.
Bameze nk’intambwe ishonje irondera ico yica, nk’intambwe ikiri nto iteze ahantu hihishije.
Va hasi, Uhoraho , ubagwanye, ubatsinde hasi; unkirishe inkota yawe ababisha.

Nkirisha ukuboko kwawe abameze batyo, ewe Uhoraho , nkiza abantu bo mw’isi baziga impera muri ubu bugingo. Ivyo wabikiye abanyakibi nivyuzure inda zabo; n’abana babo babiryeko bahage, kandi hasigare vyinshi bazoraga abuzukuru babo.
Ariko jeho, uzontsindira kandi nzobona mu nyonga hawe; ninikangura, nzohazwa no kukubona imbonankubone.

headings.text: Ni isengesho rya Dawidi.

verses.text: Ndagukunda, Uhoraho , uri inkomezi zanje.
Uhoraho ni we gitandara canje, igihome canje kinkingira n’umutabazi wanje; Imana yanje ni igitandara canje nihishamwo, inkinzo yanje, n’ihembe ry’agakiza kanje, n’umunara mpungiramwo.
Nambaje Uhoraho , we abereye gushimwa, na we ankiza abansi banje.
Iminyororo y’urupfu yaranyiboheyeko; imikuba y’ukurandura yarandengeye.
Iminyororo y’i kuzimu yaranyizingiriyeko; imitego y’urupfu yarantangiriye.
Mu mubabaro wanje nambaje Uhoraho ; natakambiye Imana yanje ngo intabare. Iri mu Ngoro yayo yumvise ijwi ryanje; ugutakamba kwanje kwashitse imbere yayo, mu matwi yayo.
Isi yaratigise ihinda agashitsi, amatanguriro y’imisozi aranyiganyiga; yahinze agashitsi kuko Uhoraho yari yaratse.
Umwotsi wapfunduka mu mazuru yiwe; umuriro utongora wava mu kanwa kiwe, hamwe n’amakara yaka.
Yamenye ijuru aramanuka; ibicu vyirabura vyari musi y’ibirenge vyiwe.
Yaje aguruka ku mukerubi; yagendera ku mababa y’umuyaga.
Yisakaye umwijima awugira nk’ihema rimukikuje; ibicu vyirabura vyo kw’ijuru vyuzuye imvura.
Mu gukayangana kwo mu nyonga hiwe, havamwo ibicu vy’imvura y’urubura n’ibikeke vy’imiravyo.
Uhoraho yaraturagaye ari mw’ijuru; ijwi ry’Iyisumbavyose ryarasamiranye.
Yarashe imyampi yiwe asanzaza abansi, yasohoye ibikeke vy’imiravyo birabakinagiza.
Ibiyaya vyo mu kiyaga vyagiye ahabona n’amatanguriro y’isi aragaragara ku bw’ugukankama kwawe, ewe Uhoraho , no ku bw’impwemu ziva mu mazuru yawe.
Yagoroye ukuboko kwiwe ari iyo hejuru aramfata; ankura mu mazi menshi.
Yantabaye umwansi wanje akomeye, ankiza abanyanka bandusha inkomezi.
Banteye ku musi w’ivyago vyanje, ariko Uhoraho ni we yanshigikiye.
Yaransohoye anjana ahagutse; arankiza kuko yanezererewe.
Uhoraho yankoreye ibihwanye n’ukugororoka kwanje; yampaye ingero ikwiranye n’ugutungana kw’amaboko yanje.
Kuko nagumye mu nzira z’ Uhoraho ; sinigeze ncumura ngo mve ku Mana yanje.
Ivyagezwe vyiwe vyose biri imbere yanje; sinigeze mpindukira ngo mve mu vyo yihanikirije.
Namye ntagira umugayo imbere yiwe kandi nirinze icaha.
Uhoraho yanyishuye ibikwiranye n’ukugororoka kwanje, ibihwanye n’ugutungana kwanje mu nyonga hiwe.
Ku mwizigirwa wiyerekana uri umwizigirwa, ku wutagira umugayo wiyerekana uri uwutagira umugayo,
ku wutunganye wiyerekana uri uwutunganye, ariko ku muntu w’intabarirwa wiyerekana nk’uwutagira akagongwe.
Ukiza abaciye bugufi ariko ucisha bugufi abafise amaso y’ubwibone.
Ni wewe, Uhoraho , ugumiza itara ryanje ryaka; Imana yanje ihindura umwijima wanje ukaba umuco.
Ku bwawe, nshobora gutera ingabo nyinshi; turi kumwe n’Imana yanje, nshobora kwurira uruzitiro.
Imana yo, inzira yayo iratunganye: ijambo ry’ Uhoraho ni iry’ukuri; abera inkinzo abamuhungirako bose.
None ni nde Mana atari Uhoraho ? Kandi ni nde Gitandara atari Imana yacu?
Imana ni yo inyambika inkomezi ikagorora inzira yanje.
Ihindura ibirenge vyanje nk’ivy’impongo; ikanshoboza guhagarara ku dutwe tw’imisozi.
Yigisha iminwe yanje kugwana; agashoboza amaboko yanje gufora umuheto w’umwakaka.
Agakiza kawe kabaye inkinzo yanje, kandi ukuboko kwawe kw’i buryo ni kwo kunshigikiye; ubushobozi bwawe ni bwo bwangize uwuhambaye.
Wanteguriye inzira ncamwo yagutse, kugira ngo ibirenge vyanje ntibinyerere.
Nakurikiye abansi banje kandi ndabashikira; sinasubiye inyuma badaherengeteye.
Nabagize ubunywenywe nta n’uwushobora kuvyura umutwe; baguye musi y’ibirenge vyanje.
Wanyambitse inkomezi zo kugwana; wacishije bugufi abansi banje imbere yanje.
Watumye abansi banje bata barahunga, kandi wampaye kubaherengeteza.
Baratakamvye, habura uwubakiza; batakambiye Uhoraho , ariko ntiyabishura.
Maze ndabasya nk’umukungugu utumurwa n’umuyaga; ndabasiribanga nk’ivyondo mu nzira y’abahita.
Wankijije ibitero vy’abantu; umpindura uwutwara amahanga. Abantu ntigeze kumenya ubu ni bo bankorera,
uko bumvise ijwi ryanje, baranyumvira; abanyamahanga baranyunamira.
Bose bacika intege; bava aho bari binyegeje bahinda agashitsi.
Uhoraho ni muzima! Hahimbazwe igitandara canje! Hashirwe hejuru Imana y’agakiza kanje!
Ni we Mana imporera, igashira amahanga musi yanje,
inkiza abansi banje. Wanshize hejuru y’abangwanya; untabara abantu b’inkozi z’ikibi.
Ni co gituma nzoguhimbaza mu mahanga, ewe Uhoraho ; nzotazira izina ryawe.
Ni we aha umwami wiwe intsinzi zihambaye; yerekanye urukundo rudashira ku wo yarobanuje amavuta, ari we Dawidi n’uruvyaro rwiwe.

headings.text: Yahawe umukuru w’abaririmvyi. Ni Zaburi ya Dawidi umusavyi w’ Uhoraho , iyo yaririmbiye Uhoraho muri aya majambo amaze kumukiza abansi biwe bose, no kumukura mu maboko ya Sawuli. Yavuze ati:

verses.text: Amajuru yamamaza ubwiza bw’Imana; ibirere bimenyesha igikorwa c’intoke ziwe.
Umurango ubibwira uwundi murango; ijoro rikabimenyesha irindi joro.
Ntibisohora ijwi canke amajambo; nta jwi ryavyo ryumvikana.
Ariko inkuru yavyo yumvikanye mw’isi yose; kandi ivyo vyavuze vyashitse ku mpera z’isi. Imana yashingiye ihema izuba iyo mw’ijuru.
Rimeze nk’umukwe asohotse ava mu cumba ciwe, rimeze nka rurangiranwa mu kwiruka anezerererwa uguhiganwa kwiwe.
Riserukira ku mpera imwe y’ijuru rikagenda urugendo rwaryo rija ku yindi mpera; nta kintu na kimwe kidashikirwa n’ubushuhe bwaryo.
Ivyagezwe vy’ Uhoraho biratunganye, bisubiza intege mu mutima. Ivyo Uhoraho yageze ni ivyo kwizigirwa, biha umunyabwengebuke ubwenge.
Ivyo Uhoraho yihanikirije ni ivyo kuri, binezereza umutima. Ivyo Uhoraho yashinze birakayangana, bimurikira amaso.
Kwubaha Uhoraho biratunganye, guhoraho ibihe vyose. Ivyo Uhoraho yategetse birashikamye, kandi vyose biragororotse.
Bifise agaciro kurusha inzahabu, kurusha inzahabu iramuye; bisosa kurusha ubuki, kurusha ubuki buvuye mu kimamara.
Muri vyo ni ho umusavyi wawe aburirwa; kuvyitondera bifise impera nyinshi.
Ariko ni nde yoshobora kwimenyako amakosa? Umparire ivyaha vyanyinyegeje.
Urinde kandi umusavyi wawe ivyaha vy’akagagazo; ntibinganze. Ni ho nzoba uwutagira umugayo, ntagirizwa ukugabitanya guhambaye.
Aya majambo yo mu kanwa kanje n’uku kurimbura kw’umutima wanje bibe ibihimbara mu nyonga zawe, Uhoraho , Gitandara canje, Mucunguzi wanje.

headings.text: Yahawe umukuru w’abaririmvyi. Ni Zaburi ya Dawidi.

verses.text: Uhoraho akwishure ku musi w’amagorwa; izina ry’Imana ya Yakobo rikurinde.
Akurungikire ugutabarwa kuva ahera hiwe, agushigikire ari i Siyoni.
Niyibuke ibimazi vyawe, yemere amashikanwa yawe yose.
Aguhe ico umutima wawe ushaka imigambi yawe yose ije mu ngiro.
Tuze turirimbishwe n’umunezero niwanesha tuduze amabendera yacu mw’izina ry’Imana yacu. Uhoraho akwishure ivyo wamusavye vyose.
Ubu ni ho nkimenya: Uhoraho aha intsinzi uwo yarobanuje amavuta. Amwishura ari ahera hiwe mw’ijuru akamwishurisha inkomezi zo kunesha zo mu kuboko kwiwe kw’i buryo.
Bamwe bishimira imikogote abandi bakishimira amafarasi yabo, ariko tweho twizigira izina ry’ Uhoraho Imana yacu.
Bacishijwe bugufi baratemba, ariko twebwe tuvuye hasi turashikama.
Uhoraho , uhe umwami intsinzi! Kandi utwishure nitwakwambaza!

headings.text: Yahawe umukuru w’abaririmvyi. Ni Zaburi ya Dawidi.

verses.text: Umwami anezerererwa inkomezi zawe, ewe Uhoraho . Ese ingene umunezero wiwe ari mwinshi ku bw’intsinzi nyinshi umuha!
Wamuhaye ico umutima wiwe wipfuza kandi ntiwamwimye ico iminwa yiwe yasavye.
Waje kumuramutsa umuzaniye imigisha myinshi kandi wamwambitse ku mutwe urugori rw’inzahabu iramuye.
Yagusavye ubuzima, na we urabumuha; ni kwo kuramba kw’ibihe bidashira.
Ku bw’intsinzi nyishi wamuhaye, icubahiro ciwe cabaye cinshi; wamushizeko ubwiza n’igitinyiro.
Ni ukuri wamuhaye imigisha idashira kandi wamuhaye guhimbarirwa no kuba mu nyonga zawe.
Kuko umwami yizigira Uhoraho ; ari mu rukundo rudashira rw’Iyisumbavyose, ntazonyiganyizwa.
Ukuboko kwawe kuzofata mpiri abansi bawe bose; ukuboko kwawe kw’i buryo kuzocakira abansi bawe.
Niwaseruka mu rugamba, uzobatongora bose nk’uwubaturira mw’itanure. Uhoraho azobamira miyonzwa mu burake bwiwe, kandi umuriro wiwe uzobatongora.
Uzoherengeteza uruvyaro rwabo kw’isi, ababakomokako bazokurwa mu bana b’abantu.
Naho bakugirira inama mbi bakagira imigambi mibi kuri wewe, nta co bazoshikako.
Uzotuma basubiza umugongo inyuma niwabatumberezako umuheto wawe ufoye.
Ushirwe hejuru mu nkomezi zawe, ewe Uhoraho ; tuzoririmba dushima inkomezi zawe.

headings.text: Yahawe umukuru w’abaririmvyi. Ni Zaburi ya Dawidi.

verses.text: Mana yanje, Mana yanje, ni kuki wampevye? Ni kuki wangiye kure ngo ntuntabare, ko wangiye kure ngo ntiwumve amajojwa yanje?
Mana yanje, ndagutakambira ku murango, ariko ntunyishure, no mw’ijoro sintora agatiro.
Ariko uri Uwera, uvyagiye ku ntebe y’ubwami; uri mu mashimwe ya Isirayeli.
Ba sogokuruza barakwizigiye; barakwizigiye urabatabara.
Baragutakambiye barakira; barakwizigiye ntibamaramara.
Ariko jeho ndi umusiba, sindi umuntu, ncokorwa na bose, nankwa n’abantu.
Abambona bose baritwengera; barantuka bakazunguza imitwe.
“Baravuga bati: ‘Yizigiye Uhoraho , Uhoraho namukize. Namutabare, ko amunezerererwa.’ ”
Ariko ni wewe wankuye mu nda ya mama, wampaye kukwizigira no mu gihe nari kw’ibere rya mama.
Nashizwe mu maboko yawe kuva nkivuka; kuva nkiri mu nda ya mama wamye uri Imana yanje.
Ntumbe kure, kuko amarushwa anyegereye kandi ata wo kuntabara.
Impfizi nyinshi zirankikije; impfizi z’inkomezi z’i Bashani zintaye hagati.
Intambwe zitontoma zitabura ico zishe ziranyasamiye ngo zimire.
Nsutswe hasi nk’amazi, amagufa yanje aratanye. Umutima wanje urashonze nk’ishashara; ushongeye muri jewe.
Akanwa kanje karumye nk’inkono y’ibumba iturirwe, n’ururimi rwanje rufatanye n’amagage; undyamitse mu mukungugu w’urupfu.
Imbwa zirankikije, akarwi k’inkozi z’ibibi kantaye hagati. Batoboye ibiganza vyanje n’ibirenge vyanje.
Amagufa yanje yose yanamye hejuru, abansi banje na bo bihera ijisho.
Bagabuye impuzu zanje bapfindira umutamana wanje.
Ariko weho, Uhoraho , ntube kure yanje. Uri inkomezi zanje; nyaruka untabare.
Nunkize inkota, ubuzima bwanje bw’igiciro ubukize imbwa.
Nunkize unkure mu kanwa k’intambwe; nunkize unkure mu mahembe y’imbogo.
Nzokwamamaza izina ryawe mu bavukanyi banje; nzoguhimbaza ikoraniro rikoranye.
Yemwe abubaha Uhoraho , nimumushime! Yemwe aba Yakobo mwese, nimumuhe icubahiro! Nimumwubahe mwese, yemwe bene Isirayeli!
Kuko atakengereye canke ngo acokore umugorwa ari mu mubabaro; ntiyamuhishije mu nyonga hiwe ariko yumvise ugutakamba kwiwe.
Ishimwe ryanje ndi mw’ikoraniro riva kuri wewe; nzoshitsa ivyo narahiye ndi imbere y’abakwubaha.
Umukene azorya ahage; abarondera Uhoraho bazomushima; imitima yanyu irakaramba ibihe vyose!
Abo ku mpera z’isi bose bazokwibuka bahindukirire Uhoraho , n’imiryango yose yo mu mahanga izokwunama imbere yiwe,
kuko kuganza ari ukw’ Uhoraho kandi ni we ategeka amahanga.
Abatunzi bose bo mw’isi bazogira umusi mukuru basenge; abamanuka baja i kuzimu bazopfukama imbere yiwe; abadashobora kwibeshaho ubwabo.
Abazobakomokako bazomukorera; abo mu runganwe ruzoza bazobwirwa ivy’Imana.
Bazokwamamaza ukugororoka kwiwe, babwira abataravuka bati: “Yarabikoze!”

headings.text: Yahawe umukuru w’abaririmvyi. Iri mw’ijwi ryitwa “Ikime co mu Gatondo.” Ni Zaburi ya Dawidi.

verses.text: Uhoraho ni we Mwungere wanje, nta co nkenye.
Ampa kuruhukira mu canya c’ubwatsi butotahaye, andongorera i ruhande y’amazi adasuma,
asubiza intege mu mutima wanje. Andongorera mu nzira z’ukuri, kugira ngo aheshe icubahiro izina ryiwe.
Mbere naho noca mu mwonga w’umwijima w’urupfu, sinzogira ikibi ntinya, kuko uri kumwe nanje; inkoni yawe n’ubuhiri bwawe ni vyo binkingira bikampumuriza.
Untegurira umusi mukuru mu maso y’abansi banje. Unsuka amavuta ku mutwe; igikombe canje kirasesekaye.
Ni ukuri ukugira neza kwawe n’urukundo rwawe bizonkurikirana imisi yose y’ukubaho kwanje, nanje nzoba mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho ibihe vyose.

headings.text: Ni Zaburi ya Dawidi.

verses.text: Isi ni iy’ Uhoraho , n’ibiri muri yo vyose, isi n’ababa muri yo bose;
kuko yashize amatanguriro yayo ku biyaga akayishinga ku mazi menshi.
Ni nde azoduga umusozi w’ Uhoraho ? Ni nde azohagarara ahera hiwe?
Ni uwufise amaboko atanduye n’umutima utunganye, atizigira ikigirwamana canke ngo arahire imana z’ibinyoma.
Uwo ni we azohabwa umugisha uva k’ Uhoraho no kuburanirwa n’Imana Umukiza wiwe.
Urwo ni rwo runganwe rw’abamurondera, bakarondera mu nyonga hawe, ewe Mana ya Yakobo.
Nimwiyugurure, yemwe marembo; nimwiyugurure, mwa nzugi z’ibihe vya kera, kugira ngo Umwami w’ubwiza yinjire.
Uwo mwami w’ubwiza ni nde? Ni Uhoraho umunyenkomezi kandi umunyabushobozi, ni Uhoraho umuhizi mu ntambara.
Nimwiyugurure, yemwe marembo; nimwiyugurure, yemwe nzugi z’ibihe vya kera, kugira ngo Umwami w’ubwiza yinjire.
Uwo Mwami w’ubwiza ni nde? Ni Uhoraho Mushoboravyose; ni we Mwami w’ubwiza.

headings.text: Ni Zaburi ya Dawidi.

verses.text: Muri wewe, Uhoraho Mana yanje, ni ho nshira ivyizigiro vyanje.
Ndakwizigiye; ntundeke ngo maramare, ntureke ngo abansi banje baneshe.
Nta wukwizigiye azokwigera amaramara, ariko abahemuka ata nyanduruko ni bo bazomaramara.
Nyereka inzira zawe, ewe Uhoraho , unyigishe kubaho uko ugomba.
Ndongorera mu kuri kwawe unyigishe, kuko uri Imana Umukiza wanje, kandi ni wewe nizigira bukarinda bwira.
Niwibuke, Uhoraho , imbabazi zawe nyinshi n’urukundo rwawe, kuko biriho uhereye kera hose.
Ntiwibuke ivyaha vyo mu buto bwanje n’inzira zanje z’ubugarariji; nyibuka ku bw’urukundo rwawe, kuko wewe, Uhoraho , uri mwiza.
Uhoraho ni mwiza aragororotse; ni co gituma azokwigisha abanyavyaha inzira ziwe.
Arongorera abaciye bugufi mu nzira itunganye akabigisha ivy’inzira yiwe.
Inzira zose z’ Uhoraho zerekana urukundo n’ubwizigirwa ku bitondera ivyo yihanikirije mw’isezerano ryiwe.
Uhoraho , ku bw’izina ryawe, mparira ukugabitanya kwanje, naho ari ugukomeye.
None, ni ba nde bubaha Uhoraho ? Azobereka inzira bakwiye kujana.
Bazomara imisi yabo bari mu buhirwe, kandi uruvyaro rwabo ruzoragwa igihugu.
Uhoraho abwira ibanga ryiwe abamwubaha; akabamenyesha isezerano ryiwe.
Amaso yanje ndayahanga Uhoraho ibihe vyose, kuko ari we wenyene azokura ibirenge vyanje mu mutego.
Hindukira ungirire ubuntu, kuko ndi inyakamwe nkaba ndi mu mubabaro.
Kuraho amarushwa yo mu mutima wanje, unkure mu mubabaro.
Raba umubabaro wanje n’amarushwa yanje kandi unkureko ivyaha vyanje vyose.
Raba ingene abansi banje ari benshi n’ukuntu banyanka urunuka!
Zigama ubugingo bwanje unkize; ntundeke ngo maramare, kuko nguhungiyeko.
Ugutungana n’ubugororotsi nibinzigame, kuko ivyizigiro vyanje biri muri wewe, Uhoraho .
Rokora Isirayeli, ewe Mana, ubakure mu marushwa yabo yose!

headings.text: Ni iya Dawidi.

verses.text: Ncira urubanza runkiza, ewe Uhoraho , kuko nabayeho ntagira umugayo; nizigiye Uhoraho kandi sinanyiganyize.
Nunsese, ewe Uhoraho , nungeze, suzuma umutima wanje n’ivyiyumviro vyanje;
Kuko namye nitwararika urukundo rwawe rudashira kandi nagenda nisunga ubwizigirwa bwawe.
Sinicarana n’ababeshi, canke ngo nifatanye n’indyadya.
Nanka ikoraniro ry’inkozi z’ibibi no kwicarana n’inkorabara.
Nkaraba ibiganza vyanje nerekana ko ata co niyagiriza, kandi nzunguruka igicaniro cawe, ewe Uhoraho ,
ndirimba ishimwe ryawe mvuga ibitangaza vyose wakoze.
Uhoraho we, ndakunda Ingoro ubamwo, aho ubwiza bwawe buba.
Ntujaniranye umushaha wanje n’abanyavyaha, ubugingo bwanje ntibuje mu gitigiri c’abicanyi,
mu gitigiri c’abafise imigabo mibi, bemera kurya ibiturire.
Mbayeho ntagira agasembwa; umbohore ungirire imbabazi.
Ibirenge vyanje birashikamye; nzohimbaza Uhoraho mw’ikoraniro rinini.

headings.text: Ni iya Dawidi.

verses.text: Uhoraho ni we muco wanje n’agakiza kanje; none notinya nde? Uhoraho ni igihome kinkingira; none ni nde yontera ubwoba?
Abanyakibi nibantera ngo bamire miyonzwa, abansi banje n’abangwanya ni bo bazotsitara batembe.
Naho ingabo zontera, umutima wanje worema; naho intambara yokwaduka intumbereye, naho nyene norema.
Ico nsaba Uhoraho ni kimwe, kandi ni co conyene ndondera: ni ukuba mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho imisi yose yo kubaho kwanje, ngo nihweze ubwiza bw’ Uhoraho , ndamurondera mu rusengero rwiwe.
Kuko ku musi w’amagorwa azonzigama amahoro mu Ngoro yiwe; azompisha mu bwihisho bwo mw’ihema ryiwe anshire hejuru ku rutare.
Maze umutwe wanje uzoshirwa hejuru nsumbe abansi banje bankikije; nzomushikanira ikimazi mw’ihema ryiwe ryera n’akamo k’umunezero; nzoririmba ncurarangire Uhoraho .
Uhoraho , unyumve ninakwambaza; ungirire imbabazi unyishure.
Umutima wanje ukuvugako uti: “Rondera mu nyonga hiwe!” Mu nyonga hawe ndaharondera, ewe Uhoraho .
Ntumpishe mu nyonga hawe, ntuhebe umusavyi wawe kubera uburake; wamye uri umutabazi wanje, ntunte canke ngo umpebe, ewe Mana Mukiza wanje.
Naho data na mama bonta, Uhoraho azonyitorera.
Nyigisha inzira yawe, ewe Uhoraho ; undongorere mu nzira igororotse kubera abansi bankikije.
Ntundeke ngo ngwe mu vyo bipfuza, kuko ivyabona vy’ibinyoma vyampagurukiye, bavuga ivy’iterabwoba no kungirira nabi.
Ico nizigiye ntakekeranya ni iki: Nzobona ukugira neza kw’ Uhoraho nkiri mw’isi y’abazima.
Urorere Uhoraho ; ukomere ureme mu mutima kandi urorere Uhoraho .

headings.text: Ni iya Dawidi.

verses.text: Ni wewe, Uhoraho ntakambiye; ni wewe Gitandara canje, ntiwime amatwi ugusenga kwanje. Kuko niwihoza, nzomera nk’abamanuka baja mu cobo.
Niwumve ugutakamba kwanje igihe cose ngutabaje, uko ntarika ibiganza vyanje ndabirabisha Ahera Cane.
Ntunjaniranye n’abanyakibi, hamwe n’abakora ibibi, bavugana ivyiza na bagenzi babo ariko bafise imigambi mibi mu mitima yabo.
Ubahe ingero ikwiranye n’ibikorwa vyabo, n’ibikorwa bibi vyabo; ubishure ku vyo amaboko yabo yakoze, ubasubirize mu nkoko ibikwiranye na bo.
Kubera batababaye ibikorwa vy’ Uhoraho n’ivyakozwe n’ukuboko kwiwe, azobatsinda hasi ntiyongere kububaka.
Uhoraho ashimwe, kuko yumvise ugutakamba kwanje.
Uhoraho ni we nkomezi zanje n’inkinzo yanje; umutima wanje uramwizigira, na we akantabara. Umutima wanje witerera hejuru kubera umunezero, nanje nzomushimisha indirimbo yanje.
Uhoraho ni inkomezi z’abantu biwe, igihome c’agakiza ku wo yarobanuje amavuta.
Tabara ubwoko bwawe uhe umugisha umugabane wawe; ubabere umwungere, ubaheke ibihe bidashira.

headings.text: Ni iya Dawidi.

verses.text: Nimwubahe Uhoraho , yemwe ngabo zo mw’ijuru, mwubahe Imana kubera ubwiza bwayo n’inkomezi zayo.
Nimuhe Uhoraho icubahiro kibereye izina ryayo; musenge Imana mu cubahiro c’ukwera kwayo.
Ijwi ry’ Uhoraho ryumvikanira ku mazi menshi; Imana y’ubwiza iraturagaye, Imana ituragariye ku mazi menshi y’inkomezi.
Ijwi ry’ Uhoraho riri n’inkomezi; ijwi ry’ Uhoraho riri n’icubahiro.
Ijwi ry’ Uhoraho rivunagura amasederi; Uhoraho ahindura ubunywenywe amasederi y’i Libani.
Atuma Libani hikina amatavu nk’inyana, Siriyoni hakikina amatavu nk’inyana y’imbogo.
Ijwi ry’ Uhoraho rirekura ibikeke vy’imiravyo.
Ijwi ry’ Uhoraho rinyiganyiza ubugaragwa; Uhoraho anyiganyiza ubugaragwa bw’i Kadeshi.
Ijwi ry’ Uhoraho rinyiganyiza ibiti bininibinini rikambika ubusa amashamba. Kandi mu Ngoro yiwe vyose bisemerera biti: “Ishimwe!”
Uhoraho avyagiye ku mwuzure; Uhoraho avyagiye nk’Umwami ibihe bidashira.
Uhoraho aha abantu biwe inkomezi; Uhoraho aha abantu biwe umugisha w’amahoro.

headings.text: Ni Zaburi ya Dawidi.

verses.text: Nzogushira hejuru, Uhoraho , kuko wanshize hejuru unkuye mu kinogo kirekire, ntiwandeka ngo abansi banje banshinyagurire.
Uhoraho Mana yanje, naragutakambiye, na we urankiza.
Ni wewe, Uhoraho , wankuye ahantu h’abapfuye; warandinze ngo simanuke nja muri rwa rwobo.
Nimuririmbire Uhoraho amashimwe, yemwe abizigirwa biwe; muhimbaze izina ryiwe ryera.
Kuko uburake bwiwe bumara akanya gato, ariko ukugira neza kwiwe kugumaho ubuzima bwose; ukurira kwomara ijoro ryose, ariko mu gitondo hakaba impundu.
Igihe nari ntekaniwe naravuze nti: “Sinzonyiganyizwa.”
Uhoraho , igihe wangirira neza, watumye umusozi w’ubwami bwanje ushikama; ariko aho wahisha mu nyonga hawe, nishwe n’ubwoba.
Narakwambaje, ewe Uhoraho ; natabaje Uhoraho Umwami wanje nti:
“Uzokwunguka iki ninapfa, ninamanuka nkaja muri rwa rwobo? Mbega umukungugu uzoguhimbaza? Canke uzokwamamaza ukwizigirwa kwawe?
Nunyumve, ewe Uhoraho , ungirire imbabazi; Uhoraho we, umbere umutabazi.”
Wahinduye ugucura intimba kwanje ukuvyina; wanyambuye igunira unyambika impuzu y’umunezero,
kugira ngo umutima wanje uririmbe amashimwe urudaca. Uhoraho Mana yanje, nzogushima ibihe bidashira.

headings.text: Ni Zaburi. Ni indirimbo ya Dawidi yo gushikiriza Uhoraho Ingoro.

verses.text: Muri wewe, Uhoraho , ni ho mpungiye; sinze nigere maramara; unkize ku bw’ukugororoka kwawe.
Ntega ugutwi, nyaruka untabare; umbere igitandara mpungiramwo, igihome gikomeye kinkingira.
Ni wewe gitandara canje n’igihome canje, undongore kandi ungire inama ku bw’izina ryawe.
Undinde kugwa mu mutego watezwe imbere yanje, kuko ari wewe buhungiro bwanje.
Mu biganza vyawe ni ho nshize impwemu yanje; nkiza, Uhoraho , Mana yanje yo kwizigirwa.
Nanka abumira ku bigirwamana bitagira ikimazi; ariko jeho, nizigira Uhoraho .
Nzonezerwa mpimbarirwe urukundo rwawe, kuko wabonye umubabaro wanje ukamenya amagorwa y’umutima wanje.
Ntiwandekuriye mu maboko y’umwansi ariko washize ibirenge vyanje ahagutse.
Ngirira ikigongwe, Uhoraho , kuko ndi mu mubabaro; amaso yanje aruhijwe n’umubabaro, umushaha wanje n’umubiri wanje bimazwe n’agahinda.
Ubugingo bwanje bumazwe n’umubabaro imyaka yanje imazwe n’ukuniha; inkomezi zanje ziraheze kubera amarushwa, n’amagufa yanje aradendebukiwe.
Kubera abansi banje, mbaye ruvumwa muri bagenzi banje n’abakunzi banje pfampfe bangiye kure; abambona mu mayira barampunga.
Ndibagiranywe nk’uwapfuye; mbaye nk’inkono imenetse.
Kuko numva ubwongoshwe bwinshi: “Ibiterabwoba impande zose!” Bangira inama mbi bagira imigabo yo kunyica.
Ariko nizigiye wewe, Uhoraho ; ndavuga nti: “Uri Imana yanje.”
Ibihe vyanje biri mu biganza vyawe; nkura mu maboko y’abansi banje, mu maboko y’abampiga.
Murikishiriza mu nyonga hawe umusavyi wawe; nkiriza mu rukundo rwawe rudahera.
Ntundeke ngo maramare, ewe Uhoraho , kuko ngutakambiye; ariko abanyakibi babe ari bo bamaramara bamanuke mu gacerere baja ahantu h’abapfuye.
Iminwa yabo ibesha nizibwe, kuko bavugana ubwibone bavuga nabi umugororotsi buzuye ubwishime n’akagaye.
Ese ingene ivyiza ari vyinshi ivyo wabikiye abakwubaha, ngo ubicuncuburire mu maso ya bose, ku bahungira muri wewe.
Mu bwihisho bwo mu nyonga hawe ni ho ubahisha inama mbi abandi babagira; ubarindira mu nzu yawe mu mahoro ababavuga nabi.
Ishimwe ni iry’ Uhoraho , kuko yanyeretse ibitangaza vyo mu rukundo rwiwe igihe nari mu gisagara gikikujwe n’abagiteye.
Kubera ubwoba nari mfise naravuze nti: “Nkuwe mu nyonga zawe!” Ariko wumvise ugutakamba kwanje igihe naguhamagara ngo untabare.
Nimukunde Uhoraho , yemwe bizigirwa biwe! Uhoraho azigama abamutunganiye, ariko abishira hejuru abasubiriza mu nkoko ibihwanye n’ivyo bakoze.
Nimukomere mureme mu mitima, yemwe mwese abizigira Uhoraho .

headings.text: Yahawe umukuru w’abaririmvyi. Ni Zaburi ya Dawidi.

verses.text: Hahiriwe umuntu Imana yababariye ibikorwa vyiwe bibi; ivyaha vyiwe bigaharirwa.
Hahiriwe umuntu Uhoraho adaharurako ivyaha vyiwe kandi mu impwemu yiwe ntihabemwo ubugunge.
Ncereje, amagufa yanje aruma kubera kuboroga bukarinda bwira.
Kuko ku murango no mw’ijoro ukuboko kwawe kwandemera; inkomezi zanje zaragurutse nk’ukwuma kwo mu ci.
Ni kuko nakwemereye icaha canje sinanyegeza ukugabitanya kwanje. Naravuze nti: “Ndaturira Uhoraho ukugabitanya kwanje.” Nawe wampariye ugucumura kwanje.
Ni co gituma abakwizigira bose bakwiye kugusenga mu mwanya ushobora kubonerwamwo; ni ukuri amazi menshi asuriranya ntazobashikira.
Ni wewe buhungiro bwanje; uzonkingira amagorwa unkikize indirimbo zo kunesha.
Nzokwigisha ndakwereke inzira ukwiye kujana; nzokugira inama ndaguhozeko ijisho ryanje.
Ntimube nk’ifarasi canke inyumbu bitagira ugutahura, ariko birinda gukubitwa no gukwegwa n’imigozi, kuko bitari uko ntivyokwegera umuntu.
Umunyakibi azobona amagorwa menshi, ariko urukundo rw’ Uhoraho rudashira rukikuje umuntu amwizigira.
Nimunezererwe Uhoraho muhimbarwe, yemwe bagororotsi; nimuririmbe, abatunganye mu mutima mwese!

headings.text: Ni iya Dawidi. Ni masikili.

verses.text: Nimuririmbire Uhoraho munezerewe, yemwe bagororotsi; birabereye abatunganye kumuhimbaza.
Muhimbaze Uhoraho n’ikembe; mumucurarangire n’inanga y’imirya cumi.
Mumuririmbire indirimbo nshasha; mucurarangishe ubuhinga, muvuze impundu z’umunezero.
Kuko ijambo ry’ Uhoraho rigororotse kandi ari iry’ukuri; ni umwizigirwa mu vyo akora vyose.
Uhoraho akunda ubugororotsi n’imanza zibereye; isi yuzuye urukundo rwiwe rudashira.
Amajuru yaremwe n’ijambo ry’ Uhoraho , inyenyeri zo kw’ijuru zose zaremwe n’impwemu z’akanwa kiwe.
Yegeraniriza mu mibindi amazi yo mu kiyaga; ashira amazi yose yo mw’idamba mu bubiko.
Isi yose niyubahe Uhoraho ; abo mw’isi bose nibamwunamire.
Kuko yavuze bikaba; agategeka, bigakomera.
Uhoraho ahindura ubusa imigambi y’amahanga; asambura imigabo y’amoko.
Imigambi y’ Uhoraho ihora ihangamye ibihe bidashira, imigabo y’umutima wiwe yamaho uko urunganwe rukuranwa n’urundi.
Hahiriwe ihanga rifise Uhoraho nk’Imana yaryo, abantu yitoranirije ngo bamubere inyegu.
Uhoraho ari mw’ijuru arunguruka kw’isi ngo arabe abana b’abantu;
ari aho aba yitegereza abari kw’isi bose;
Uwaremye imitima yabo bose, yitegereza ivyo bakora vyose.
Nta mwami akizwa n’uko afise ingabo nyinshi; nta muhizi akizwa n’uko afise inkomezi nyinshi.
Ntukizigire ifarasi ngo igukize; naho ifise inkomezi nyinshi ntishobora gukiza.
Ariko inyonga z’ Uhoraho ziri ku bamwubaha, ku bizigira urukundo rwiwe rudashira,
ngo rubakize urupfu rubazigame bagume ari bazima mu gihe c’ikigoyi.
Turindiriye Uhoraho twihanganye; kuko ari umutabazi wacu n’inkinzo yacu.
Imitima yacu inezererwa muri we, kuko twizigiye izina ryiwe ryera.
Urukundo rwawe rudashira rubane natwe, ewe Uhoraho , kuko ari wewe twizigiye.
Nzokwama nshima Uhoraho ibihe vyose; ishimwe ryiwe rizokwama ku minwa yanje ubudasiba.
Nzokwirata Uhoraho ; abaciye bugufi nibavyumve banezerwe.
Nimumfashe dushime Uhoraho ; nimuze dufatanye gushira hejuru izina ryiwe.
Narondeye Uhoraho , na we aranyishura; ankiza ubwoba bwose nari mfise.
Abamuravye bose barakayangana; mu maso habo ntihazokwigera hamaramara.
Uwu mugorwa yarambaje, Uhoraho aramwumva; amukiza amarushwa yiwe yose.
Umumarayika w’ Uhoraho acumbitse hirya no hino y’abamwubaha, akabakiza.
Nimwumvirize mumenye ko Uhoraho ari mwiza; hahiriwe uwumuhungirako.
Nimwubahe Uhoraho , yemwe abera biwe, kuko abamwubaha batazogira ico bakena.
Intambwe zocika intege zigasonza, ariko abarondera Uhoraho ntibazokena iciza na kimwe.
Nimuze bana banje, munyumvirize; nanje ndabigishe ukwubaha Uhoraho .
Umuntu wese akunda ubugingo akipfuza kubona imisi myiza myinshi,
aze arinde ururimi rwiwe ikibi n’iminwa yiwe ayirinde ivyo kubesha.
Itandukanye n’ikibi, ukore ivyiza; rondera amahoro uyakurikire.
Inyonga z’ Uhoraho ziri ku bagororotsi, kandi amatwi yiwe ayabangira ugutakamba kwabo;
ariko igitsure ciwe kiri ku bakora ibibi, ngo aherengeteze ukwibukwa kwabo kw’isi.
Abagororotsi baratakamvye, Uhoraho arabumva; abakiza amarushwa yabo yose.
Uhoraho ari hafi y’abafise imitima imenetse kandi akiza abajanjaguritse imitima.
Amarushwa y’umugororotsi ashobora kuba menshi, ariko Uhoraho ayamukiza yose;
azigama amagufa yiwe, nta na rimwe rizovunika.
Ikibi kizokwica umunyakibi; abagwanya umugororotsi bazotsindwa n’urubanza.
Uhoraho azokiza abasavyi biwe; nta n’umwe mu bamuhungirako azotsindwa n’urubanza.

headings.text: Ni iya Dawidi. Igihe yihindura umusazi imbere ya Abimeleki, agaca amwirukana, na we agaca agenda.

verses.text: Uhoraho , burana n’abamburanya; gwana n’abangwanya.
Fata inkinzo yawe, nini na ntoya; uve hasi untabare.
Bangura icumu n’ikimito utere abampiga. Umbwire uti: “Ni jewe gakiza kawe.”
Abarondera ubugingo bwanje nibateterwe bamaramare; abagira inama yo kunyica basubire inyuma batinye.
Nibamere nk’umuguruka utumurwa n’umuyaga, umumarayika w’ Uhoraho abirukane;
iminyuro yabo nicure umwijima kandi inyerere, umumarayika w’ Uhoraho abahige abakinagize.
Kuko banteze umutego ata nyanduruko bakanyimbira icobo ata gituma,
uguhona nikubashikeko giturumbuka; umutego bateze abe ari bo ufata, bagwe muri ca cobo, bahonereyo.
Ni ho umutima wanje uzonezererwa Uhoraho , ugahimbarirwa agakiza kiwe.
Ibimbamwo vyose bizokwatura biti: “Ni nde ameze nkawe, ewe Uhoraho ? Ukiza abakene ababarusha inkomezi, aboro n’abakene ukabakiza ababahahaza.”
Ivyabona vy’ibinyoma bihagurukiye kunyagiriza; bambaza ibintu ata na kimwe ndabiziko.
Banyishuye ikibi ku ciza nabagiriye maze banta jenyene.
Ariko igihe bari bagwaye, nambaye igunira nicisha bugufi ndisonzesha. Amasengesho yanje atishuwe,
nagendagenda ngandaye nk’uwabuze umukunzi canke umuvukanyi. Nacuritse umutwe ngandaye nk’uwabuze nyina.
Ariko aho natsitara, bagiye hamwe baranezerwa; bakoraniye kungwanya ntabizi. Bamvuze nabi ubudahumeka.
Bancokoye nk’abatubaha Imana, bampekenyera amenyo.
Uzogeza ryari, ewe Mana, kubiraba ntugire ico ukora? Ntabara unkize ibibi bakora, ukure ubugingo bwanje bw’igiciro mu menyo y’izo ntambwe!
Nzogushimira mw’ikoraniro rinini; imbere y’amasinzi nzoguhimbaza.
Ntureke abo ngo banyishimeko, banyankira ubusa; ntureke abanyanka ata gituma ngo bavuniranire ingohe.
Ntibavuga ivy’amahoro, ariko biyumvira ivyo kubeshera abibera mu gihugu ata nkomanzi.
Bashira urwamo hejuru bambwira bati: “Aha! Aha! Twavyiboneye n’amaso yacu.”
Uhoraho we, warabibonye; ntucereze. Ntube kure yanje, ewe Mana.
Ikangure uve hasi ungwanire! Mburanira, ewe Mana yanje kandi Mwami wanje.
Ungwanire mu bugororotsi bwawe, Uhoraho Mana yanje; ntubareke ngo banyishime hejuru.
Ntubareke ngo bavuge bati: “Ivyo ni vyo twarondera!” Canke bati: “Twamumize miyonzwa.”
Abahimbarwa n’uko nguye mu vyago nibamaramare bakorwe n’isoni; abanyishimako bakorwe n’isoni, bamaramare.
Abahimbarwa n’uko ntabawe nibavuze impundu z’umunezero; bame bavuga bati: “ Uhoraho ashirwe hejuru, we ahimbarwa n’ukugubwa neza kw’umusavyi wiwe.”
Ururimi rwanje ruzokwamamaza ukugororoka kwawe, n’amashimwe yawe burinde bwira.

headings.text: Ni iya Dawidi.

verses.text: Mfise ubutumwa mu mutima wanje buvuye ku Mana yanje bwerekeye ububi bw’abanyakibi ngo: Nta gutinya Imana kuri muri bo.
Mu maso yabo barihenda ubwabo kugeza aho batamenya canke ngo banke icaha cabo.
Amajambo yo mu kanwa kabo ni mabi, ni ay’uruhendo; bananiwe no gukora ivy’ubwenge canke ngo bakore ivyiza.
Bari no ku mariri yabo baja imigabo yo gukora ibibi; bakiyegurira gusiganwa mu bibi ntibatere ibitugu ibitari ivy’ukuri.
Uhoraho , urukundo rwawe rushika no mw’ijuru, ukwizigirwa kwawe gushika no mu birere.
Ukugororoka kwawe kumeze nk’imisozi miremire, imanza zawe zimeze nk’idamba rinini. Ewe Uhoraho Mana, ni wewe ubwawe uzigama abantu n’ibikoko.
Ese ukuntu urukundo rwawe rudashira ari akaburarugero, ewe Mana! Abantu bahungira musi y’igitutu c’amababa yawe.
Bagira umusi mukuru mu bihinda vyo mu nzu yawe; ubaha ivyo kunywa biva ku ruzi rwawe rw’ibiryoshe.
Kuko kuri wewe ari ho hari isoko y’ubugingo; mu nyonga hawe ni ho tubonera umuco.
Shishikara ukunda abakumenye, ugume uri umugororotsi ku batunganye mu mitima.
Ikirenge c’umwibone ntikigahonyore iwanje, n’ukuboko kw’umunyakibi kwirukanwe.
Ehe ingene inkozi z’ibibi ziguye hasi; baratemvye, ubutagihaguruka!

headings.text: Yahawe umukuru w’abaririmvyi. Ni iya Dawidi umusavyi w’ Uhoraho .

verses.text: Ntuhagarikwe umutima n’abanyakibi canke ngo wipfuze ivy’abakora ibibi;
kuko bagiye gutemwa nk’ubwatsi vuba, bazokwuma nk’uko ivyatsi vyuma.
Wizigire Uhoraho ukore ivyiza; guma mu gihugu unezerererwe uburagiro bwiza.
Uhimbarwe n’ Uhoraho , na we azoguha ivyo umutima wawe wipfuza.
Wegurire Uhoraho inzira yawe; umwizigire na we azobishitsa:
Azotuma ingero yawe yo kugororoka ikayangana nk’umutwenzi, n’urubanza rwawe nk’izuba ryo mu mashoka.
Utekerereze imbere y’ Uhoraho umurindire wihanganye; ntuze ubabare abantu nibatunganirwa mu nzira zabo, nibashira mu ngiro imigambi yabo mibi.
Reka ishavu, va mu burake; ntushangashirwe; vyotuma ukora nabi.
Kuko abanyakibi bazohona, ariko abizigira Uhoraho bazoragwa igihugu.
Hasigaye igihe gito, umunyakibi ntabe akibaho; uzomurondera ariko ntuzomubona.
Ariko abaciye bugufi bazoragwa isi banezerererwe amahoro n’ukugubwa neza.
Umunyakibi agirira imigabo mibi umugororotsi akamuhekenyera amenyo;
ariko wewe Mana atwengera mw’ijigo umunyakibi, kuko azi ko umusi wiwe ushitse.
Umunyakibi asokoye inkota kandi afoye umuheto ngo atsinde hasi umworo n’umukene, ngo yice uwugenda atunganye mu nzira ziwe.
Ariko inkota yiwe izosogota umutima wiwe bwite, n’umuheto wiwe uzovunika.
Kuba umugororotsi no gutunga bike biruta kuba umunyakibi afise ubutunzi bwinshi;
kuko inkomezi z’umunyakibi zizovunagurwa, ariko Uhoraho ashigikiye umugororotsi.
Inyankamugayo zimara imisi yazo zishigikiwe n’ Uhoraho , kandi ivyo zarazwe bizokwamaho ibihe vyose.
Mu bihe vy’ivyago ntibazokabirana; no mu gihe ca kigoyi bazonezererwa umusesekara.
Ariko umunyakibi azohona: naho abansi b’ Uhoraho bameze nk’amashurwe yo ku misozi, bazotongorwa batumuke nk’umwotsi.
Umunyakibi aragurana ntasubize, ariko umugororotsi atanga ivyo ubuntu;
abahawe umugisha n’ Uhoraho bazoragwa igihugu, ariko abavumwe na we bazohona.
Uhoraho akomeza intambuko z’uwumwishimira;
naho yotsitara, ntazogwa hasi, kuko Uhoraho amushigikije ukuboko kwiwe.
Kuva ndi muto kugeza ubu nshaje, sinigeze mbona umugororotsi yatawe canke abana biwe basegerereza ivyokurya.
Yama atanga ivyo ubuntu akaguranira kutaziga inyungu; abana biwe bazoba umugisha.
Va mu bibi ukore ivyiza; ni ho uzoba mu gihugu ibihe bidashira.
Kuko Uhoraho akunda uwutunganye kandi ntazohemukira abizigirwa biwe. Abakora ibibi bazohona rwose; uruvyaro rw’umunyakibi ruzohona.
Umugororotsi azoragwa igihugu akibemwo ibihe vyose.
Akanwa k’umugororotsi katura ivy’ubwenge, n’ururimi rwiwe ruvuga ibitunganye.
Ivyagezwe vy’Imana yiwe biri mu mutima wiwe, ibirenge vyiwe ntibizonyerera.
Umunyakibi abundira umugororotsi, agomba kumwica.
Yamara Uhoraho ntazomurekurira mu maboko yiwe canke ngo amureke atsindwe niyaja imbere y’intahe.
Wizigire Uhoraho ugume mu nzira yiwe. Azogushira hejuru uragwe igihugu, abanyakibi bazohona ubiraba.
Nabonye umunyakibi w’umwicanyi asagarara nk’igiti gitotahaye,
ariko yarazimanganye ntiyaba akiboneka; naho namurondeye, ntiyari akiboneka.
Witegereze uwutagira umugayo, urabe uwutunganye; kazoza keza karindiriye abarondera amahoro.
Ariko abanyavyaha bazopfa; nta kazoza ku munyakibi.
Agakiza k’abagororotsi kava k’ Uhoraho ; ni we gihome kibakingira mu bihe vy’amagorwa.
Uhoraho ni we abatabara akabarokora; akabarokora mu maboko y’abanyakibi akabakiza, kuko bamuhungiyeko.

headings.text: Ni iya Dawidi.

verses.text: Uhoraho , ntumpanane ishavu canke ngo unkubitane uburake.
Imyampi yawe irantobekeranije, kandi ukuboko kwawe kwaramanukiye.
Muri jewe nta hazima kubera uburake bwawe; no mu magufa yanje sinikoma kubera icaha canje.
Ukugabitanya kwanje kurandengeye kwabaye nk’umuzigo ntashobora kwikorera.
Ibikomere vyanje birasebuye kandi biranuka kubera ivyaha vyanje vy’ubupfu.
Ncishijwe bugufi cane ndahetamye; ngenda ngandaye bukarinda bwira.
Umugongo wanje wuzuye ububabare bwinshi; nta na hamwe nikoma.
Mfise intege nke, ndavunaguritse; ngenda ngandaye mu mutima.
Ivyo nipfuza vyose biri imbere yawe, ewe Mana; ukuniha kwanje ntuguhishijwe.
Umutima wanje urahagaze, ncitse intege; mbere n’amaso yanje ntagira umuco.
Abagenzi banje n’abo twagendana bampevye kubera ibikomere vyanje; ababanyi banje bahagarara kure yanje.
Abagomba kunyica banteze imitego, abagomba kungirira nabi bangira inama yo kunyica; bavugana ibinyoma umusi wose bukarinda bwira.
Meze nk’igipfamatwi, kidashobora kwumva, nk’ikiragi, kidashobora kuvuga;
nabaye nk’uwutumva, uwo akanwa kiwe kadashobora kwishura.
Uhoraho we, ni wewe ndindiriye; uzokwishura, Mwami Imana yanje.
Kuko navuze nti: “Ntubareke ngo banyitambe ku muvyimba canke ngo banezerwe ninagwa hasi.”
Kuko ngira ngwe hasi, kandi umubabaro wanje ugumana nanje na ntaryo.
Ndatuye ukugabitanya kwanje; mbujijwe amahoro n’icaha canje.
Benshi bahindutse abansi banje ata nyanduruko; abanyanka ata nyanduruko babaye benshi.
Abanyishura ibibi ku vyiza nabagiriye bazanye ibirego bandega, naho jewe ndazwa ishinga no gukora ivyiza gusa.
Uhoraho ntumpebe; ntube kure yanje, Mana yanje.
Tebuka untabare, Mwami wanje kandi Mukiza wanje.

headings.text: Ni Zaburi ya Dawidi. Ni isengesho.

verses.text: Naravuze nti: “Nzocungera inzira zanje ndinde ururimi rwanje icaha; nzoshira umurinzi ku munwa wanje ndi imbere y’umunyakibi.”
Ni co gituma nagumye mu gacerere, ata n’iciza mvuga. Ariko umubabaro wanje warongerekana;
umutima wanje waranshongeramwo. Nkiriko ndavyiyumvira, umuriro waraka; maze mvugisha ururimi rwanje nti:
“ Uhoraho , nyereka iherezo ry’ubuzima bwanje n’igitigiri c’imisi yanje; umpe kumenya ko ubuzima bwanje bumara akanya gato.
Wahinduye imisi y’ukubaho kwanje uyinganya n’ikiganza gusa; ikiringo c’imyaka yanje ni nk’aho ari ubusa kuri wewe. Umuntu wese ni nk’impwemu zihumetswe gusa, no ku baboneka ko bakingiwe.
Ni ivy’ukuri umuntu wese agenda nk’igitutu gusa; birukira ubusa, barondera ubutunzi batazi uwuzobutahira kw’iherezo.
Ariko noneho ubu ndondera iki, ewe Mana? Ivyizigiro vyanje biri muri wewe.
Nkiza ibigabitanyo vyanje vyose; ntumpindure agatwengo k’ibipfu.
Nari ncereje; sinakurako umunwa, kuko ari wewe wakoze ivyo.
Nkurako ikimoko cawe; kuko nseserejwe cane n’inkoni zawe.
Iyo uhanye ugakubita abantu kubera icaha cabo, urya ubutunzi bwiwe nk’umuswa; ni ukuri bose ni impwemu zihumetswe gusa.
Niwumve ugusenga kwanje, ewe Uhoraho , wumvirize ugutakamba kwanje; ntiwizibe amatwi ngo woye kwumva amarira yanje. Mbana nawe nk’umunyamahanga, nk’injabuka, nk’uko ba sogokuru banje bari bari.
Raba hirya, kugira ngo nsubire kunezererwa ubuzima ntaragenda ngo sinze nongere kubaho.”

headings.text: Yahawe umukuru w’abaririmvyi. Yahawe kandi Yedutuni. Ni Zaburi ya Dawidi.

verses.text: Narorereye Uhoraho nihanganye; na we arahindukira yumva ugutakamba kwanje.
Yankuye mu cobo c’ukwihebura, ankura mu vyondo binyika; ashinga ibirenge vyanje ku rutare ampa aho guhagarara hakomeye.
Yashize indirimbo nsha mu kanwa kanje, indirimbo y’ishimwe ry’Imana yacu. Benshi bazobibona bubahe Uhoraho maze bamwizigire.
Hahiriwe umuntu yizigira Uhoraho , ntashire amaso ku bibone, canke ku bahindukirira ibigirwamana.
Uhoraho Mana yanje, ibitangaza wakoze ni vyinshi, ivyo waduteguriye. Nta cogereranywa nawe; novuga ibikorwa vyawe, vyoba vyinshi cane sinobimara.
Ibimazi n’amashikanwa si vyo washatse; ariko wuguruye amatwi yanje; ibimazi bituriwe n’ibimazi vy’ivyaha ntivyaguhimbaye.
Nuko ndavuga nti: “Ndi hano, ndaje; ni ko vyanditswe kuri jewe, mu muzingo w’igitabu,
ndipfuza gukora ivyo ugomba, Mana yanje; ivyagezwe vyawe biri mu mutima wanje.”
Ndamamaza ibikorwa vyawe vyo kugororoka mw’ikoraniro rinini; sincereza, ewe Uhoraho , nk’uko ubizi.
Sinyegeza ukugororoka kwawe mu mutima wanje; ndavuga ukwizigirwa kwawe n’ugutabara kwawe. Sinshira mu gisimbo urukundo rwawe n’ukwizigirwa kwawe ngo ndabihishe mw’ikoraniro rinini.
Ntunkureko imbabazi zawe, ewe Uhoraho ; urukundo rwawe n’ubwizigirwa kwawe vyame binzigama.
Kuko ivyago bitagira igitigiri binkikije; ivyaha vyanje biramfashe, nanje nta vyo mbona. Ni vyinshi nk’umushatsi wo ku mutwe wanje, n’umutima wanje ucitse intege.
Uhoraho we, emera kunkiza; Uhoraho , tebuka untabare.
Abagomba kunyica nibamaramare bakorwe n’isoni; abipfuza ko nohona bose nibasubizwe inyuma bateterewe.
Abambwira bati: “Aha! Aha!” isoni zitume bazibwa akanwa.
Ariko abakurondera bose nibanezerwe bahimbarirwe muri wewe; abipfuza ugutabarwa kwawe bame bavuga bati: “ Uhoraho arahambaye!”
Ariko jeho ndi umworo, ndi umukene; ariko Uhoraho arambabara. Ni wewe mutabazi wanje n’umurokozi wanje; ni wewe Mana yanje, ntutebe.

headings.text: Ni izaburi ya Dawidi, yahawe umukuru w’abaririmvyi.

verses.text: Hahiriwe abababara umugorwa; Uhoraho azobakiza mu gihe c’ivyago.
Uhoraho azobarinda abakingire; bazoharurwa mu bahawe umugisha bo mu gihugu; ntazobarekurira mu maboko y’abansi babo.
Uhoraho azobashigikira bari ku buriri bagwaye, kandi azobasubizamwo inkomezi abahagurutse kuri ubwo buriri.
Naravuze nti: “Ngirira imbabazi, ewe Uhoraho ; unkize, kuko nagucumuyeko.”
Abansi banje bamvuga nabi bati: “Azopfa ryari ngo izina ryiwe ryibagiranwe?”
Iyo umwe muri bo aje kundaba, avuga ibinyoma, umutima wiwe uba wuzuye uruvugo; maze yasohoka akarukwiza hose.
Abansi banje bose bamvugira mu vyongoshwe; banyipfuriza ibibi bavuga bati:
“Yafashwe n’ingwara idakira; ntazovyuka aho aryamye.”
N’umugenzi wanje pfampfe, uwo nahora nizigira, uwo twasangiye akabisi n’agahiye, ni we yahindukiriye kungwanya.
Ariko wewe Uhoraho ngirira imbabazi, unkure hasi, kugira ngo ndabihore.
Ndazi ko unezerererwa, kuko umwansi wanje atazonyitamba ku muvyimba.
Kubera gutungana kwanje uranzigama, ukampagarika imbere yawe ibihe vyose.
Uhoraho we, Imana ya Isirayeli nahimbazwe, uhereye ibihe bidashira ukageza ibihe bidashira. Amen kandi Amen.

headings.text: Yahawe umukuru w’abaririmvyi. Ni Zaburi ya Dawidi.

verses.text: Nk’uko impongo ihuzagizwa irondera imigezi y’amazi, ni ko n’umutima wanje uhuzagizwa ukwipfuza, ewe Mana yanje.
Umutima wanje unyoterewe Imana, Imana Nzima. Nzogenda ryari kubonana n’Imana?
Amosozi yanje ni yo yabaye ivyokurya vyanje ku murango no mw’ijoro, mu gihe abantu bivugira bukarinda bwira bati: “Imana yawe iri hehe?”
Ibi ni vyo nibuka umutima wanje ukameneka: ingene nahora nja mu nzu y’Imana, nkingiwe n’Inyenkomezi, ndi mu mashimwe n’impundu, ndi kumwe n’abantu benshi banezerewe.
Mutima wanje, ni igiki gitumye wicurikira? Ni igiki gitumye umpagararamwo? Niwizigire Imana, kuko nzosubira kumuhimbaza, Umukiza wanje n’Imana yanje.
Umutima wanje wicurikiriye muri jewe; ni co gituma nzokwibuka ndi mu ntara ya Yorodani, mu bushorishori bwa Herumoni; ndi ku musozi Mizari.
Idamba rihamagara irindi damba mu gusuma kw’amazi asuma; imikuba yawe yose n’imipfunda yawe birandengeye.
Ku murango Uhoraho arongora urukundo rwiwe, mw’ijoro indirimbo yiwe ibana nanje; nk’isengesho ku Mana y’ubugingo bwanje.
Ndabwira Imana Gitandara canje nti: “Ni kuki wanyibagiye? Ni igiki cotuma ngenda ngandaye, kubera guhahazwa n’umwansi wanje?”
Amagufa yanje avunagurikiye muri jewe, kubera abansi banje bankindaga, bukarinda bwira bambwira bati: “Imana yawe iri hehe?”
Mutima wanje, ni igiki gitumye wicurikira? Ni igiki gitumye umpagararamwo? Niwizigire Imana, kuko nzosubira kuyihimbaza, yo mukiza wanje n’Imana yanje.

headings.text: Igitabu ca kabiri Zaburi 42–72|loc="PSA 42-72" Zaburi ya 42
Yahawe umukuru w’abaririmvyi. Ni masikili ya bene Kora.

verses.text: Ncira urubanza runkiza, ewe Mana yanje, uburane urubanza rwanje mfitaniye n’ihanga ritizigirwa. Ntabara unkize abo bantu, buzuye ubugunge n’ikibi.
Uri Imana, igihome kinkingira. Ni igiki kikumpebesheje? Ni igiki gituma mbayeho ngandaye, mpahazwa n’umwansi?
Ndungikira umuco wawe n’ukugira neza kwawe, bibe ari vyo bindongora; binshikane ku musozi wawe wera, aho uba.
Maze nzoja ku gicaniro c’Imana, ku Mana, yo munezero wanje n’ibihimbaro vyanje. Nzoguhimbarisha ikembe, ewe Mana, Mana yanje.
Mutima wanje, ni igiki gitumye wicurikira? Ni igiki gitumye umpagararamwo? Niwizigire Imana, kuko nzosubira kuyihimbaza, yo mukiza wanje n’Imana yanje.
Mana, twavyumvishije amatwi yacu; ba sogokuruza baratubwiye ivyo wakoze mu bihe vyabo, mu misi ya kera.
Wirukanye amahanga n’ukuboko kwawe maze uzana ba sogokuruza bacu; wirukanye amoko maze utuma ba sogokuruza bacu basagarara.
Ntibaronse igihugu kubera inkota yabo, kandi ntibanesheje kubera amaboko yabo; kwari ukuboko kwawe kw’i buryo, ukuboko kwawe, n’umuco wo mu nyonga hawe, kuko wabakunze.
Uri Umwami wanje n’Imana yanje, urategeka maze Yakobo akaronka intsinzi.
Muri wewe ni ho dukinagiriza abansi bacu; mw’izina ryawe dusiribangira hasi abatugwanya.
Sinizigira umuheto wanje, inkota yanje si yo impa kunesha;
ariko ni wewe uduha kunesha abansi bacu, utuma abatugwanya bamaramara.
Twirata Imana bukarinda bwira, kandi tuzoguhimbaza ibihe vyose.
Ariko ubu raba wadutaye uratumaramaza; ntukijana n’ingabo zacu.
Watumye dusubiza imigongo inyuma imbere y’umwansi, kandi abansi bacu batunyaze urukomba amazi.
Waradutanze turatabagurwa nk’intama kandi wadusanzarije mu mahanga.
Wagurishije abantu bawe igiciro gitoya, nta co wungutse umaze kubagurisha.
Waduhinduye akamenyo ku babanyi bacu, turacokorwa, dutwengwa n’abadukikuje.
Waduhinduye iciro ry’umugani mu mahanga; abantu batuzunguriza imitwe.
Mba mu biteterwe bukarinda bwira, kandi mu maso hanje nuzuye ibimaramare
kubera abitwengera bankora kw’itama, kubera umwansi, ashaka kwihora.
Ivyo vyose vyatubayeko, naho tutari twakwibagiye; ntitwari twahonyanze isezerano ryawe.
Imitima yacu ntiyari yasubiye inyuma; ibirenge vyacu ntivyari vyanyereye ngo bive mu nzira yawe.
Ariko waratujanjaguye duhinduka umusaka w’imbwebwe; wadupfukishije umwijima w’umuzitanya.
Iyo tuba twaribagiye izina ry’Imana yacu canke tukagaranzurira ibiganza vyacu imana y’inyamahanga,
Imana ntiba yarabibonye, ko izi amabanga yo mu mutima?
Ariko twirirwa turicwa kubera wewe, bukarinda bwira; dufatwa nk’intama zijanywe kubagwa.
Ikangure, ewe Mana! Ni kuki usinziriye? Va hasi! Ntuduhebe ibihe bidashira.
Ni kuki uduhisha mu nyonga hawe ukibagira amagorwa tugowe n’agahahazo turimwo?
Ducishijwe bugufi gushika mu mukungugu; imibiri yacu irambaraye hasi.
Va hasi udutabare; udutabare kubera urukundo rwawe rudashira.

headings.text: Yahawe umukuru w’abaririmvyi. Ni iya bene Kora. Ni masikili.

verses.text: Umutima wanje usimbagijwe n’amajambo meza ndiko ndaririmbira umwami amajambo meza; ururimi rwanje ni ikaramu y’umwanditsi w’umuhinga.
Uri rurangiranwa mu bantu kandi iminwa yawe yasizwe amavuta y’ubuntu, kuko Imana yaguhaye umugisha ibihe bidashira.
Hagatira inkota yawe kw’itako, ewe muhizi w’inkomezi; ushazishe ubwiza n’igitinyiro.
Mu cubahiro cawe gendera ku mukogote uje kunesha ugwanire ukuri, uguca bugufi n’uguca imanza zibereye; ukuboko kwawe kw’i buryo nigukore ibikomeye.
Imyampi yawe ikarishe nitobekeranye imitima y’abansi b’umwami; amahanga nahindikirane imbere y’ibirenge vyawe.
Ukuganza kwawe, ewe Mana, kuzokwamaho; ubugororotsi ni ryo cumu ry’inganji y’ubwami bwawe.
Wakunze ubugororotsi, wanka ikibi; ni co gituma Imana, ari yo Mana yawe, yagutoranije, ikakurobanuza amavuta y’umunezero, ikakurutisha bagenzawe.
Impuzu zawe zose zamoteshejwe neza n’imibavu, alowe n’akasiya; ibicurarangisho vy’imirya birakunezereza, vyumvikana bivuye mu mazu asharijwe n’amahembe y’inzovu.
Abakobwa b’abami bari mu bagore b’icubahiro; umugeni w’umwami ari i buryo bwawe yambaye inzahabu iva muri Ofiru.
Umviriza, mukobwa wanje, kandi ubishireko umutima: Wibagire ubwoko bwawe n’umuryango wawe.
Umwami yipfuze ubwiza bwawe; umwubahe, kuko ari umwami wawe.
Igisagara c’i Tiro kizozana ingabire, abantu bafise ubutunzi bazorondera ko ubaraba ryiza.
Umukobwa w’umwami yambaye ubwiza ari mu cumba ciwe; ikanzu yiwe idombagijeko inyuzi z’inzahabu.
Ajanywe ku mwami yambaye impuzu zitewe amabara menshi; inkumi zimuherekeje ziramukurikiye; ni abazanywe ngo babane na we.
Binjijwe mu munezero n’akaneza, binjiye mu ngoro y’umwami.
Abahungu bawe bazosubira mu kibanza ca ba sogokuruza banyu; uzobagira abaganwa mu gihugu cose.
Nanje nzokwibutsa abantu izina ryawe uko urunganwe ruzogenda rukuranwa n’urundi; ni co gituma amahanga azoguhimbaza ibihe bidashira.

headings.text: Yahawe umukuru w’abaririmvyi. Mw’ijwi ryitwa “Ikirungu.” Ni iya bene Kora. Ni masikili. Ni indirimbo y’ubukwe.

verses.text: Imana ni yo buhungiro bwacu n’inkomezi ni umufasha atabura guseruka mu magorwa.
Ni co gituma tutazotinya, naho isi yonyiganyiga n’imisozi ikagwa mw’ibenga ry’ikiyaga,
naho amazi yaco yosuriranya akuzura ifuro agatera n’imisozi kunyiganyiga.
Hari uruzi rufise amazi ahimbara igisagara c’Imana, ahera aho Iyisumbavyose iba.
Imana iri muri wo, ntuzonyiganyiga; Imana izowutabara umutwenzi utambitse.
Amahanga avugije urwamo, ubwami buranyiganyize; yumvikanishije ijwi ryayo, maze isi irashonga.
Uhoraho Mushoboravyose ari kumwe natwe; Imana ya Yakobo ni yo gihome kidukingira.
Nimuze murabe ivyo Uhoraho yakoze, ingene yasambaguye isi.
Yahagaritse intambara gushika ku mpera z’isi. Yavunaguye umuheto acagagura icumu; yaturiye umukogote mu muriro.
Uhoraho aravuga ati: “Nimutekereze, mumenye ko ndi Imana; nzoshirwa hejuru mu mahanga yose, nzoshirwa hejuru mw’isi.”
Uhoraho Mushoboravyose ari kumwe natwe; Imana ya Yakobo ni yo gihome kidukingira.

headings.text: Yahawe umukuru w’abaririmvyi. Ni iya bene Kora. Mw’ijwi ryitwa alamoti. Ni indirimbo.

verses.text: Yemwe mahanga mwese, nimukome amashi; nimushire ijwi hejuru muvugirize Imana impundu.
Kuko Uhoraho Musumbavyose ateye ubwoba, ni Umwami ahambaye aganza isi yose.
Yacishije bugufi amahanga musi yacu, amoko yayashize musi y’ibirenge vyacu.
Yadutoranirije umugabane wacu, ivyirato vya Yakobo, uwo yakunze.
Imana iduze mu mashimwe, Uhoraho aduze mu majwi y’inzamba.
Nimuhimbaze Imana, nimuyihimbaze; nimuhimbaze Umwami wacu, nimumuhimbaze.
Kuko Imana ari Umwami aganza isi yose; nimumuririmbire Zaburi y’ishimwe.
Imana iganje amahanga yose; Imana ivyagiye ku ntebe yayo yera y’ubwami.
Abaganwa b’amahanga bakoraniye hamwe nk’abantu b’Imana ya Aburahamu, kuko abami bo mw’isi ari ab’Imana; ni yo ishizwe hejuru cane.

headings.text: Yahawe umukuru w’abaririmvyi. Ni iya bene Kora. Ni Zaburi.

verses.text: Uhoraho arahambaye, abereye gushimwa, mu gisagara c’Imana yacu, ku musozi wayo wera.
Ni mwiza uteye igomwe, utera umunezero isi yose, Umusozi Siyoni ni nk’ubushorishori bwa Zafori, ni wo gisagara c’Umwami ahambaye.
Imana iri mu minara yawo; yiyerekanye ari yo gihome kiwukingira.
Igihe abami baja hamwe, igihe baza kuhatera bose,
barawubonye baratangara; bafashwe n’ubwoba barahunga.
Guhinda agashitsi kwabafatiye aho, bafashwe n’ibise nk’ivy’umugore agira avyare.
Wabasambuye nk’ubwato bw’i Tarushishi busambuwe n’umuyaga uturutse mu buseruko.
Nk’uko twavyumvise, ni ko twabisanze mu gisagara c’ Uhoraho Mushoboravyose, mu gisagara c’Imana yacu: Imana irawukingira ibihe bidashira.
Yewe Mana, turi mu Ngoro yawe, tuzirikana urukundo rwawe rudashira.
Yewe Mana, nk’uko izina ryawe riri, ishimwe ryawe rishika ku mpera z’isi; ukuboko kwawe kw’i buryo kwuzuye ukugororoka.
Umusozi Siyoni uranezerewe, imihana y’i Buyuda irahimbawe kubera amateka yawe.
Nimutembere i Siyoni, muhazunguruke, muharure iminara yaho,
mwihweze neza inzitiro zaho, murabe iminara yaho, kugira ngo muze mubibwire abo mu runganwe ruzoza.
Kuko iyo Mana ari yo Mana yacu ibihe n’ibihe; ni yo izoturongora no gushika kw’iherezo.

headings.text: Ni indirimbo. Ni Zaburi ya bene Kora.

verses.text: Yemwe mahanga mwese, nimwumve ibi; yemwe ababa kuri iyi si mwese, nimwumvirize,
abaciye bugufi n’abashizwe hejuru, baba abatunzi canke abakene:
Akanwa kanje kagira kavuge amajambo y’ubwenge; ukurimbura kw’umutima wanje kuzobaha gutahura.
Ndahindukiriza ugutwi kwanje ku mugani; mu murya w’inanga ndasigura igisokozo.
Ni kuki notinya igihe imisi mibi ije, mu gihe abantu b’ingunge bankikuje;
abizigira ubutunzi bwabo bakirata ibihinda vyabo vyinshi?
Nta n’umwe ashobora gucungura ubugingo bw’uwundi canke ngo abutangire incungu ku Mana;
incungu y’ubuzima bw’umuntu ni iy’igiciro kinini, nta co umuntu yoriha ngo akwize ikiguzi;
kugira ngo barambe ibihe vyose ntibabone ukubora.
Kuko mbona ko umunyabwenge apfa, igipfu n’ikijuju na bo bagahona, bagasigira abandi ubutunzi bwabo.
Imva zabo ni zo zizoba amazu yabo y’ibihe bidashira, aho bazoba ibihe bizokuranwa n’ibindi, naho amatongo yabo bari bayise amazina yabo.
Abantu naho bogira ibihinda, ntibahoraho; bameze nk’ibikoko bipfa gusa.
Iyi ni yo nzira y’abiyizigira, n’ababakurikira, bakunda ivyo bavuga.
Bameze nk’intama kandi bagerewe gupfa; urupfu ni rwo ruzoba umwungere wabo (ariko abatunganye bazobasiribanga mu gitondo). Ubwiza bwabo buzoborera mu mva, kure y’amazu yabo ajererenze.
Ariko Imana izoncungura inkure ahantu h’abapfuye; ni ukuri izonjana iwe.
Ntuze ugire ubwoba abandi nibarushaho gutunga, ubwiza bw’amazu yabo bukaba bwinshi;
kuko ata co bazojana nibapfa, ubwiza bwabo ntibuzojana na bo.
Naho igihe bakiriho biyita abahirwe; kandi bagakomerwa amashi kubera ivyo bashitseko;
bazohamvya ababitangiye imbere, batazosubira kubona umuco w’ubugingo.
Abantu bafise ubutunzi ariko badafise ugutahura bameze nk’ibikoko bipfa.

headings.text: Yahawe umukuru w’abaririmvyi. Ni iya bene Kora. Ni Zaburi.

verses.text: Inyenkomezi, Imana, Uhoraho , aravuze ahamagara abo mw’isi uhereye iyo izuba riserukira ukageza iyo rirengera.
Kuva i Siyoni, h’ubwiza buhebuje, Imana irakayanganye.
Imana yacu iraje kandi ntizocereza; umuriro uratongora imbere yayo, kandi akikijwe n’igihuhusi gihambaye.
Ahamagara amajuru yo hejuru, agahamagara n’isi, kugira ngo acire imanza abantu biwe ati:
“Nimunyegeranirize aba bantu batoranijwe, abo twagiranye isezerano na bo hatanzwe ikimazi.”
Kandi amajuru yamamaza ukugororoka kwiwe, kuko ari Imana ica imanza zibereye.
“Nimwumve, bantu banje, kuko ngira mvuge; nzokwagiriza, ewe Isirayeli: ndi Imana, Imana yawe.
Sinzozana ivyo kukwagiriza bijanye n’ibimazi vyawe canke bijanye n’amashikanwa yawe aturiwe, vyama imbere yanje na ntaryo.
Sinkeneye impfizi zivuye mu mpongore zanyu canke impene zo mu mpongore zanyu,
kuko ibikoko vyose vyo mw’ishamba ari ivyanje, n’amasho yo ku mirambi igihumbi.
Ndazi inyoni zose zo ku misozi, n’udukoko tuguruka two ku misozi ni utwanje.
Nosonza sinobikubwira, kuko isi ari iyanje, n’ibiri muri yo vyose.
Mbega ndarya inyama z’impfizi canke ndanywa amaraso y’impene?
Nimushikanire Imana ikimazi c’ishimwe, mushitse ivyo mwasezeraniye Iyisumbavyose,
maze muze munyambaze mu gihe c’amagorwa; nzobakiza, namwe muzompesha icubahiro.”
Ariko umunyakibi, Imana iramubwira iti: “Wiruhiriza iki uvuga ivyagezwe vyanje canke ucisha isezerano ryanje mu kanwa kawe?
Ko wanka inyigisho zanje ugatera ibitugu amajambo yanje.
Ubonye umusuma wifatanya na we; ugasangira umugabane wawe n’abasambanyi.
Akanwa kawe ugakoresha mu kuvuga ibibi kandi ururimi rwawe ruvuga ivy’ubugunge.
Wicara uvuga nabi umuvukanyi wawe ukararaza mwene nyoko bwite.
Igihe wabikora nanje narihoreye, nawe wibaza ngo turangana. Ariko nzoguhana, ibirego vyanje vyose ndabishire imbere yawe.
Mumenye ibi, yemwe abibagira Imana, kugira ngo sindabatabagure, mutagira gitabara.
Abanshikanira ibimazi vy’ishimwe baba bampesheje icubahiro, kandi abagendera mu bugororotsi nzobereka agakiza kanje.”

headings.text: Ni Zaburi ya Asafu.

verses.text: Ngirira imbabazi, ewe Mana kubera urukundo rwawe rudashira; kubera impuhwe zawe nyinshi nufute ibigabitanyo vyanje.
Nyoza ukugabitanya kwanje kwose unyoze icaha canje.
Kuko ndazi ibigabitanyo vyanje, kandi icaha canje cama imbere yanje
Nacumuye kuri wewe, wewe wenyene, nakoze ibibi mu nyonga hawe; ari na co gituma uvuga ukuri mu manza uca kandi ata co ugawa iyo uciye urubanza.
Ni ukuri navukiye mu vyaha, ndi umunyavyaha kuva mama akinsama inda.
Ariko washatse ko mba umwizigirwa n’igihe nari mu nda; wanyigishije ubwenge nkiri aho hantu hihishije.
Unyogeshe ezobu, nanje ndahumanuka; unyoze, nanje ndera derere kurusha shelegi.
Umpe kwumva umunezero n’agahimbare; amagufa wavunaguye anezerwe.
Hisha inyonga zawe ivyaha vyanje uhanagure ukugabitanya kwanje.
Ureme muri jewe umutima utunganye, ewe Mana, umpe umutima ushikamye.
Ntunyirukane mu nyonga hawe canke ngo unkureko Mpwemu Yera wawe.
Nsubiza umunezero w’agakiza kawe umpe umutima ufise ishaka ryo kukwumvira.
Ni ho nzokwigisha inzira zawe abagucumurako, kugira ngo abanyavyaha baguhindukirire.
Mbohora unkureko urubanza rw’amaraso, ewe Mana, wewe Mana Mukiza wanje, maze ururimi rwanje ruzoririmba ivyo kugororoka kwawe.
Ugurura iminwa yanje, ewe Mana, maze akanwa kanje kazokwamamaza ishimwe ryawe.
Ntuhimbarwa n’ibimazi, iyo biba gutyo mba ndabikuzaniye, amashikanwa aturiwe si yo unezerererwa.
Ikimazi ngushikaniye, Mana, ni umutima umenetse; umutima umenetse kandi ujanjaguritse wewe, Mana, ntuzowukengera.
Nibiguhimbare ugirire neza Siyoni, wubake inzitiro z’i Yerusalemu.
Ni ho uzonezerererwa ibimazi vyo kugororoka, amashikanwa aturiwe atagabanije; n’amapfizi azotangwa ku gicaniro cawe.

headings.text: Yahawe umukuru w’abaririmvyi. Ni Zaburi ya Dawidi. Igihe uwavugishwa n’Imana Natani yaza kuri we inyuma yaho Dawidi asambanye na Batisheba.

verses.text: Ni kuki wirata ikibi, wa muhizi w’inkomezi? Ni kuki wirata bukarinda bwira, wa gatetereza mu nyonga z’Imana?
Wewe ukora ivy’ubugunge, ururimi rwawe ruja inama yo kwica; rumeze nk’urwembe rwakarihijwe.
Ukunda ikibi kukirutisha iciza, ibinyoma ukabirutisha ukuvuga ukuri.
Ukunda ijambo ryose ryo kwonona, ewe wa rurimi rw’ingunge!
Ni ukuri Imana izogushitsako uguhona kw’ibihe bidashira: izoguhonyanga igukwege igukure mw’ihema ryawe; izokurandura igukure mw’isi y’abazima.
Abagororotsi bazobiraba batinye; bazogutwenga, bavuge bati:
“Ehe wa muntu atigeze agira Imana ubuhungiro ariko yishimiye ubutunzi bwiwe bwinshi agashirwa hejuru n’uko yishe abandi!”
Ariko jeho ndi nk’igiti c’umwelayo gishurikira mu nzu y’Imana; nzokwizigira urukundo rw’Imana rudashira ibihe vyose.
Nzokwama ndagushimira ivyo wakoze ndi mu bizigirwa bawe. Kandi nzokwizigira izina ryawe, kuko izina ryawe ari ryiza.

headings.text: Yahawe umukuru w’abaririmvyi. Ni masikili ya Dawidi. Aho Dowegi Umunyedomu yari yagiye kwa Sawuli akamubwira ati: “Dawidi yagiye mu nzu kwa Ahimeleki.”

verses.text: Igipfu cibwira mu mutima kiti: “Nta Mana iriho.” Abantu nk’abo barononekaye, n’inzira zabo ni mbi; nta wukora ivyiza, nta n’umwe.
Imana irunguruka iri mw’ijuru ikitegereza abana b’abantu ngo irabe ko hari n’umwe atahura, ko hari n’umwe arondera Imana.
Bose barazimiye, bose barononekaye; nta wukora ivyiza, eka nta n’umwe.
Mbega abo bantu b’inkozi z’ikibi nta co bazi? Barya abantu banje nk’abarya umutsima; ntibigera bambaza Imana.
Ariko aho nyene ni ho ubwoba bubafatiye, kandi ata kintu na kimwe co kubatera ubwoba. Imana izosanzaza amagufa y’abaguteye; uzobamaramaza, kuko Imana yabakengereye.
Ese icompa agakiza ka Isirayeli kakaza kavuye i Siyoni! Aho Imana izogarukanira abantu bayo; aba Yakobo baze banezerwe kandi Isirayeli ihimbarwe!

headings.text: Yahawe umukuru w’abaririmvyi. Iri mw’ijwi ryitwa mahalati. Ni masikili ya Dawidi.

verses.text: Mana, nunkize ku bw’izina ryawe; ngwanira ku bw’inkomezi zawe.
Mana, niwumve ugusenga kwanje; niwumvirize amajambo y’akanwa kanje.
Abansi bibona baje kuntera; abicanyi bagomba kunyica; abantu batababaye Imana.
Ni ukuri Imana ni yo mutabazi wanje; Uhoraho ni we anshigikira.
Ikibi nigisubire ku bamvuga nabi; mu bwizigirwa bwawe nubasangangure.
Nzogushikanira ikimazi n’umutima ubikunze; nzoshima izina ryawe, Uhoraho , kuko ari ryiza.
Wantabaye mu magorwa yanje yose, kandi amaso yanje yiboneye ukuneshwa kw’abansi banje.

headings.text: Yahawe umukuru w’abaririmvyi bavugira inanga. Ni masikili ya Dawidi. Ni igihe Abanyazifu bari bagiye kwa Sawuli bakavuga bati: “Mbega Dawidi ntiyinyegeje iwacu?”

verses.text: Niwumve ugusenga kwanje, Mana, ntiwirengagize ugutakamba kwanje;
Nunyumve kandi unyishure. Ivyiyumviro vyo muri jewe bimbujije amahoro kandi ncitse intege
kubera ivyo umwansi wanje avuga, kubera ibiteye ubwoba vy’umunyakibi; kuko banteje amarushwa bakaza kuntera buzuye uburake.
Umutima wanje ubuze uburagamo; ibiteye ubwoba vy’urupfu vyanyubikijeko.
Ubwoba no guhinda agashitsi bintaye hagati; nishwe n’ubwoba.
Naravuze nti: “Iyo mba nari mfise amababa y’akanuma Kolombe! Nogurutse nkaja aho kuruhukira.
Nohungiye kure nkigumira mu bugaragwa;
Nokwirukiye mu buhungiro bwanje, kure y’isegenya n’igihuhusi.”
Ewe Mana, maramaza abanyakibi, amajambo yabo anyurane, kuko mbona umuryano n’intambara mu gisagara.
Ku murango no mw’ijoro bazunguruka ku nzitiro zaco; ivyago n’amarushwa biri hagati muri co.
Mu gisagara baricana; ivyago n’amarushwa vyahatse indaro.
Iyo aba ari umwansi ariko arantuka, nari kuvyihanganira; iyo yari kuba ari umwansi wanje ampagurukiye kungwanya, nari kwinyegeza.
Ariko ni wewe, umuntu nkanje, uwo twagendana, umugenzi wanje wo hafi,
uwo twahora dusangira akabisi n’agahiye turi mu nzu y’Imana, uwo twagendana turi hagati y’abasenzi.
Urupfu nirushike giturumbuka ku bansi banje; bagende bakiri bazima iwabo w’abapfuye, kuko bahaye indaro ikibi muri bo.
Ariko jeho, nambaza Imana, maze Uhoraho akankiza.
Ku mugoroba, mu gitondo no ku murango ntakambana agahinda, na we akumva ijwi ryanje.
Arantabara akantahana amahoro ankuye mu ntambara y’abanteye, naho abangwanya bakiri benshi.
Imana, iri ku ntebe y’inganji uhereye kera hose, ni Imana idahindagurika; izobumva maze ibacishe bugufi, kuko badatinya Imana.
Uwahora ari umugenzi wanje ahiga abagenzi biwe; yishe isezerano.
Amajambo yiwe yoroshe nk’amavuta, ariko mu mutima wiwe hari intambara; amajambo yiwe mbere yoroshe kurusha amavuta, ariko ni nk’inkota zakuwe mu rwubati.
Uremeke imitwaro yawe Uhoraho na we azogushigikira; ntazokwigera areka umugororotsi ngo anyiganyizwe.
Ariko wewe Mana, uzotsinda hasi abanyakibi mu cobo co kubora; abasesa amaraso n’ingunge ntibazomara igice c’ubuzima bwabo. Ariko jeho, nzokwizigira.

headings.text: Yahawe umukuru w’abaririmvyi baririmbisha inanga. Ni masikili ya Dawidi.

verses.text: Ngirira imbabazi, Mana yanje, kuko abansi banje bampiga cane; barampiga bukarinda bwira.
Abangwanya barampiga bukarinda bwira; ni benshi bampigana ubwibone bwabo.
Igihe cose ngize ubwoba, ni wewe nizigira.
Nshimira Imana ivyo yasezeranye. Imana ni yo nizigira singire ubwoba. Mbe abantu buntu bongira iki?
Bagoreka amajambo yanje bukarinda bwira; nta kindi barota atari ukunyica.
Bagira inama, bakangenza, bagenzura intambuko zanje, bashaka kunyica.
Kubera ibibi vyabo ntubareke ngo bagende uko; Mana, utsinde hasi amahanga mu burake bwawe.
Ibuka amagorwa yanje; andika amosozi yanje mu gitabu cawe; mbega ntiwayanditse?
Aho ni ho abansi banje bazosubira inyuma ninatabaza. Aho ni ho nzomenyera ko Imana iri mu ruhande rwanje.
Imana, iyo nshimira amajambo yayo, Uhoraho , uwo mpimbaza ijambo ryiwe;
Imana ni yo nizigira maze singire ubwoba. Mbega umuntu yoshobora kungira iki?
Naragusezeraniye Mana yanje; nzogushikanira ikimazi c’ishimwe.
Kuko wantabaye ukankura mu rupfu n’ibirenge vyanje ukabirinda gutsitara, kugira ngo nze ngendere imbere y’Imana mu muco w’ubugingo.
