headings.text: Yahawe umukuru w’abaririmvyi. Iri mw’ijwi ryitwa “Inuma iri ku Kivumu nca kure.” Ni mikitamu ya Dawidi. Ni igihe Abafilisitiya bari bamufatiye i Gati.

verses.text: Ngirira akagongwe, Mana yanje, ngirira akagongwe, kuko muri wewe ari ho mpungiye. Nzohungira mu gitutu c’amababa yawe kugeza icago kirenganye.
Ndatakambira Imana Musumbavyose, Imana izoshitsa imigambi yayo myiza kuri jewe.
Izondungikira ugutabarwa kuva mw’ijuru maze inkize, ineshe abampigana ishavu; Imana izorungika urukundo rwayo n’ukwizigirwa kwayo.
Ndi hagati y’intambwe; hagati y’ibikoko vy’inkazi; abantu bafise amenyo ameze nk’amacumu n’imyampi, indimi zabo zikamera nk’inkota zikarishe.
Nushirwe hejuru, ewe Mana, hejuru y’amajuru; icubahiro cawe gikwire kw’isi yose.
Bateze umutego mu nzira ncamwo; nciwe intege n’akabonge. Banyimbiye icobo mu nzira yanje; ariko ni bo bakiguyemwo ubwabo.
Umutima wanje urashikamye, ewe Mana, umutima wanje urashikamye; nzoririmba ncurarange.
Mutima wanje, niwikangure! Ewe nanga nawe kembe, nimwikangure! Nzovyura umutwenzi.
Ewe Mana, nzoguhimbaza mu moko menshi; nzokuririmba ndi mu mahanga.
Kuko urukundo rwawe ari rwinshi, rushika no mu majuru; ubwizigirwa bwawe bushika no mu birere.
Nushirwe hejuru, Ewe Mana, hejuru y’amajuru; icubahiro cawe gikwire kw’isi yose.

headings.text: Yahawe umukuru w’abaririmvyi. Mw’ijwi ryitwa “Ntuhonye.” Ni mikitani ya Dawidi. Aho yari aheje guhunga Sawuli akaja mw’isenga.

verses.text: Mbega batware muvuga ivy’ukuri koko? Mbega mucira abantu imanza mudahengamye?
Oya, mu mitima yanyu mutumbereye ikibi, kandi amaboko yanyu yakoze ivy’umuryano kw’isi.
No kuva bakivuka abanyakibi barazimiye; kuva mu nda za ba nyina babandanije inzira zabo zo kubesha.
Ubumara bwabo ni nk’ubumara bw’inzoka, ni nk’ubwo incira itumva yizivye amatwi,
itumva amajwi y’uwuyigunda, naho yoba ari umuhinga yabimogoreye gute.
Vunagura amenyo yo mu kanwa kabo, ewe Mana; Uhoraho , menagura imibangabanga y’izo ntambwe!
Nibakamangane nk’amazi asheshwe kw’isi igadutse; nibafora umuheto, imyampi yabo ntishike kure.
Nibabe nk’igifyera kigenda kirayonga, nk’inda ikorotse itigeze ibona izuba.
Imbere y’uko inkono zanyu zumva ubushuhe bw’amahwa yaka; yaba ay’umye canke mabisi; abanyakibi bazogurukanwa n’igihuhusi.
Abagororotsi bazonezerwa niwabahora, nibadibika ibirenge vyabo mu maraso y’abanyakibi.
Abantu bazovuga bati: “Ni ukuri abagororotsi bahawe ingero; ni ukuri hari Imana icira amateka isi.”

headings.text: Yahawe umukuru w’abaririmvyi. Mw’ijwi ryitwa “Ntuhonye.” Ni mikitamu ya Dawidi.

verses.text: Nkiza abansi banje, Mana; mbera igihome kinkingira abaje kuntera.
Nkiza inkozi z’ikibi ukize ubugingo bwanje abarondera gusesa amaraso yanje.
Raba uburyo bambundiye! Abantu b’ibirara bangira inama mbi kandi ata gicumuro canke icaha nakoze, Uhoraho .
Nta kibi nakoze, ariko raba baje kuntera. Va hasi untabare; raba ibiriko biraba!
Yewe Uhoraho Mana Mushoboravyose, wewe Mana ya Isirayeli, banguka uhane amahanga yose; ntugirire impuhwe izo nkozi z’ikibi.
Bagaruka bugorovye, bakuga nk’imbwa, bakazunguruka igisagara.
Raba ibiva mu kanwa kabo; amajambo ava mu minwa yabo ikarishe nk’inkota, maze bakiyumvira bati: “Ni nde atwumva?”
Ariko uzobatwengera mw’ijigo, Uhoraho ; uzokankamira ayo mahanga yose.
Ni wewe nkomezi zanje, ni wewe niteze; wewe, Mana, ni wewe gihome kinkingira,
Imana yanje nizigira. Imana izonja imbere izompa kwibonera uburyo abansi banje baneshwa.
Ariko ntubice, ewe Mana, wewe nkinzo yacu, kugira ngo ihanga ryanje ntiryibagire. Mu nkomezi zawe, barandurane n’imizi maze ubatsinde hasi.
Kubera ivyaha vy’akanwa kabo, kubera amajambo y’iminwa yabo, nibafatwe mu bwibone bwabo. Kubera ibitutsi n’ibinyoma bateguye,
batongoze uburake bwawe, ubatongore ntibabe bakiboneka. Ni ho bizomenyekana gushika ku mpera z’isi ko Imana iganje mu ba Yakobo.
Bagaruka bugorovye, bakuga nk’imbwa, bakazunguruka igisagara.
Bahunahuna barondera ico borya bakaboroga iyo badahaze.
Ariko jewe nzoririmba ivy’inkomezi zawe, mu gitondo nzoririmba ivy’urukundo rwawe; kuko uri igihome kinkingira, ubuhungiro bwanje mu gihe c’amagorwa.
Ni wewe nkomezi zanje, ndakuririmbira ishimwe; Mana, wewe uri igihome kinkingira, Imana yanje nizigira.

headings.text: Yahawe umukuru w’abaririmvyi. Iri mw’ijwi ryitwa “Ntuhonye.” Ni mikitamu. Ni igihe Sawuli yari yarungitse ingabo ngo babunde ku nzu ya Dawidi kugira ngo bamwice.

verses.text: Mana, waradutaye, kandi waduciyemwo imigwi; waraturakiye; none ubu nutugarukane!
Wanyiganyije igihugu ugisiga ari umusaka; none rero zibira ibihengeri vyaco, kuko kiriko kirazungazunga.
Weretse abantu bawe ibihe bigoye; watunywesheje umuvinyu utuma tudandabagirana.
Ariko ku bakwubaha, wabadugirije ibendera nk’ikimenyetso ngo bahunge imyampi y’ababateye.
Dutabarishe ukuboko kwawe kw’i buryo, kandi utwishure; kugira ngo abo ukunda bakire.
Imana yavugiye ahera hayo iti: “Mu kunesha kwanje nzogaburamwo ibice Shekemu, kandi nzogeresha umugozi ikiyaya c’i Sukoti;
Gileyadi ni uwanje, kandi Manase ni uwanje; Efurayimu ni we nkofero yanje, Yuda ni icumu ryanje ry’ubugabe.
Mowabu ni ibesani niyogeramwo, kuri Edomu ni ho nkunkumurira ibirato vyanje; Kuri Filisitiya ni ho nivugira amazina yo kunesha.”
Ni nde azonshikana mu gisagara gikikujwe inzitiro? Ni nde azondongora gushika kuri Edomu?
Mbega si wewe ga Mana wadutaye, ntube ukijana n’ingabo zacu ku rugamba?
Dufashe kugwanya umwansi, kuko ugutabara kw’abantu ata co kumaze.
Turi kumwe n’Imana tuzonesha intambara, kandi izosiribanga abansi bacu.

headings.text: Yahawe umukuru w’abaririmyi. Mw’ijwi ryitwa “Ishurwe ry’Isezerano.” Ni Mikitamu ya Dawidi. Ni iyo kwigisha. Yayanditse igihe yagwana na Aramu-Naharayimu hamwe na Aramu-Zoba, Yowabu na we avuye gutikiriza ibihumbi cumi na bibiri vy’Abanyedomu Kiyaya c’Umunyu.

verses.text: Niwumve ukurira kwanje; umva ugusenga kwanje.
Ndagutakambira ndi ku mpera z’isi, ndagutabaza kuko umutima wanje unkabiraniyemwo; undongorere ku gitandara kirekire kinsumba.
Wamye uri ubuhungiro bwanje, umunara ukomeye unkingira abansi.
Ndipfuza kuba mw’ihema ryawe ibihe vyose ngahungira mu bwihisho bw’amababa yawe.
Kuko wewe, Mana, wumvise ivyo narahiye; wampaye umugabane w’abubaha izina ryawe.
Gwiza imisi yo kubaho kw’umwami, imyaka yiwe uko urunganwe rukurikirana n’urundi.
Niyimikirwe mu nyonga z’Imana ibihe vyose; utume urukundo rwawe n’ubwizigirwa bwawe ngo bimuzigame.
Maze nanje nzoririmba ishimwe ry’izina ryawe nshitse n’ivyo narahiye umusi ku wundi.

headings.text: Yahawe umukuru w’abaririmvyi. Bavugira inanga. Ni iya Dawidi.

verses.text: Ni ukuri umutima wanje uruhukira mu Mana; agakiza kanje kava kuri yo.
Ni ukuri ni yo gitandara canje n’agakiza kanje: ni yo gihome kinkingira, sinzokwigera nyiganyizwa.
Muzogeza hehe kuntera? Mbega mwese mugomba kuntsinda hasi; nk’urusika ruhengamye, canke uruhome ruhomvokeye hasi?
Ni ukuri bagira inama yo kuntembagaza ngo bankure ku ntebe yanje iri hejuru, bahimbarwa n’ibinyoma. Bahezagirisha akanwa kabo, ariko mu mitima yabo bakavuma.
Ego cane, mutima wanje, ruhukira mu Mana; ivyizigiro vyanje biva kuri yo.
Ni ukuri ni we gitandara canje n’agakiza kanje; ni we gihome kinkingira, sinzonyiganyizwa.
Agakiza kanje n’icubahiro canje kiva ku Mana; ni we gitandara canje gikomeye, ni ubuhungiro bwanje.
Muze muhore mu mwizigira ibihe vyose, yemwe bantu; mumugaragarize imitima yanyu, kuko Imana ari yo buhungiro bwacu.
Ni ukuri abantu bose ni nk’impwemu zihumetswe gusa, abakuru n’abato ni ubusa gusa. Iyo bagezwe ku munzane, basangwa ari ubusa; bose hamwe ni impwemu zihumetswe gusa.
Ntimwishimire uguhahaza canke ngo ivyizigiro vyanyu mubishire ku vyasahuwe; naho ubutunzi bwanyu bwokongerekana, ntimubushireko umutima.
Imana yavuze kimwe, nanje numva bibiri: Ubushobozi ni ubwawe, Mana,
kandi urukundo rudashira, ewe Mana, ruri kumwe nawe; kandi, ugerera umuntu wese ibikwiranye n’ivyo yakoze.

headings.text: Yahawe umukuru w’abaririmvyi. Yahawe kandi Yedutuni. Ni Zaburi ya Dawidi.

verses.text: Mana, ni wewe Mana yanje, ndakuronderana umwete; ndakunyotewe, ibiri muri jewe vyose birakwipfuza, ndi mu gihugu cumye kigadutse kitagira amazi.
Narakubonye uri ahera nitegereza ubwiza bwawe n’ubushobozi bwawe.
Kuko urukundo rwawe ari rwiza kurusha ubugingo, iminwa yanje izogushima.
Nzogutazira nkiriho, nzotarika amaboko yawe mw’izina ryawe.
Umutima wanje uzohazwa nk’uwariye ivyokurya biryoshe kurusha ibindi vyose; akanwa kanje kazoguhimbaza iminwa yanje ikuririmbire.
Ndyamye ku buriri bwanje ndakwibuka; ndakwiyumvira iyo nteramye mw’ijoro.
Kuko uri umutabazi wanje, ndaririmbira musi y’igitutu c’amababa yawe.
Nzokwumirako; ukuboko kwawe kw’i buryo kuranseguye.
Abagomba kunyica bazohona; bazomanuka baja i kuzimu.
Bazokwicishwa inkota bahinduke inyama z’imbwebwe.
Ariko umwami azonezererwa mu Mana; uwirahira mw’izina ry’Imana azohimbarirwa muri we, ariko akanwa k’ababeshi kazozibwa.

headings.text: Ni Zaburi ya Dawidi. Yayirorimvye igihe yari mu bugaragwa bw’i Buyuda.

verses.text: Mana yanje, urumva ijwi ryanje ninagutakambira; ukingire ubuzima bwanje kuko umwansi anteye ubwoba.
Mpisha unkize inama z’abanyakibi, unkize imigabo mibi y’inkozi z’ikibi.
Bakarisha indimi zabo nk’inkota batumbereza amajambo yabo mabi nk’imyampi yica.
Barasa uwutagira icaha bamwibundiye; bamutera atiteguye, badatinya.
Baterana intege mu migambi yabo mibi, bakavugana ivy’imitego yo mu mpisho; bakavuga bati: “Ni nde abibona?”
Baja inama zo kurenganya abandi bakavuga bati: “Twagize umugambi mwiza!” Ni ukuri umutima w’umuntu uri n’ubugunge.
Ariko Imana izobarasisha imyampi yayo; bazokubitwa hasi giturumbuka.
Azobasubiza ku mitwe amajambo yabo mabi abashitseko uguhona; abazobabona bose bazobazunguriza imitwe babacokora.
Abantu bose bazotinya; bazokwamamaza ibikorwa vy’Imana batahure ivyo yakoze.
Umugororotsi azonezererwa Uhoraho amuhungireko; abatunganye mu mitima bose bazomunezerererwa!

headings.text: Yahawe umukuru w’abaririmvyi. Ni Zaburi ya Dawidi.

verses.text: Mana yacu, ubereye amashimwe uri i Siyoni; tuzoshitsa ivyo twagusezeraniye.
Wewe wishura amasengesho, abantu bose bazoza kuri wewe.
Aho twari turengewe n’ivyaha vyacu, waduhariye ibigabitanyo vyacu.
Hahiriwe abantu utoranya ukabiyegereza ngo babe mu rugo rw’Ingoro yawe. Duhagijwe n’ivyiza vyo mu nzu yawe, vyo mu Ngoro yawe yera.
Utwirura mu bikorwa biteye ubwoba vyo kugororoka, Mana Mukiza wacu, wewe vyizigiro vyo ku mpera z’isi zose n’ivy’ibiyaga vya kure,
waremesheje imisozi ubushobozi bwawe, wambaye inkomezi,
wewe wahojeje ukubomborana kw’ibiyaga, ugusuriranya kw’imipfunda yavyo, n’urwamo rw’amahanga.
Isi yose irahinda agashitsi kubera ibitangaza vyawe; bituma umutwenzi utambika, ahandi bukira, ugahamagara indirimbo z’umunezero.
Witwararika isi ukayivomerera; ukayuzuzamwo ubutunzi bwinshi. Imigezi y’Imana yuzuye amazi ngo uhe abantu ivyimburwa vy’ibinyantete, kuko ariko wabitegetse.
Wuzuza imivo yayo ukamenagura ibinonko; uyibombekesha imvura ugaha umugisha ivyimburwa vyayo.
Umwaka uwambika urugori ukoresheje ivyimburwa, aho uciye haba ubutunzi bwinshi.
Imisozi yumye yo mu bugaragwa yambaye ivyimburwa; uturambi watwambitse umunezero.
Imirambi yuzuyeko imikuku n’ibiyaya vyuzuyemwo ingano; bivuza impundu y’umunezero bikaririmba.

headings.text: Yahawe umukuru w’abaririmvyi. Ni Zaburi ya Dawidi. Ni indirimbo.

verses.text: Yemwe abari kw’isi yose, nimuvugirize Imana impundu!
Muririmbe muhayagiza ubwiza bw’izina ryiwe; mumuririmbire ishimwe.
Mubwire Imana muti: “Ese ukuntu ibikorwa vyawe biteye ubwoba! Ubushobozi bwawe ni bwinshi butuma abansi bawe bakwunamira.
Isi yose irakwunamira; bakuririmbira ishimwe, bahimbaza izina ryawe.”
Nimuze murabe ivyo Imana yakoze, ibihambaye yakoreye abana b’abantu!
Ikiyaga yagihinduye isi humye, baciye mu kiyaga n’amaguru; nimuze tunezererwe muri we.
Aganza ibihe bidashira mu nkomezi ziwe, inyonga ziwe zihora ku mahanga; ntihagire abagarariji bahagurukira kumugwanya.
Yemwe moko mwese, nimuhimbaze Imana yacu, ijwi ryo kumuhimbaza nirisamirane;
yazigamye ubugingo bwacu yarinze ibirenge vyacu kunyerera.
Kuko wewe, Mana, wadusuzumye; waducishije mu ruganda nk’ifeza.
Wadushize mw’ibohero uduhekereza imitwaro ku migongo yacu.
Waretse abantu ngo batugendereko; twaciye mu muriro no mu mazi, ariko wadushikanye ahantu h’umusesekara.
Nzoza mu Ngoro yawe nzanye ibimazi vyo guturirwa n’umuriro, kugira ngo nshitse ivyo nagusezeraniye;
amasezerano nasezeranishije akanwa kanje iminwa yanje ikabivuga ca gihe nari mu vyago.
Nzogushikanira ibinuze n’ikimazi c’impfizi z’intama; nzoshikana impfizi n’impene.
Nimuze mwumvirize, yemwe abubaha Imana mwese; reka ndababwire ivyo yankoreye.
Narayitakambiye n’akanwa kanje; ishimwe ryayo ryari ku rurimi rwanje.
Iyo mba narahaye indaro icaha mu mutima wanje, Imana ntiba yaranyumvirije.
Ariko ni ukuri Imana yarumvirije maze yumva ugusenga kwanje.
Imana ishimwe, itirengagije ugusenga kwanje canke ngo inkureko urukundo rwayo!

headings.text: Yahawe umukuru w’abaririmvyi. Ni indirimbo kandi ni Zaburi.

verses.text: Ese Imana, yotugirira ubuntu ikaduhezagira, mu nyonga hayo tukaboneka dufise igikundiro;
kugira ngo inzira zawe zimenyekane kw’isi, n’agakiza kawe kamenyekane mu mahanga yose.
Amoko naguhimbaze, ewe Mana; amoko yose naguhimbaze.
Ese amahanga yose yonezerwa akavuza impundu z’umunezero, kuko urongora abantu bose mu bugororotsi ukarongora amahanga yose yo kw’isi.
Amoko naguhimbaze, ewe Mana; amoko yose naguhimbaze.
Isi yimbuka ivyimburwa vyayo; ewe Mana, Mana yacu, duhe umugisha.
Ese Imana yoduha umugisha, kugira ngo abo ku mpera z’isi bose baze bayubahe.

headings.text: Yahawe umukuru w’abaririmvyi. Icurarangishwa ibicurarangisho vy’imirya. Ni Zaburi, kandi ni indirimbo.

verses.text: Imana nihaguruke, abansi bayo bose basanzare; abayanka bose nibahunge mu nyonga hayo.
Ese wobatumurira kure nk’umwotsi; nk’uko ishashara rishonga imbere y’umuriro, ese abanyakibi bohonera imbere y’Imana.
Ariko ese abagororotsi bohimbarwa bakanezerererwa imbere y’Imana; ese bonezerwa bakuzura akamwemwe.
Nimuririmbire Imana, nimuririmbe mushima izina ryiwe, mutegure inzira y’uwugendera ku bicu; nimunezererwe imbere yiwe; izina ryiwe yitwa Uhoraho .
Ni we se w’impfuvyi, uwutabara abapfakazi, ni Imana iba ahera hayo.
Imana ishira inyakamwe mu miryango, isohora imbohe zikaririmba; ariko abagarariji bazoba ahagadutse.
Ewe Mana, igihe waja imbere y’ubwoko bwawe, igihe wagendagenda mu bugaragwa,
isi yaranyiganyize, amajuru arekura imvura, imbere y’Imana, Imana y’i Sinayi, imbere y’Imana, Imana ya Isirayeli.
Watanze imvura nyinshi, ewe Mana; wasubijemwo inkomezi umugabane wawe.
Ubwoko bwawe bwahagize aho kuba, mu kugira neza kwawe, ewe Mana, wagaburiye abakene.
Imana yatanze ijambo, abagore baryamamaza na bo bacika ingabo zikomeye:
Abami n’ingabo barahunze; abagore bibereye i muhira bagabura iminyago.
Mbere n’abiryamiye mu mpongore z’intama baronka ubwatsi, amababa y’inuma yanje asizwe ifeza, amoya yayo na yo asize inzahabu ikayangana.
Igihe Iyishoboravyose yirukana abami mu gihugu, vyari bimeze nka shelegi yaguye ku musozi Zalumoni.
Musozi Bashani, musozi w’ubwiza, Musozi Bashani, musozi w’udutwe twinshi,
ni kuki, ewe musozi w’udutwe twinshi, ugirira ishari umusozi Imana yatoranije ngo ivyagireko, aho Uhoraho ubwiwe azokwibera ibihe vyose?
Imikogote y’Imana ni ibihumbi bidaharurika, n’ibihumbi n’ibihumbi; Uhoraho aturutse i Sinayi aje ahera hiwe.
Aho waduga iyo hejuru, wajanye iminyago myinshi; wakiriye impano nyinshi mu bantu, no mu bagarariji; kugira ngo uhibere, wewe Uhoraho Mana.
Uhoraho ahimbazwe, Imana yo Mukiza wacu, atwikorerera imitwaro uko bukeye.
Imana yacu ni Imana ikiza; Uhoraho Nyeninganji ni we adukiza urupfu.
Ni ukuri Imana izomenagura imitwe y’abansi bayo, hamwe n’ibitsibo vy’umushatsi vy’abashishikara gukora ivyaha.
Imana iravuze iti: “Nzobazana ndabakuye i Bashani; nzobazana ndabakuye mw’idamba ry’ikiyaga,
kugira ngo ibirenge vyanyu bihonyore mu maraso y’abansi banyu, mu gihe indimi z’imbwa zanyu zizoronka umugabane wazo.”
Turabona abakugendaniye, ewe Mana, abagendaniye Imana yanje, Umwami wanje binjiye ahera hiwe.
Imbere hari abaririmvyi, bakurikiwe n’abacuraranzi; bari kumwe n’abigeme bavuza utugoma dutoduto.
Himbaza Imana muri mw’ikoraniro rinini; mutazire Uhoraho muri mw’ikoraniro rya Isirayeli.
Ehe umuryango mutoya wa Benyamini, ni wo ubarongoye, abaganwa ba Yuda n’ingabo zabo, n’abaganwa ba Zebuloni na Nafutali.
Hamagara ubushobozi bwawe, Mana; utwereke inkomezi zawe, Mana yacu, nk’uko wabikoze kera.
Abami bazokuzanira ingabire mu Ngoro yawe i Yerusalemu.
Kankamira ibikoko vyo mu marenga, amapfizi yo mu masho y’amahanga. Nibicishwe bugufi maze bizane imirava y’ifeza yo guhonga. Sanzaza amahanga anezerererwa intambara.
Intumwa zizoza zivuye muri Egiputa; I Kushi hazoca bugufi imbere y’Imana.
Nimuririmbire Imana, yemwe bwami bwo mw’isi, nimutazire Uhoraho,
uwugendera ahasuma ijuru, uwuganza amajuru, uwuturagara n’ijwi ry’inkomezi.
Nimumenyekanishe ubushobozi bw’Imana, igitinyiro ciwe kiri kuri Isirayeli, ubushobozi bwiwe buri mw’ijuru.
Ewe Mana, uteye ubwoba uri ahera hawe; Imana ya Isirayeli ni yo iha inkomezi abantu bayo. Imana ishimwe!

headings.text: Yahawe umukuru w’abaririmvyi. Ni iya Dawidi. Ni Zaburi, kandi ni indirimbo.

verses.text: Mana, nkiza, kuko amazi yaduze angeze mw’izosi.
Ndiko ndanyika mu kinogo cuzuye ivyondo, ata kinsama. Nshitse mw’idamba ry’amazi; imipfunda irantembanye.
Intege ziramperanye kubera gutabaza; umuhogo wanje urumye. Amaso yanje arenze i mutwe, mu kurindira Imana yanje.
Abanyanka ata nyanduruko baruta umushatsi wo ku mutwe wanje; benshi banyanka ata nyanduruko, kandi bashaka kunyica. Nategetswe kuriha ivyo ntivye.
Mana, wewe urazi ubupfu bwanje; ukugabitanya kwanje ntiguhishijwe mu nyonga zawe.
Uhoraho, Uhoraho Mushoboravyose, abakwizigira ntibamaramare kubera jewe. Mana ya Isirayeli, icompa abakurondera ntibamaramare kubera jewe.
Kuko ncokorwa ku bwawe, kandi ibimaramare vyuzuye mu maso yanje.
Nabaye umunyamahanga mu muryango wanje, injabuka mu bana ba mama;
kuko ishaka mfitiye inzu yawe ryaka muri jewe nk’umuriro, kandi ibitutsi vy’abagutuka vyaguye kuri jewe.
Iyo nisonzesheje nkarira, bituma ncokorwa;
iyo nambaye amagunira, mba ndabihaye ngo bitwengere.
Abicara kw’irembo barantwenga, kandi ndi indirimbo y’imborerwa.
Ariko ni wewe nsenga, Uhoraho , mu gihe co kwemererwamwo nawe; mu rukundo rwawe rudashira, ewe Mana, unyishurishe agakiza kawe k’ukuri.
Ntabara unkure mu vyondo, ntundeke ngo nyike; nkiza abanyanka, unkure mw’ibenga
ntureke ngo imipfunda indengere canke ngo idamba rimire miyonzwa canke ngo icobo kimire nkibona.
Nyishura, Uhoraho , ku bwo kugira neza kw’urukundo rwawe; mu rukundo rwawe rwinshi unyibuke.
Ntuhishe inyonga zawe umusavyi wawe; unyishure vuba, kuko ndi mu magorwa.
Nuze hano untabare; untabare ku bwo abampiga.
Urazi uburyo ncokorwa, ngateterezwa kandi nkamaramazwa; abansi banje bose bari imbere yawe.
Ugucokorwa kwavunye umutima wanje kandi kwansize ntagira gitabara; narondeye uwombabara, ariko nta n’umwe nabonye, narondeye abandemesha, ariko sinaronse n’umwe.
Basize ishano mu ndya zanje kandi bampaye inkarisha igihe nari nyotewe.
Ese imeza bashizwe imbere zobabera umutego; n’ubutunzi bwabo bukababera ikinogo co kugwamwo.
Reka amaso yabo ahume ntibashobore kubona, n’imigongo yabo yame ihetamye ibihe vyose.
Uburake bwawe nibubaziriringire; uburake bwawe bw’inkazi nibubashikeko.
Aho bahora nihasigare ari umusaka; ntihagire n’umwe aba mu mahema yabo.
Kuko bababaje abo wewe wakomerekeje bongereza umubabaro ku bo wababaje.
Bacire urubanza ku bibi vyose bakoze; ntibagire ico baronka kivuye ku kugororoka kawe.
Bahanagurwe mu gitabu c’ubugingo ntibashirwe mu gitigiri c’abagororotsi.
Ariko jeho, umugorwa ndi mu marushwa; agakiza kawe, ewe Mana kankingire.
Nzohimbaza izina ry’Imana mu ndirimbo ndamuhe icubahiro mu mashimwe.
Ivyo bizohimbara Uhoraho kurusha ishuri, kurusha impfizi n’amahembe yayo n’ibinono vyayo.
Abakene bazobibona banezerwe; yemwe abarondera Imana, imitima yanyu nireme!
Uhoraho yumva abakene kandi ntakengera abantu biwe babaye inyagano.
Ijuru n’isi nibimuhimbaze, n’ibiyaga n’ibiri muri vyo vyose,
kuko Imana izokiza Siyoni kandi izosubira kwubaka ibisagara vy’i Buyuda. Maze abantu bazosubira kuhaba habegukire;
abana b’abasavyi bayo bazohegukira, kandi abakunda izina ryayo bazohaba.

headings.text: Yahawe umukuru w’abaririmvyi. Mw’ijwi ryitwa “Ikirungu.” Ni iya Dawidi.

verses.text: Mana, tebuka unkize; Uhoraho , tebuka untabare.
Abagomba kunyica nibamaramare bakorwe n’isoni; abipfuza ko nohona bose nibasubizwe inyuma bateterewe.
Abambwira bati: “Aha! Aha!” basubire inyuma kubwo kumaramara.
Ariko abakurondera bose nibanezerwe bahimbarirwe muri wewe; abipfuza ugutabarwa kwawe bame bavuga bati: “Imana irahambaye!”
Ariko jeho ndi umworo, kandi ndi umukene; nuze aho ndi vuba, ewe Mana. Ni wewe mutabazi wanje n’umurokozi wanje; Uhoraho we, ntutebe.

headings.text: Yahawe umukuru w’abaririmvyi. Ni iya Dawidi. Ni ukwinginga.

verses.text: Muri wewe, Uhoraho , ni ho mpungiye; sinze nigere maramara.
Untabare undokore, ku bw’ukugororoka kwawe; ntega ugutwi maze unkize.
Umbere igitandara mpungiramwo, aho nama nirukira imisi yose. Tegeka ntabarwe, kuko ari wewe gitandara canje n’igihome kinkingira.
Mana yanje, undokore mu maboko y’abanyakibi, unkize ububasha bw’abantu babi b’ibirara.
Kuko uri ivyizigiro vyanje, Uhoraho Nyeninganji, ni wewe nizigira kuva nkiri muto.
Kuva nkivuka namye nisunga wewe; wankuye mu nda ya mama. Nzokwama ndaguhimbaza.
Nabaye akabarore kuri benshi; ni wewe buhungiro bwanje buhambaye.
Akanwa kanje kuzuye ishimwe ryawe, kavuga ubwiza bwawe bukarinda bwira.
Ntunshiburire kure mu gihe c’ubusaza bwanje; ntumpebe mu gihe ncitse intege.
Kuko abansi banje bangira inama mbi; abambundiye baja imigabo yo kunyica.
Baravuga bati: “Imana yamuhevye; mukurikire kugeza mumufashe, kuko ata wo kumutabara.”
Ntumbe kure, Mana yanje; tebuka, Mana, untabare.
Abanyagiriza nibahone bicwe n’ibimaramare; abagomba kunyica bambare ugucokorwa n’ibiteterwe.
Ariko jeho, nzokwamana ivyizigiro; nzogushima ubudahengeshanya.
Akanwa kanje kazovuga ibikorwa vyawe vyo kugororoka, mvuge ivyo gukiza wakoze burinde bwira; naho ntashobora kubivuga vyose.
Nzoza menyekanishe ivyo wakoze bihambaye; Uhoraho Nyeninganji, nzokwamamaza ivy’ukugororoka wakoze, wewe wenyene.
Kuva mu buto bwanje, Mana, waranyigishije, kugeza uwu musi ndacamenyekanisha ibihambaye wakoze.
No mu gihe c’ubusaza bwanje maze kumera imvi, ntuze umpebe, Mana yanje, kugeza menyesheje ubushobozi bwawe abo mu runganwe ruzoza, ibikorwa vy’inkomezi wakoze kubazovuka hanyuma.
Ukugororoka kwawe, ewe Mana, gushika mw’ijuru, wewe wakoze ibihambaye. Ni nde ameze nka we, Mana?
Naho wandetse ngo mbone amarushwa, menshi kandi arura, uzosubira kunsubizamwo intege; uzonkura i bwina mw’isi wongere ungarukane hejuru.
Uzokwongereza icubahiro canje wongere kundemesha.
Nzogushimisha inanga kubera ukwizigirwa kwawe, Mana yanje; nzogushimisha ikembe, Ewe Uwera wa Isirayeli.
Iminwa yanje izosemerera ku bw’umunezero aho nzoguhimbariza; jewe uwo warokoye.
Ururimi rwanje ruzovuga ibikorwa vyawe vyo kugororoka burinde bwira, kuko abagomba kungirira nabi bamaramaye bakicwa n’isoni.
Igisha umwami guca imanza zibereye, ewe Mana, igisha umwana w’umwami ivyo kugororoka kwawe.
Ese yocira imanza abantu bawe mu bugororotsi, abanyamibabaro bo mu bantu bawe akabatunganiriza.
Ese imisozi yozanira abantu bawe iterambere, n’udutumba tukazana ivyamwa vyo kugororoka.
Ese yogwanirira abanyamibabaro bo mu bantu agakiza abana b’umukene; akamara inkomezi umunyagahahazo.
Ese yohoraho igihe cose izuba rizoba rikiriho, igihe cose ukwezi kuzoba kukiriho uko urunganwe ruzogenda rukurakuranwa.
Ese yomera nk’imvura igwa kw’isi yumye, nk’imvura itosa isi.
Mu misi yiwe, ese abagororotsi boshurika n’iterambere rikagwira gushika ukwezi kutakiriho.
Ese yoganza kuva ku kiyaga gushika ku kindi no kuva ku ruzi Efurate gushika ku mpera z’isi.
Ese amoko aba mu bugaragwa yomwunamira abansi biwe bakarigata umukungugu.
Ese abami b’i Tarushishi n’abo ku bizinga vya kure bomuzanira ivyo gusaba impore. Ese abami b’i Sheba n’i Seba bomuzanira ingabire.
Ese abami bose bomwunamira kandi amahanga yose amukorera.
Kuko azokiza umukene amutakambiye, n’umunyamibabaro atagira gitabara.
Azogirira akagongwe umukene n’umunyantegenke akize umukene amukure mu rupfu.
Azobatabara abakure mu gahahazo no mu muryano, kuko amaraso yabo ari ay’igiciro mu nyonga ziwe.
Arakaramba! Ahabwe inzahabu z’i Sheba. Abantu bame bamusengera bamuhezagira burinde bwira.
Ese ingano zogwira mu gihugu cose; umuyange wazo ugahungabana ku dutwe tw’imisozi. Ese ibiti vy’ivyamwa vyoshurika nk’i Libani n’abantu mu bisagara bagatotahara nk’ivyatsi ku misozi.
Ese izina ryiwe ryokwamaho ibihe bidashira; rikamaho izuba rikiriho. Maze amahanga yose agahererwa umugisha muri we, kandi bazomwita uwahawe umugisha.
Nihashimwe Uhoraho Imana, Imana ya Isirayeli, ni we wenyene akora ibitangaza.
Nihashimwe izina ryiwe ry’icubahiro ibihe bidashira; ese isi yose yokwuzura icubahiro ciwe. Amen kandi Amen.
Aya ni yo majambo arangiza amasengesho ya Dawidi mwene Isayi.

headings.text: Ni iya Salomo.

verses.text: Ni ukuri Imana ni nziza kuri Isirayeli, ku bafise imitima itanduye.
Ariko jeho, ibirenge vyanje hari hasigaye gatoya bikanyerera; hari habuze gatoya ngatemba.
Kuko nagirira ishari abibone aho nabona abanyakibi baguwe neza.
Bibereyeho nk’abatagira ingorane; bafise amagara meza kandi barakomeye.
Imibabaro abandi bacamwo bobo ntibashikako; ntibashikirwa n’ivyago nk’abandi.
Ni co gituma ubwishime babwambaye mw’izosi nk’umugufu; umuryano bakawambara nk’impuzu.
Mu mitima yabo mibi havamwo ibigabitanyo, imigabo yabo mibi ntigira iherezo.
Baracokorana, bakavuga ivy’agahahazo; bavugana ubwibone amajambo y’agacinyizo.
Akanwa kabo kavuga nabi ivy’ijuru, indimi zabo zikihayagiza mw’isi.
Ni co gituma abantu babahindukirira bakiranguza amajambo yabo nk’uwunywa amazi.
Baravuga bati: “Imana yobimenya gute? Mbega Iyisumbavyose hari ico izi?”
Uko ni ko abanyakibi bameze; bama baguwe neza, biyegeraniriza ubutunzi.
Ni ukuri nta co nungutse mu kwirinda kwanduza umutima wanje amaboko yanje agakaraba mu kudacumura.
Narababaye burinda bwira, kandi igitondo cose kikanzanira imibabaro.
Iyo mba naravuze ntyo, mba narabaye umuguranyi w’abana bawe.
Igihe nagerageza gutahura ivyo vyose, vyarambabaje cane
gushika aho ninjiye ahera h’Imana; maze ntahura iherezo ryabo rya nyuma.
Ni ukuri, ubashira ahantu hanyerera; ubakororera mu mahonero.
Bahona mu kanya isase, bakurwaho rwose bishwe n’ubwoba.
Bameze kurya kw’inzozi iyo umuntu yikanguye; aho uzovira hasi, ewe Mana, uzobatwenga nk’uko umuntu atwenga ivyo yaraye arose.
Aho umutima wanje wababara umutima wanje ukantunturiramwo,
nari igipfu n’inyoberwa; nari nk’igikoko imbere yawe.
Ariko namana nawe imisi yose; umfashe ukuboko kw’i buryo.
Undongoza inama ungiriye, kandi hanyuma uzonjana mu bwiza bwawe.
Ni nde mfise mw’ijuru atari wewe? No mw’isi nta co mfise nipfuza atari wewe.
Umubiri wanje n’umutima wanje bishobora kugira intege nke, ariko Imana ni yo nkomezi z’umutima wanje, ni yo mugabane wanje ibihe bidashira.
Abagiye kure yawe bazopfa rubi; uzohonya abaguteye ibitugu.
Ariko jeho, bimbereye vyiza kuba hafi y’Imana. Nagize Uhoraho Nyeninganji ubuhungiro bwanje; nzokwamamaza ivyo wakoze vyose.

headings.text: Igitabu ca gatatu Zaburi 73–89|loc="PSA 73-89" Zaburi ya 73
Ni Zaburi ya Asafu.

verses.text: Mana, ni kuki wadutaye igihe kirekire? Ni kuki uburake bwawe bwaziriringiye intama zo mu buragiro bwawe?
Niwibuke ihanga witoranirije kuva kera, ubwoko bw’iragi ryawe, wicunguriye; Umusozi Siyoni, aho wibera kera.
Hindukira ugendere iyo misaka y’igisagara iteye agahinda, urabe ingene umwansi yasanganguye ahera hawe.
Abansi bawe bihereye akamo mu kibanza wahora uhuriramwo natwe; aho ni ho bashinze amabendera yabo.
Bakoze nk’abicira ibiti bakoresheje incabiti, mw’ishamba.
Bamenaguye ivyabajwe vyose bakoresheje incabiti n’inyundo vyabo.
Baturiye ahera hawe barahasenyura; bahumanije ahera hagaragaza izina ryawe.
Bavuze mu mitima bati: “Turabaherengeteza bose!” Baturiye aho gusengera Imana hose mu gihugu.
Nta bitangaza tukironka bivuye ku Mana; nta bavugishwa n’Imana bakiriho kandi nta wuzi igihe ivyo bizomara.
Ewe Mana, Umwansi azogucokora gushika ryari? Abakugwanya bazokengera izina ryawe ibihe vyose?
Ni kuki ata co ukora, ukarera amaboko? Kura ukuboko kwawe mu mpuzu maze ubamare!
Ariko Imana ni Umwami wanje kuva kera; azana agakiza kw’isi.
Ni wewe waciyemwo kubiri ikiyaga kubera inkomezi zawe; wamenye imitwe y’igisizimwe co mu mazi menshi.
Ni wewe wamenaguye imitwe ya Leviyatani ukayitanga ngo ibe ivyokurya vy’ibikoko vyo mu bugaragwa.
Ni wewe wuguruye amasoko n’imigezi; wakamije inzuzi z’ibihe vyose.
Umurango ni uwawe, n’ijoro na ryo ni iryawe; ni wewe washizeho izuba n’ukwezi.
Ni wewe washizeho imbibe z’isi; washizeho ici n’urushana.
Niwibuke ingene umwansi yagucokoye, ewe Uhoraho , ingene abantu b’ibipfu bacokoye izina ryawe.
Ntutange intunguru imwe mu menyo y’ibikoko vyo mw’ishamba; ntiwibagire abagorwa bo mu bantu bawe ibihe vyose.
Niwibuke isezerano ryawe, kuko umuryano uri ahantu hose hari umwijima mu gihugu.
Ntureke abahahazwa ngo bagende bamaramaye; abakene n’abagorwa bahimbaze izina ryawe.
Va hasi, ewe Mana, wiburanire; niwibuke ingene ibipfu bigucokora bukarinda bwira.
Ntiwirengagize urwamo rw’abansi bawe, urwamo rwinshi rw’abakugwanya rurushirizaho kwiyongera.

headings.text: Ni masikili ya Asafu.

verses.text: Turaguhimbaza, Mana, turaguhimbaza, kuko Izina ryawe riri hafi yacu; ahantu hose abantu baganira ibitangaza wakoze.
Uravuga ngo: “Mu gihe nzoba nashinze, nzoca imanza mu bugororotsi.
Igihe isi izohinda agashitsi n’abari kuri yo, ni jewe nzofata inkingi zayo ndazikomeze.
Ku bibone ndavuga nti: ‘Ntimukirate,’ n’abanyakibi nti: ‘Ntimukaduze amahembe yanyu.
Ntimukaduze amahembe yanyu mw’ijuru; ntimuvuge amajambo y’ubwibone.’ ”
Nta n’umwe wo mu buseruko canke mu burengero, canke ava mu bugaragwa yoshobora kwishira hejuru.
Imana ni yo ica imanza: icisha bugufi umwe, igashira hejuru uwundi.
Mu kuboko kw’ Uhoraho hari igikombe cuzuye umuvinyu ubiragira uturiranije; arawusuka, maze abanyakibi bose bo kw’isi bakawiranguza gushika no ku mvuzo.
Ariko jeho, nzokwamamaza ibi bintu ibihe bidashira; nzoririmbira ishimwe ry’Imana ya Yakobo,
ni yo ivuga iti: “Nzovunagura amahembe y’abanyakibi bose, ariko amahembe y’abagororotsi azoshirwa hejuru.”

headings.text: Yahawe umukuru w’abaririmvyi. Ni mw’ijwi ryitwa “Ntuhonye.” Ni Zaburi ya Asafu. Ni indirimbo.

verses.text: Imana yamamaye i Buyuda; muri Isirayeli izina ryiwe rirahambaye.
Ihema ryiwe riri i Salemu, Siyoni ni ho aba.
Aho ni ho yavunaguriye imyampi yaka umuriro, inkinzo n’inkota, hamwe n’ibigwanisho vy’intambara.
Urakayangana, uri n’ubwiza kurusha imisozi y’abaguteye.
Abahizi baryamye hasi bafashwe mpiri, basinziriye ubutikoma; nta n’umwe mu bagwanyi akivyura n’umutwe.
Kubera ijwi ryo gukankama kwawe, ewe Mana ya Yakobo, ifarasi n’umukogote birambaraye hasi.
Ni wewe wenyene ukwiye kwubahwa. Ni nde yoguhagarara imbere waratse?
Waciye amateka yawe uri mw’ijuru, isi iratinya iratekereza;
igihe wahaguruka ngo uce imanza, ewe Mana, ngo ukize aboro bo mu gihugu.
Ni ukuri ubushangashirwe bwawe ku bantu butuma uhimbazwa, kandi amasigarira y’uburake bwawe azogukikiza.
Girana amasezerano n’ Uhoraho Imana yawe kandi uyashitse; kandi ibihugu bihakikije nibizane ingabire kuri Imwe ikwiye kwubahwa
Acisha bugufi abatware; yubahwa n’abami bose bo kw’isi.

headings.text: Yahawe umukuru w’abaririmvyi. Bavugira inanga. Ni Zaburi ya Asafu. Ni indirimbo.

verses.text: Natakambiye Uhoraho ; nambaje Imana ngo inyumve.
Aho nari mu mubabaro, narondeye Imana; mw’ijoro ntarika ibiganza ubudahumeka, umushaha wanje wanka guhozwa.
Narakwibutse, Mana, maze ndaboroga; nariyumviriye, maze umushaha wanje uradendebukirwa.
Wabujije amaso guhunyiza; kuba mu magorwa vyambujije kuvuga.
Niyumviriye ku misi ya kera, imyaka ya kera cane;
nibutse indirimbo zanje mw’ijoro. Umutima wanje urarimbura n’impwemu yanje ikibaza iti:
“Mbega Imana izoheba umuntu ibihe vyose? Mbega ntizosubira kwerekana imbabazi ziwe?
Mbega urukundo rwayo rudashira rwaragiye akagirire? Amasezerano yiyo mbega ntakiriho?
Mbega Imana yaribagiye kugira imbabazi? Mbega uburake bwayo bwasubiriye imbabazi zayo?”
Maze ndibwira nti: “Iki ni co kimbabaza: ni nk’aho Iyisumbavyose itakigorora ukuboko kwayo kw’i buryo.”
Ariko ngaca nibuka ibikorwa vy’ Uhoraho ; egome cane, ndibuka ibitangaza vyawe vya kera.
Nzokwiyumvira ku bikorwa vyawe nzirikane ivy’inkomezi wakoze.
Inzira zawe, Mana zirera. Ni iyihe mana imeze nk’Imana yacu?
Uri Imana ikora ibitangaza; werekana ubushobozi bwawe mu mahanga.
Wacunguje ubwoko bwawe ukuboko kw’inkomezi, ari bo bene Yakobo na Yosefu.
Amazi yarakubonye, ewe Mana, amazi yarakubonye ahinda agashitsi; mbere n’ibenga ry’ikiyaga rirajugumira.
Ibicu vyarekuye imvura, amajuru yasiranamwo imituragaro, imyampi yawe iraririra hirya no hino.
Umuturagaro wawe wumvikaniye mu gashururu, umuravyo wawe umurika mw’isi, isi iranyiganyiga ihinda agashitsi.
Inzira yawe yaca mu kiyaga, waciye mu mipfunda y’amazi, naho amakanda yawe atabonetse.
Warongoye abantu bawe nk’umukuku ubarongoje ukuboko kwa Mose na Aroni.

headings.text: Yahawe umukuru w’abaririmvyi. Yahawe kandi Yedutuni. Ni iya Asafu. Ni Zaburi.

verses.text: Bantu banje, nimwumve ukwigisha kwanje; nimwumvirize amajambo yo mu kanwa kanje.
Reka nugurure akanwa kanje nce umugani; ndavuga natura ibihishijwe, ivya kera muri kahise;
ivyo twumvise tukamenya, ivyo ba sogokuruza batubwiye.
Ntituzobinyegeza abana bacu; tuzobibwira abo mu runganwe ruzoza. Ivyo Uhoraho yakoze bibereye gushimwa, inkomezi ziwe, n’ibitangaza yakoze.
Yashingiye aba Yakobo ivyagezwe yashinze amabwirizwa kuri Isirayeli, ivyo yategetse ba sogokuruza ngo bavyigishe abana babo,
kugira ngo abo mu runganwe ruzoza baze babimenye, mbere n’abana bataravuka maze na bo baze babibwire abana babo.
Maze bazokwizigira Imana kandi ntibazokwibagira ivyo yakoze ariko bazokwitondera amabwirizwa yiwe.
Ntibaze babe nka ba sekuruza babo; bari urunganwe rw’intumva kandi rugarariza, bari bafise imitima itumvira Imana, imitima yabo ntiyamugororokera.
Abefurayimu naho bari bafise imiheto, barahunze ku musi w’intambara.
Ntibagumye mw’isezerano ry’Imana kandi banse no kugendera mu Vyagezwe vyayo.
Bibagiye ivyo yari yakoze, hamwe n’ibitangaza yari yaraberetse.
Yakoreye utwumiza imbere ya ba sekuruza babo mu gihugu ca Egiputa, mu ntara y’i Zowani.
Yagabuyemwo kubiri ikiyaga akibacishamwo; yatumye amazi ahagarara nk’uruhome.
Yabarongoje inkingi y’igicu ku murango, n’inkingi y’umuriro mw’ijoro.
Yasatuye igitandara mu bugaragwa abaha amazi menshi nk’ayo mu biyaga;
yabatoboreye umugende mu gitandara c’isare atuma amazi atemba nk’inzuzi.
Ariko bashishikaye kumucumurako, bagarariza Iyisumbavyose bari mu bugaragwa.
Bagerageje Imana n’ibigirankana mu gusaba indya bipfuza.
Bidodombeye Imana; baravuga bati: “Mbega Imana vy’ukuri yodutegurira imeza mu bugaragwa?
Egome, yarakubise igitandara, maze amazi aradudubiza, imigezi irasendanisha, ariko none yoshobora kuduha indya? Yoshobora guha inyama abantu bayo?”
Uhoraho abumvise, arashangashirwa; umuriro wiwe waduka mu ba Yakobo, n’uburake bwiwe buziriringira Isirayeli,
kuko batizeye Imana canke ngo bizigire ugutabara kwayo.
Ariko na ho nyene yategetse ikirere yugurura imiryango yo mw’ijuru;
agwisha manu nk’imvura abantu bararya, yabahaye imikate ivuye mw’ijuru.
Abana b’abantu bariye imfungurwa z’abamarayika; yabarungikiye ivyokurya vyose bashobora kurya.
Yategetse ijuru kurekura umuyaga wo mu buseruko kandi umuyaga wo mu bumanuko urahuhuta ku bwo inkomezi ziwe.
Atuma inyama zimanuka aho bari nk’umukungugu, inyoni zingana n’umusenyi wo kw’isesero ry’ikiyaga.
Yatumye zarara aho bari bacumbitse, hirya no hino y’amahema yabo.
Barazirya gushika baziduhiwe; yabahaye ivyo bipfuza.
Ariko bakiriko bararya ivyo bipfuje, igihe inyama zari zikiri mu kanwa kabo,
Uburake bw’Imana burabaziriringira; yica abanyenkomezi bari muri bo, atsinda hasi imisore ya Isirayeli.
Naho vyagenze uko, babandanije gucumura; naho yakoze ibitangaza bikomeye, ntibamwizeye.
Uko ni ko yashize kw’iherezo imisi yabo nk’impwemu zihumetswe n’imyaka yo kubaho kwabo nk’ikiza.
Mu gihe cose Imana yica bamwe muri bo, baca bayirondera; bakayigarukako n’umwete mwinshi.
Bibutse ko Imana ari yo Gitandara cabo, ko Imana Musumbavyose ari yo Mucunguzi wabo.
Ariko batangura kuyihemesha iminwa yabo; bayihendesha indimi zabo;
imitima yabo ntiyayumvira, ntibitondera isezerano ryayo.
Ariko naho nyene yagumye ari inyembabazi; yahariye ibigabitanyo vyabo ntiyabarandura. Yama yigarura ikareka kuraka kandi ntiyabarekurirako ubushangashirwe bwayo bwose.
Imana yibutse ko ari abantu buntu bameze nk’umuyaga urengana ntube ukigaruka.
Ese ingene bamugararije mu bugaragwa, bakamutunturiza mu gahinga!
Bama bagerageza Imana kenshi; barakije Uwera wa Isirayeli.
Ntibibutse ubushobozi bwiwe; mu gihe yabacungura akabakura mu maboko y’ababahahaza,
ku musi yerekaniyeko ibitangaza vyiwe muri Egiputa, hamwe n’utwumiza twiwe mu ntara ya Zowani.
Yahinduye uruzi rwabo amaraso; ntibashobora kunywa amazi yo mu masoko yabo.
Yabarungikiye ibibugu birabarya, n’ibikere vyonona igihugu cabo.
Imirima yabo yayigaburiye inzige, ivyimburwa vyabo biribwa n’intoteza.
Imizabibu yabo yayitikirishije urubura imisukomora yabo yicwa n’igikonyozi.
Amasho yabo yayamarishije urubura, ibitungwa vyabo yabikubitishije inkuba.
Yabarekuriyeko uburake bwiwe bwaka umuriro; ubushangashirwe bwiwe bwose, uburake bwiwe bw’inkazi, n’igitsure ciwe; vyazananye n’abamarayika barandura.
Yateguye inzira y’uburake bwiwe; ntiyabakingira ngo ntibapfe; ariko abateza ikiza gihonya.
Yishe imfura zose zo muri Egiputa, uburiza bwo mu bantu bo mu mahema ya Hamu.
Ariko isohora abantu bayo nk’umukuku; abarongora nk’intama mu bugaragwa.
Yabarongoye amahoro bituma batagira ubwoba; ariko ikiyaga kimira abansi babo.
Uko ni ko yabashikanye ku rubibe rw’igihugu ciwe cera, mu gihugu c’imisozi yari yigarurije umuheto.
Yakinagije amahanga imbere yabo aca abagaburira igihugu ngo bacegukire; ashira imiryango ya Isirayeli mu mazu yabo.
Ariko bagerageza Imana bagarariza Iyisumbavyose; ntibitondera ivyo yashinze.
Bagararije nka ba sekuruza babo ntibizera, bamera nk’umuheto ugoramye ata wowizigira.
Bayirakishije n’ibibanza vyo gusengeramwo ku misozi; bayiteje ishari ibigirwamana vyabo.
Imana imaze kubumva irashangashirwa; ica iheba Isirayeli rwose.
Iheba inzu yayo yari i Shilo, ihema yari yashinze mu bana b’abantu.
Yemera ko isandugu y’inkomezi ziwe ijanwa mu kinyago, n’ubwiza bwiwe ko bukorokera mu maboko y’umwansi.
Abantu biwe yabarekuriye ku nkota; arakira umugabane wiwe.
Umuriro watongoye abasore babo, n’inkumi zabo ntizavyinye imvyino z’ubukwe;
abaherezi babo bamazwe n’inkota, n’abapfakazi babo ntibashobora kurira.
Maze Imana ivyuka nk’iyari isinziriye, nk’umuhizi atewe intege n’umuvinyu.
Yasanzaje abansi bayo; ibateza ibimaramare bidashira.
Maze itera ibitugu amahema ya Yosefu, ntiyatoranya umuryango wa Efurayimu;
Ariko itoranya umuryango wa Yuda, Umusozi Siyoni, uwo yakunze.
Yubatse Ingoro yayo nk’agatwe k’umusozi, iyigira nk’isi yama ishimangiye ibihe vyose.
Yatoranije Dawidi umusavyi wayo maze imukura mu mpongore z’intama;
yamukuye inyuma y’intama imuhindura umwungere w’abantu bayo ari bo bene Yakobo, Isirayeli inyegu yiwe.
Maze Dawidi abaragirana umutima utunganye; abarongoza ubuhinga bwo mu biganza vyiwe.

headings.text: Ni masikili ya Asafu.

verses.text: Mana, amahanga yateye mu mugabane wawe; bahumanije Ingoro yawe yera, Yerusalemu bahahinduye umusaka.
Imivyimba y’abasavyi bawe bayigaburiye ibisiga vyo mu kirere, inyama z’abantu bawe bazigaburiye ibikoko vyo mw’ishamba.
Basheshe amaraso nk’amazi hirya no hino i Yerusalemu, kandi nta muntu asigaye wo guhamba abapfuye.
Ku babanyi bacu twahindutse akamenyo, turacokorwa tugatukwa n’abadukikije.
Uzogeza ryari, ewe Uhoraho ? Uzokwama uturakiye ibihe vyose? Uburake bwawe buzotuziriringira kugeza ryari?
Suka uburake bwawe kuri ayo mahanga atakwemera, kuri ubwo bwami butambaza izina ryawe;
Kuko batsontsomeye Yakobo bagasambura igihugu ciwe.
Ntuduharureko ivyaha vya ba sogokuruza; imbabazi zawe nizize zinyaruka aho turi, kuko dukeneye gutabarwa.
Dufashe, Mana mukiza wacu, ku bw’icubahiro c’izina ryawe; dukize uduharire n’ivyaha vyacu ku bwo’izina ryawe.
Ni kuki amahanga yobaza ati: “Imana yabo iri hehe?” Imbere y’amaso yacu, menyekanisha mu mahanga ko uhora amaraso y’abasavyi bawe yasesetse.
Amaborogo y’imbohe nashike imbere yawe; ukirishe ukuboko kwawe kw’inkomezi abagerewe gupfa.
Usubirize mu nkoko abadukikije incuro indwi agacokoro bagucokoye, ewe Mana.
Maze twebwe abantu bawe, intama zo mu buragiro bwawe, tuzoguhimbaza ibihe bidashira; uko urunganwe ruzokurikirana n’urundi tuzokwamamaza ishimwe ryawe.

headings.text: Ni Zaburi ya Asafu.

verses.text: Nutwumve, Mwungere wa Isirayeli, wewe urongora aba Yosefu nk’umukuku. Wewe uvyagiye hagati y’abakerubi, kayangana
imbere ya Efurayimu, Benyamini na Manase. Vyuka mu nkomezi zawe; nuze udukize.
Tugarukane, ewe Mana; tumurikishirize mu nyonga hawe, kugira ngo dukire.
Uzogeza ryari, Uhoraho Imana Mushoboravyose, kuturakira no gushiburira kure ugusenga kw’abantu bawe?
Wabagaburiye indya z’amosozi; wabanywesheje ikiyaga c’amosozi.
Waduhinduye akamenyo mu bihugu bidukikije, kandi abansi bacu baraducokora.
Tugarukane, ewe Mana Mushoboravyose; tumurikishirize mu nyonga hawe, kugira ngo dukire.
Wabatuye umuzabibu uwukuye muri Egiputa; wirukana amahanga uraheza urawubadika.
Wawuteguriye aho kuwutera, maze ushora imizi ukwira igihugu cose.
Imisozi yose yapfutswe n’igitutu cawo, amashami yawo yapfutse amasederi maremare y’Imana
Amashami yawo yashitse no ku Kiyaga Mediterane, imivyaro yawo ishika kuri rwa Ruzi.
Ni kuki wahomvoye inzitiro zawo bigatuma abirenganira bamura inzabibu zawo?
Ingurube zo mw’ishamba zarawononye, n’udukoko two ku misozi turawurisha.
Garuka aho turi, Mana Mushoboravyose! Urunguruke uri mw’ijuru urabe! Garuka witwararike uwo muzabibu wawe,
umuzi ukuboko kwawe kw’i buryo kwabaditse, umwana wirereye ngo abe uwawe.
Umuzabibu wawe uciriwe hasi, utongowe n’umuriro; ku bwo gukankama kwawe, abantu bawe barahonye.
Ukuboko kwawe ni kugume ku muntu ari i buryo bwawe, ku mwana w’umuntu wirereye ngo abe uwawe.
Maze natwe ntituzokuvako; duhembure, natwe tuzokwambaza izina ryawe.
Tugarukane, ewe Uhoraho Mana Mushoboravyose; tumurikishirize mu nyonga hawe, kugira ngo dukire.

headings.text: Iyi Zaburi yahawe umukuru w’abaririmvyi. Mw’ijwi ryitwa “Ibirungu vy’Isezerano”. Ni iya Asafu.

verses.text: Nimuvugirize Imana impundu y’umunezero, yo nkomezi zacu; muririmbire Imana ya Yakobo n’ijwi rirenga!
Shirako mucurarange, muvuze ingoma, muvuze inanga y’ijwi rirengera n’ikembe.
Muvuze ihembe ry’intama ku mboneko y’ukwezi, no mu mfato zakwo, ku musi mukuru wacu;
iki ni icagezwe kuri Isirayeli, ni ibwirizwa ry’Imana ya Yakobo.
Aho Imana yaja kugwanya Egiputa, yarishinze nk’ibwirizwa ku ba Yosefu. Numvise ijwi ntazi rivuga riti:
“Nabatuye umutwaro wari ku bitugu vyabo; nakijije amaboko yabo ibitebo vy’amatafari.
Mu marushwa yanyu mwaranyambaje nanje ndabakiza, nabishuye ndi mu gihuhusi; nabagereje ku mazi y’i Meriba.
Nimuntege amatwi, yemwe bantu banje, kuko ngira ndabihanikirize; ese icompa mukanyumvira, yewe Isirayeli!
Ntihakagire imana y’inyamahanga iba muri mwebwe; ntihakagire iyindi mana musenga atari jewe.
Ndi Uhoraho Imana yanyu, nabaduganye ndabakuye muri Egiputa. Asama cane nanje nduzuza akanwa kawe.
Ariko abantu banje ntibanyumviye; Isirayeli ntibanyubashe.
Ni co catumye ndeka imitima yabo ikomantaye ngo ikurikire ivyo biyumvira.
Icompa abantu banje bakanyumvira, icompa Isirayeli bagakurikira inzira zanje,
nokwirukanye abansi babo vuba nohindukirije ukuboko kwanje ku babagwanya!
Abanka Uhoraho bomwunamira, kandi igihano cabo cobaye ic’ibihe vyose.
Ariko mweho mwogaburiwe ingano z’indobanurwa; kandi nobahagije ubuki bwo mu gitandara.”

headings.text: Yahawe umukuru w’abaririmvyi. Muri Gititi. Ni iya asafu.

verses.text: Imana ivyagiye mu nama nkuru y’ubucamanza; icira imanza ibigirwamana:
iti: “Muzogeza ryari kuburanira abo gutsindwa no kwerekeza urubanza ku banyakibi?
Nimuburanire abanyantegenke n’impfuvyi; muburane urw’umukene n’uwuhahazwa.
Mutabare umunyantegenke n’umukene; mubakure mu maboko y’umunyakibi.
Ibigirwamana nta co bizi, nta co bitahura. Bigendagenda mu mwiza; amatanguriro y’isi yose aranyiganyize.
Naravuze nti: ‘Muri imana’ mwese muri abana b’Iyisumbavyose.
Ariko muzopfa nk’abantu buntu; muzogwa nk’uko abandi batware bose bagwa.”
Va hasi, ewe Mana, ucire urubanza isi, kuko amahanga yose ari umugabane wawe.

headings.text: Ni Zaburi ya Asafu.

verses.text: Mana, ntugume wihoreye; ntiwice ugutwi, ntugume wihoreye, ewe Mana!
Raba uko abansi bawe bakuye hasi, uko abakugwanya bagararije.
Bagira inama abantu bawe mu bugunge, bagira imigabo mibi abo ukunda cane.
Baravuga bati: “Nimuze tubamare baherengetere nk’igihugu, kugira ngo izina rya Isirayeli ntiribe ricibukwa.”
Bahuje umutima bagira imigabo; bigize akagwi ngo bakugwanye;
amahema ya Edomu n’ay’Abishimayeli, aya Mowabu n’ay’Abahaguri,
Abagebali, Abamoni n’Abamaleki, Abafilisitiya, n’abantu b’i Tiro.
N’ab’i Ashuri na bo bifatanije na bo ngo bahe inkomezi bene Loti.
Bagirire ivyo wagiriye Abamidiyani, nk’uko wagiriye Sisera na Yabini ku mugezi Kishoni,
bamwe bahonera muri Eni-Dori bagacika nk’amase ku mbuga.
Abaganwa babo nubagirire nka Orebu na Zeyebu, abana b’umwami waho ubagire nka Zeba na Zalimuna,
bamwe bavuga ngo: “Reka tugende twigarurire uburagiro bw’Imana.”
Bahindure nk’agashururu, Mana yanje, ubagire nk’umuguruka utwarwa n’umuyaga.
Nk’uko umuriro utongora ishamba canke imbeya z’umuriro zitongora imisozi,
abe ari ko ubakurikiza igihuhusi cawe ubateze ubwoba igihuhusi cawe.
Mu maso habo nihuzure ibiteterwe, Uhoraho , kugira ngo baze bakurondere.
Nibamaramare bicwe n’ubwoba ibihe vyose; barinde bapfa bari mu bimaramare.
Nibamenye ko wewe, wewe izina ryawe ari Uhoraho ; ari wewe wenyene uri Iyisumbavyose kw’isi yose.

headings.text: Ni indirimbo. Ni Zaburi ya Asafu.

verses.text: Ese ingene Ingoro yawe ari nziza, Ewe Uhoraho Mushoboravyose!
Umutima wanje uraniha, unkabiraniyemwo ku bwo gukumbura ibirimba vy’ Uhoraho ; umutima wanje n’umubiri wanje biratakambira Imana nzima.
Utunyoni na two twironkeye aho kuba, n’intamba zironkeye icari, aho gushira uduswi twazo; i ruhande y’igicaniro cawe, Uhoraho Mushoboravyose, Mwami wanje, Mana yanje.
Hahiriwe abibera mu nzu yawe; bama baguhimbaza.
Hahiriwe abafise inkomezi muri wewe, imitima yabo yama yiteguye kuja mu rugendo ruja i Siyoni.
Iyo baciye mu Mwonga wa Baka, bisigura “umwonga w’amarira”, bahahindura ahantu h’amariba; kandi n’imvura yo ku mutasuro iwambika imigisha.
Bagenda biyubura mu nkomezi nsha, kugeza umwe wese ashitse imbere y’Imana i Siyoni.
Umva ugusenga kwanje, Uhoraho Mana Mushoboravyose; ntega ugutwi, Mana ya Yakobo.
Raba wewe nkinzo yacu, ewe Mana; raba ryiza uwo warobanuje amavuta.
Kumara umusi umwe mu birimba vyawe biruta kumara imisi igihumbi ahandi; nopfuma mba umurinzi w’irembo ry’inzu y’Imana yanje hako mba mu mahema y’abanyakibi.
Kuko Uhoraho Imana ari izuba akaba n’inkinzo; Uhoraho agira ubuntu agatanga icubahiro; ntazogira iciza yima abagenda batunganye.
Uhoraho Mushoboravyose, hahiriwe uwukwizigira.

headings.text: Yahawe umukuru w’abaririmvyi. Mw’ijwi ryitwa Gititi. Ni iya bene Kora. Ni Zaburi.

verses.text: Uhoraho , wewe werekanye imbabazi ku gihugu cawe; wagarukanye inyagano zo mu ba Yakobo.
Wahariye ukugabitanya kw’abantu bawe utwikira ivyaha vyabo vyose.
Warigaruye uva mu burake bwawe ureka ubushangashirwe bwawe bw’inkazi.
Subira utugarukane, ewe Mana Mukiza wacu, udukureko ukuturakira waturakiye.
Mbega uzokwama uturakiye ibihe vyose? Mbega uburake bwawe buzogumaho uko urunganwe ruzogenda rukurikirana?
Mbega ntuzoduhembura, kugira ngo abantu bawe bakunezerererwe?
Twereke urukundo rwawe rudashira, ewe Uhoraho , uduhe agakiza kawe.
Nzokwumviriza ivyo Uhoraho Imana avuga; yasezeraniye amahoro abantu biwe, abantu biwe bamwumvira; ariko ntibasubire mu bupfu bwabo.
Ni ukuri agakiza kiwe kari hafi y’abamwubaha, kugira ngo ubwiza bwiwe bugume mu gihugu cacu.
Urukundo n’ubwizigirwa birahuye; ubugororotsi n’amahoro biragumbiranye.
Ubwizigirwa buratutuje buva mw’ivu, ubugororotsi bumanutse buva mw’ijuru.
Uhoraho azotanga ivyiza vy’ukuri, maze igihugu cacu kizokwera ivyimburwa vyaco.
Ukugororoka kumugiye imbere kugira ngo kumutegurire inzira acamwo.

headings.text: Yahawe umukuru w’abaririmvyi. Ni iya bene Kora. Ni Zaburi.

verses.text: Ntega ugutwi, Uhoraho , maze unyishure, kuko ndi umukene n’umugorwa.
Zigama ubugingo bwanje, kuko ndi umwizigirwa kuri wewe; kiza umusavyi wawe akwizigira; uri Imana yanje;
ngirira imbabazi, ewe Mana, kuko ndakwambaza bukarinda bwira.
Zanira umunezero k’umusavyi wawe, ewe Mana, kuko nkwizigira.
Ewe Mana, uraharira kandi uri mwiza, kandi ufise urukundo rwinshi ku bakwambaza bose.
Niwumve ugusenga kwanje, Uhoraho ; niwumve ugutakamba kwanje.
Iyo ndi mu mubabaro, ndakwambaza, kuko unyishura.
Nta n’imwe mu zindi mana imeze nkawe, ewe Uhoraho; nta wushobora gukora nk’ivyo ukora.
Amahanga yose waremye azoza akwikubite imbere, ewe Mana; bazoshima izina ryawe.
Kuko uhambaye kandi ukora ibihambaye; ni wewe wenyene uri Imana.
Nyigisha inzira zawe, ewe Uhoraho , kugira ngo nizigire ukwizigirwa kwawe; umpe umutima ugororotse, kugira ngo nubahe izina ryawe.
Nzogushima, ewe Uhoraho Mana yanje, n’umutima wanje wose; nzoshima izina ryawe ibihe bidashira.
Kuko urukundo unkunda ari rwinshi; wantabaye ukankura i bwina, iwabo w’abapfuye.
Abangwanya bibona baranteye, Mana; abantu b’ibirara bagomba kunyica; ntibakubabaye na mba.
Ariko wewe, Uhoraho, uri Imana y’inyabuntu igira imbabazi, iteba kuraka, yuzuye urukundo n’ubwizigirwa.
Hindukira ungirire imbabazi; erekana inkomezi zawe zo gutabara umusavyi wawe; unkize, kuko ndagukorera nk’uko na mama yabikora.
Nyereka ikimenyetso c’ukugira neza kwawe, kugira ngo abansi banje babibone bamaramare, kuko wewe, Uhoraho , wantabaye ukandemesha.

headings.text: Isengesho rya Dawidi.

verses.text: Yashinze igisagara ciwe ku musozi wera.
Uhoraho akunda amarembo y’i Siyoni kurusha ibindi bisagara vyose vy’aba Yakobo.
Hari ivyiza vyavuzwe kuri wewe, ewe gisagara c’Imana:
“Nzokwandika Egiputa na Babiloni mu gitigiri c’abanyemera; no mu Bafilisitiya naho nyene, n’i Tiro, hamwe na Kushi; maze nzovuga nti: ‘Uwu yavukiye muri Siyoni.’ ”
Ni ivy’ukuri, bizovugwa kuri Siyoni ngo: “Uwu n’urya bose bavukiye ngaha, kandi Iyisumbavyose ubwayo ni yo izohubaka ihakomeze.”
Uhoraho azokwandika ku gitabu c’amoko ati: “Uwu yavukiye i Siyoni.”
Uko bazocuraranga bazoririmba bati: “Amasoko yanje yose ari muri wewe.”

headings.text: Ni iya bene Kora. Ni Zaburi, kandi ni indirimbo.

verses.text: Uhoraho , uri Imana inkiza; ndagutakambira ku murango no mw’ijoro.
Icompa isengesho ryanje rigashika imbere yawe; tega ugutwi ugutakamba kwanje.
Amagorwa arandengeye kandi ubugingo bwanje bwegereye urupfu.
Mparurwa mu bamanuka baja muri rwa rwobo; nabaye nk’umwe mu banyantegenke.
Nashizwe hamwe n’abapfuye, nk’abishwe barambaraye mu mva, abo utacibuka, abo utakibabara.
Wanshize mu rwobo rw’i bwina, ahantu hacuze umwijima.
Uburake bwawe burandemereye; watumye imipfunda yawe indengera.
Wankuye mu bagenzi banje pfampfe utuma ndabasesema. Ndugaranywe kandi sinshobora gusohoka;
amaso yanje ahumishijwe n’umubabaro. Imisi yose, ndakwambaza; ndagutarikira amaboko.
Mbega uzokwereka ibitangaza vyawe abapfuye? Mbega impwemu zabo zizozuka, ziguhimbaze?
Mbega urukundo rwawe ruzomenyekanishwa mu mva, n’ukwizigirwa kwawe ahantu h’abapfuye?
Ibitangaza vyawe, mbega bizomenyekanira ahantu h’umwijima, canke ibikorwa vyawe vyo kugororoka mu gihugu co kwibagiranwa?
Ariko ndagutakambira, ewe Uhoraho ; mu gitondo ugusenga kwanje kuza imbere yawe.
Ni igiki gitumye unta kure, ewe Uhoraho ukampisha mu nyonga hawe?
Kuva mu buto bwanje namye ndi mu mubabaro negereye urupfu; navukiye mu biteye ubwoba kandi ndihebuye.
Uburake bwawe bwanciyeko; ibiteye ubwoba vyawe biranyishe.
Birankikuza bukarinda bwira nk’imipfunda; vyandengeye impande zose.
Wankuyeko abagenzi n’ababanyi; umwijima ni wo wabaye umukunzi wanje wa hafi.

headings.text: Ni indirimbo. Ni Zaburi ya bene Kora. Yahawe umukuru w’abaririmvyi mw’ijwi ryitwa Mahalati Leyanoti. Ni masikili ya Hemani Umunyazirahi.

verses.text: Nzoririmba urukundo ruhambaye rw’ Uhoraho ibihe vyose; nzomenyekanisha akanwa kanje ukwizigirwa kwawe uko urunganwe ruzogenda rukurikirana n’urundi.
Nzovuga ko urukundo rwawe rwamaho ibihe bidashira, ko washinze ubwizigirwa bwawe mw’ijuru ubwaryo.
Waravuze uti: “Nasezeranye isezerano n’uwo natoranije, narahiye Dawidi umusavyi wanje nti:
‘Nzokomeza uruvyaro rwawe ibihe vyose kandi nzokomeza inganji yawe uko urunganwe ruzokuranwa n’urundi.’ ”
Uhoraho , amajuru ahimbaza ibitangaza vyawe, n’ukwizigirwa kwawe nakwo, mw’ikoraniro ry’abera.
Kuko none ni nde ari mw’ijuru yogereranywa n’Imana? Mu vyo mw’ijuru ni nde ameze nk’ Uhoraho ?
Mw’ikoraniro ry’abera Imana irubashwe cane; iteye ubwoba kurusha abayikikije bose.
Ni nde ameze nkawe, ewe Mana Mushoboravyose? Wewe, Uhoraho , urakomeye, kandi ubwizigirwa bwawe buragukikuje.
Ni wewe uganza ikiyaga gisuriranya; igihe imipfunda yaco yahagurutse, ni wewe uyitururuza.
Ni wewe wasiribanze Rahabu nk’umuvyimba; wasanzaje abansi bawe n’ukuboko kwawe gukomeye.
Amajuru ni ayawe, n’isi na yo ni iyawe; washizeho isi n’ibiri muri yo vyose.
Waremye uburaruko n’ubumanuko; Tabori na Herumoni haririmbishwa n’umunezero kubera izina ryawe.
Ukuboko kwawe kwuzuye inkomezi; ikiganza cawe kirakomeye, ikiganza cawe c’i buryo gishizwe hejuru.
Ukugororoka n’uguca izibereye ni vyo rufatiro rw’inganji yawe; urukundo n’ubwizigirwa bigendera imbere yawe.
Hahiriwe abize kukuvugiriza impundu, bagendera mu muco wo mu nyonga hawe, Uhoraho .
Banezererwa izina ryawe bukarinda bwira; bahimbaza ukugororoka kwawe.
Kuko ari wewe cubahiro cabo n’inkomezi zabo, kandi ushira hejuru ihembe ryacu ku bwo kugira neza kwawe.
Ni ivy’ukuri, inkinzo yacu iganzwa n’ Uhoraho , umwami wacu ni uw’Uwera wa Isirayeli.
Umusi umwe waravuze mw’iyerekwa, ubwira abantu bawe bo kwizigirwa uti: “Natabaye umuhizi mu nkomezi zanje; namutoranije mu bantu basanzwe.
Nironkeye umusavyi wanje Dawidi; narobanuje amavuta yanje yera.
Ikiganza canje kizomushigikira; ni ukuri ukuboko kwanje kuzomukomeza.
Umwansi ntazomutera giturumbuka; umunyakibi ntazomuhonyora ku gakanu.
Nzoherengetereza abamugwanya imbere yiwe ntsinde hasi abansi biwe.
Urukundo rwanje ruzoguma kuri we, kandi ihembe ryiwe rizoshirwa hejuru ku bw’izina ryanje.
Nzoshinga ikiganza ciwe ku kiyaga, ukuboko kwiwe kw’i buryo ndagushire hejuru y’inzuzi.
Azonyambaza ati: ‘Uri Data, Imana yanje, igitandara Umukiza wanje.’
Kandi nzomutoranya ambere imfura, uwushizwe hejuru y’abami bose bo mw’isi.
Urukundo rwanje ruzoguma kuri we ibihe vyose, kandi isezerano namusezeraniye ntirizohinduka.
Nzohagarika abo mu ruvyaro rwiwe ibihe vyose, intebe yiwe y’ubwami izohangama igihe cose amajuru azoba akiriho.
Abana biwe nibahemukira Ivyagezwe vyanje ntibitondere ivyo nabihanikirije,
nibarenga ku vyo nategetse bikabananira kwitondera amabwirizwa yanje,
nzohanisha ivyaha vyabo inkoni, ukugabitanya kwabo ndaguhanishe kubakubitisha ikimoko;
ariko urukundo rwanje ntiruzomuvako, canke ngo mpindure isezerano ryanje.
Sinzoca mw’isezerano ryanje canke ngo mpindure ivyo akanwa kanje kavuze.
Narahiye ukwera kwanje rimwe risa; kandi sinzobesha Dawidi;
ko hatazobura uwo mu ruvyaro rwiwe aba umwami ibihe vyose kandi ingoma yiwe izokwama ihangamye imbere yanje nk’izuba;
izoshingwa ibihe vyose nk’ukwezi, icabona co kwizigirwa co kw’ijuru.”
Ariko waramwirukanye umushiburira kure! Washavuriye uwo warobanuje amavuta.
Wakuyeho isezerano wagiranye n’umusavyi wawe maze utuma igitsibo ciwe kivundagazwa mu mukungugu.
Impome ziwe waziciyemwo ibirengero uhindura ibihome bimukingira imisaka.
Abirenganira baramusahuye; yabaye ak’amenyo mu babanyi biwe.
Washize hejuru ukuboko kw’i buryo kw’abamugwanya; watumye abansi biwe banezerwa.
Ni ivy’ukuri, wasubije inyuma inkota yiwe ntiwamushigikira mu ntambara.
Washize kw’iherezo ubwiza bwiwe uvunagurira hasi intebe yiwe y’ubwami.
Wagabanije imyaka y’ubuto bwiwe; umuteterereza mu maso ya bose.
Uzogeza ryari, Uhoraho ? Uzokwama winyegeje ibihe vyose? Uburake bwawe buzogeza ryari kwaka nk’umuriro?
Ibuka ingene ubugingo bwanje bukenyuka. Kuko waremeye abana b’abantu gupfa gusa.
Ni nde azobaho ntabone urupfu, canke ni nde azokira ntaje mu mva?
Urukundo rwawe rwa kera ruhebuje ruri he, ewe Mana, urwo warahiye Dawidi mu bwizigirwa bwawe?
Niwibuke, ewe Mana, uko umusavyi wawe yacokowe, uko umutima wanje wuzuye ibitutsi vy’amahanga yose,
ibitutsi abansi bawe, Uhoraho bantutse, ivyo bacokoye uwo warobanuje amavuta mu ntambuko ziwe zose.
Uhoraho ahimbazwe ibihe bidashira! Amen kandi Amen!

headings.text: Ni masikili ya Etani Umunyezirahi.

verses.text: Uhoraho, watubereye aho kuba uko urunganwe rwakurikiranye n’urundi.
Imisozi itaravuka canke ngo wibaruke isi yose, uhereye kera hose ukageza ibihe bidashira uri Imana.
Usubiza abantu mu mukungugu, ukavuga uti: “Subire mu mukungugu, mwa bantu buntu.”
Imyaka igihumbi imbere yawe ni nk’umusi warenganye gusa, canke igice kimwe c’ijoro.
Ariko utwara abantu bakamera nk’inzozi; bakamera nk’ivyatsi bimera mu gitondo:
Mu gitondo biramera bigatotahara; ariko ku mugoroba biruma bigakabirana.
Turanduwe n’uburake bwawe dutewe ubwoba n’ubushangashirwe bwawe.
Washize ibigabitanyo vyacu imbere yawe, ivyaha vyacu vyo mu mpisho ubishira imbere y’inyonga zawe.
Imisi yacu yose tuyimara turi mu burake bwawe; turangiza imyaka yacu turi mu kuniha.
Imisi yacu ishobora kungana n’imyaka mirongo indwi, canke mirongo umunani, ku banyenkomezi ariko ivyiza vyo muri yo n’ivyago n’umubabaro gusa.
Ese iyo tumenya ubushobozi bw’uburake bwawe! Uburake bwawe bungana n’ukwubahwa kugukwiye.
Utwigishe guharura imisi yacu, kugira ngo turonke imitima y’ubwenge.
Niwigarure, Uhoraho ! Bizogeza ryari? Girira ikigongwe abasavyi bawe.
Mu gitondo uze uduhaze urukundo rwawe rudashira, kugira ngo tuvuze impundu kandi tunezererwe imisi yacu yose.
Utunezereze imisi ingana n’iyo watubabaje, imyaka ingana iyo twaboneyemwo ivyago.
Niwereke ibikorwa vyawe abasavyi bawe, hamwe n’ubwiza bwawe abana babo.
Ukugira neza kw’Uhoraho Imana yacu kube kuri twebwe ukomeze igikorwa c’intoke zacu; egome, komeza igikorwa c’intoke zacu.

headings.text: Igitabu ca kane Zaburi 90–106|loc="PSA 90-106" Zaburi ya 90
Ni isengesho rya Mose umuntu w’Imana.

verses.text: Uwuba mu bwugamo bw’Iyisumbavyose azokwama ari mu gitutu c’Iyishoboravyose.
Nzobwira Uhoraho nti: “Uri ubuhungiro bwanje n’igihome kinkingira, uri Imana yanje nizigira.”
Ni ukuri azogukiza umutego w’umutezi n’ikiza gihonya.
Azokubundikiriza amoya yiwe, kandi uzohungira musi y’amababa yiwe; ubwizigirwa bwiwe ni bwo buzokubera inkinzo n’icuma gikingira igikiriza.
Ntuzotinya ibiteye ubwoba mw’ijoro, canke umwampi urashwe ku murango,
canke ikiza gitera mu mwijima, canke icago gihonya mu mashoka.
Abantu igihumbi bazogwa i ruhande yawe, ibihumbi cumi i buryo bwawe, ariko ntibizokwegera.
Ariko uzobibonesha amaso yawe kandi uzokwibonera uguhanwa kw’abanyakibi.
Niwavuga uti: “ Uhoraho ni we buhungiro bwanje,” Iyisumbavyose ukayigira ahantu hawe ho kuba,
nta kibi kizogukorako, nta cago kizokwegera ihema ryawe.
Kuko azotegeka abamarayika biwe ngo bakuzigame mu nzira zawe zose;
bazokurerura mu maboko yabo, kugira ngo ntutsitare kw’ibuye.
Uzokandagira intambwe n’imvuvyi; uzosiribanga intare ikomeye n’ikiyoka.
“Kuko yankunze,” ni ko Uhoraho avuze, “nzomukiza, nzomukingira, kuko yamenye zina ryanje.
Niyanyambaza, nanje nzomwishura; nzobana na we mu magorwa, nzomukiza ndamuhe icubahiro.
Nzomuhaza kuramba, ndamwereke agakiza kanje.”
Ni vyiza guhimbaza Uhoraho no gucurarangira izina ryawe, ewe Iyisumbavyose,
kwamamaza urukundo rwawe mu gitondo n’ubwizigirwa bwawe mw’ijoro,
hakoreshejwe inanga y’imirya cumi n’ijwi ry’ikembe.
Kuko ibikorwa vyawe biranezereza, ewe Uhoraho ; ndirimbishwa n’umunezero kubera ibikorwa vy’inkoke zawe.
Mbega ukuntu ibikorwa vyawe ari ibihambaye, Uhoraho , n’ivyo wiyumvira bishika i bwina!
Abatagira ubwenge nta co bamenya, ibipfu ata co bitahura.
Naho abanyakibi bakura nk’ivyatsi, inkozi z’ibibi zigatotahara, bazorandurwa ibihe vyose.
Ariko weho, Uhoraho , ushizwe hejuru ibihe bidashira.
Nta nkeka, abansi bawe, ewe Uhoraho , ni ukuri abansi bawe bazohona; inkozi z’ibibi zose zizosanzazwa.
Wampaye inkomezi nk’iz’imbogo; unsukako amavuta meza y’umunezero.
Amaso yanje yiboneye ukuneshwa kw’abangwanya; amatwi yanje yiyumvira uguhunga kw’abanyanka.
Umugororotsi azototahara nk’ikigazi, akure asagarare nk’isederi ry’i Libani.
Atewe mu nzu y’ Uhoraho , azototaharira mu birimba vy’Imana yacu.
No mu busaza bwiwe azoba acama ivyamwa, azokwamana ubuto n’itoto,
yamamaze avuga ati: “ Uhoraho aratunganye; ni we Gitandara canje, kandi nta bubi buri muri we!”

headings.text: Ni Zaburi, kandi ni indirimbo iririmbwa kw’Isabato.

verses.text: Uhoraho araganje, yisakaye ubwiza; Uhoraho yisakaje ubwiza kandi yambaye inkomezi; ni ukuri, isi irakomeye, irahamye kandi irahangamye.
Intebe yawe y’Ubwami yabayeho kuva kera; wamyeho ibihe vyose.
Ibiyaga birasuriranye, ewe Uhoraho , ibiyaga birabomboranye; ibiyaga bivyuye imipfunda yavyo.
Ariko wewe urakomeye kurusha ukubomborana kw’amazi yo mw’ibenga, urakomeye kurusha imipfunda y’ikiyaga; Uhoraho ashizwe hejuru arahambaye.
Ivyo washinze, ewe Uhoraho , birahamye; ukwera ni kwo gusharije inzu yawe ibihe bitazoshira.
Uhoraho ni Imana ihana. Yewe Mana ihana, seruka ukayangane.
Haguruka, ucire isi amateka; subiriza mu nkoko abibone ibikwiranye na bo.
Uhoraho we, abanyakibi bazogeza ryari, bazogeza ryari kwirata?
Bavuga amajambo y’ubwibone; inkozi z’ibibi zose zuzuye ukwirata.
Bacinyiza abantu bawe, Uhoraho ; bagatoteza ishamvu yawe.
Bica umupfakazi n’inyambukira; bagandagura impfuvyi.
Bakavuga bati: “ Uhoraho ntabibona; Imana ya Yakobo nta co yitaho.”
Nimumenye ibi, yemwe bantu b’ibipfu; yemwe bijuju, muzoca ubwenge ryari?
Uwaremye ugutwi ntashobora kwumva? Uwaremye ijisho mbega ntabona?
Mbega uwutoza indero amahanga ntashobora guhana? Uwigisha abana b’abantu mbega nta bwenge azi?
Uhoraho arazi ivyiyumviro vy’abana b’abantu; arazi ko ari ubusa gusa.
Hahiriwe umuntu utoza indero, Uhoraho , uwo wigisha Ivyagezwe vyawe.
Ubaha ugutekanirwa mu misi y’ivyago, kugeza aho icobo kizokwimbirwa abanyakibi.
Kuko Uhoraho atazota abantu biwe; ntazokwigera ahemukira inyegu yiwe.
Uguca imanza kuzosubira kwisunga ubugororotsi, kandi abatuganye mu mitima bazogukurikira.
Ni nde azova hasi ngo angwanire kubera umunyakibi anteye? Ni nde azomburanira agahangana n’inkozi z’ibibi?
Uhoraho iyo atantabara, mba naragiye ahantu h’agacerere k’urupfu.
Aho navuga nti: “Ikirenge canje kiriko kiranyerera,” urukundo rwawe rudashira, Uhoraho , rwaranshigikiye.
Aho nari nuzuye umubabaro, uguhumurizwa kwawe kwanzaniye umunezero.
Mbega ingoma yononekaye yokwifatanya nawe; ingoma izana amagorwa kubera ivyo itegeka?
Abanyakibi baja inama yo kugirira nabi umugororotsi bagacira uwutagira icaha urwo gupfa.
Ariko Uhoraho yambereye igihome kinkingira, Imana yanje yambereye igitandara nihishamwo.
Izobasubiriza mu nkoko ivyaha bakoze izobahonya kubera ibibi bakoze; Uhoraho Imana yanje izobahonya.
Nimuze turirimbire Uhoraho tunezerewe; tuvugirize impundu Igitandara c’agakiza kacu.
Tuze mu nyonga hiwe tumushima tumuririmbire tuvugira ibicurarangisho.
Kuko Uhoraho ari Imana ihambaye, ni Umwami ahambaye asumba ibigirwamana vyose.
I bwina h’isi hari mu kuboko kwiwe, n’udutwe tw’imisozi ni utwiwe.
Ikiyaga ni iciwe, kuko ni we yakiremye, ibiganza vyiwe ni vyo vyabumye i musozi.
Nimuze, tumwunamire tumusenge, dupfukame imbere y’ Uhoraho Umuremyi wacu;
kuko ari we Mana yacu natwe turi abantu yiragiriye, umukuku yitayeho. Uwu musi icompa mukumva ijwi ryiwe rivuga riti:
“Ntimukomantaze imitima yanyu nk’uko mwayikomantarije i Meriba, nk’uko mwabigize kuri urya musi i Masa mu bugaragwa,
aho ba sogokuruza banyu bangerageza bakancaca, naho bari barabonye ivyo nakoze.
Nashavuriye urwo runganwe imyaka mirongo ine; ndavuga nti: ‘Ni abantu bama bazimira mu mitima, kandi ntibamenye inzira zanje.’
Ni co catumye ndahirana uburake nti: ‘Ntibazokwigera binjira aho kuruhukira nari narabateguriye.’ ”
Nimuririmbire Uhoraho indirimbo nshasha; yemwe abari mw’isi mwese, muririmbire Uhoraho .
Muririmbire Uhoraho muhimbaze izina ryiwe, mwamamaze agakiza kiwe uko bukeye.
Muvuge ivy’icubahiro ciwe mu mahanga yose, n’ibitangaza yakoze mu moko yose.
Kuko Uhoraho ahambaye kandi abereye gushimwa; akwiye kwubahwa kuruta ibigirwamana vyose.
Kuko imana zose z’amahanga ari ibigirwamana, ariko Uhoraho yaremye amajuru.
Ubwiza n’icubahiro biri imbere yiwe; inkomezi n’igikundiro biri mu ngoro yiwe.
Nimwemere Uhoraho , yemwe miryango yose yo mu mahanga, mwemere ko Uhoraho afise icubahiro n’inkomezi.
Nimuhe Uhoraho icubahiro kibereye izina ryiwe; muzane ishikanwa mushike mu birimba vyiwe.
Musenge Uhoraho muri mu bwiza bw’ukwera kwiwe; yemwe abari mw’isi mwese, muhindire agashitsi imbere yiwe.
Mwamamaze mu mahanga muti: “ Uhoraho araganje.” Isi irashimangiye, ntishobora kunyiganyizwa; azocira amahanga imanza zibereye.
Ijuru nirinezerwe, isi nihimbarwe; ikiyaga nikibomborane, n’ibiri muri co vyose.
Imisozi yose ninezerwe, n’ibiri muri yo vyose; ibiti vyose vyo mw’ishamba nibiririmbishwe n’umunezero.
Ivyaremwe vyose nibinezererwe imbere y’ Uhoraho , kuko aje, aje gucira isi urubanza. Azocira abari mw’isi imanza mu bugororotsi N’amahanga azoyacira imanza mu kuri kwiwe.
Uhoraho araganje, isi nihimbarwe; ibizinga vya kure nibihimbarwe.
Ibicu n’umwijima w’umuzitanya biramukikije; ubugororotsi n’uguca imanza zibereye ni vyo tanguriro ry’ingoma yiwe.
Umuriro ugendera imbere yiwe maze ugatongora abansi biwe impande zose.
Umuravyo wiwe umurikira isi; isi irabibona maze igahinda agashitsi.
Imisozi ishonga nk’ishashara imbere y’ Uhoraho imbere y’umwami w’isi yose.
Amajuru yamamaza ukugororoka kwiwe, kandi amoko yose arabona ubwiza bwiwe.
Abasenga ibishushayo bazomaramara, abishimira ibigirwamana; nimumwunamire, yemwe bigirwamana mwese!
Siyoni haravyumva maze hakanezerwa n’imihana y’i Buyuda igahimbarwa kubera guca amateka kwawe.
Kuko wewe, Uhoraho , uri Iyisumbavyose kw’isi yose; ushizwe hejuru cane kuruta ibigirwamana vyose.
Abakunda Uhoraho nibanke ibibi, kuko azigama ubugingo bw’abantu biwe akabakiza akabakura mu maboko y’abanyakibi.
Umuco ukayanganira umugororotsi n’umunezero ugakayanganira uwutunganye mu mutima.
Nimunezererwe Uhoraho , yemwe bagororotsi, muhimbaze izina ryiwe ryera.
Nimuririmbire Uhoraho indirimbo nsha, kuko yakoze ibintu bitangaje; kuko yazanishije agakiza ikiganza ciwe c’i buryo n’ukuboko kwiwe kwera.
Uhoraho yamenyekanishije agakiza kiwe kandi yahishuye ukugororoka kwiwe mu mahanga.
Yibutse urukundo rwiwe n’ukwizigirwa kwiwe kuri Isirayeli; abo ku mpera z’isi bose babonye agakiza k’Imana yacu.
Nimuvugirize impundu Uhoraho , yemwe abari mw’isi mwese, muturikishe muririmbe mucuraranga;
Mucurarangire Uhoraho ikembe, mwumvikanishe indirimbo mucuraranga ikembe,
Muvuze inzamba n’ihembe ry’intama; muvugirize impundu mu nyonga z’ Uhoraho , Umwami.
Ikiyaga nicumvikanishe ijwi, n’ibiri muri co vyose, isi, n’abayibako bose.
Inzuzi nizikome amashi, imisozi yose iririmbane umunezero;
Vyose nibiririmbire mu nyonga z’ Uhoraho , kuko aje gucira imanza isi. Azocira imanza isi mu bugororotsi n’amoko yose azoyacira izibereye.

headings.text: Ni Zaburi.

verses.text: Uhoraho araganje, amahanga yose nahinde agashitsi; avyagiye hagati y’abakerubi, isi nihinde agashitsi.
Uhoraho arahambaye ari i Siyoni; ashizwe hejuru y’amahanga yose.
Nibahimbaze izina ryawe rihambaye kandi riteye ubwoba; uri uwera.
Umwami ni umunyenkomezi, akunda imanza zibereye; washinze ubutungane; mu ba Yakobo wakoze ibigororotse kandi bitunganye.
Nimushire hejuru Uhoraho Imana yacu mumwunamire ku ndava y’ibirenge vyiwe; ni uwera.
Mose na Aroni bari mu baherezi biwe, Samweli yari mu bambaza izina ryiwe; bambaje izina ry’ Uhoraho na we arabishura.
Yavuganye na bo ari mu nkingi y’igicu; bitondeye ivyo yihanikirije n’amategeko yiwe yabashingiye.
Uhoraho Mana yacu, warabishuye; ku Bisirayeli wabaye Imana iharira ivyaha, naho wabahaniye ibibi bakoze.
Nimushire hejuru Imana yacu musengere ku musozi wiwe wera, kuko Uhoraho Imana yacu ari uwera.
Nimuvugirize impundu Uhoraho , yemwe abari mw’isi mwese.
Musenge Uhoraho munezerewe; muze imbere yiwe muririmbana umunezero.
Mumenye ko Uhoraho ari we Mana. Ni we yaturemye, natwe turi abiwe, turi abantu biwe, intama zo mu buragiro bwiwe.
Mwinjire mu marembo y’Ingoro yiwe mushima, mu birimba vyiwe muhimbaza; mumushime kandi muhimbaze izina ryiwe.
Kuko Uhoraho ari mwiza kandi urukundo rwiwe rwamaho ibihe bidashira; ukwizigirwa kwiwe kuzokwamaho uko urunganwe ruzokuranwa n’urundi.

headings.text: Ni Zaburi. Ni iyo guhimbaza no gushima.

verses.text: Nzoririmba ivy’urukundo rwawe n’uguca imanza zibereye; Uhoraho , nzokuririmbira ishimwe.
Nzokwitondera kugenda ntunganye; mbega uzoza iwanje ryari? Nzotunganya ivyo mu rugo rwanje mfise umutima utunganye.
Sinzokwigera nshima ikintu na kimwe kibi. Nanka ivyo abatizera bakora; sinzokwigera nifatanya na vyo.
Abanduye mu mitima bazoba kure yanje; sinzokwifatanya n’ikintu na kimwe kibi.
Uwuvuga nabi mugenziwe wese mu mpisho, nzomuzibiza; uwufise amaso y’ubwibone n’umutima wishira hejuru, sinzomwihanganira.
Amaso yanje azoba ku bizigirwa bo mu gihugu, kugira ngo babane nanje; uwugenda atunganye ni we azonkorera.
Nta n’umwe mu bakora ivy’ubugunge azoba mu nzu yanje; nta n’umwe avuga ibinyoma azohagarara imbere yanje.
Uko bukeye nzokwama nziba akanwa k’abanyakibi bose bo mu gihugu; nzoherengeteza abakora ibibi bose bave mu gisagara c’ Uhoraho .

headings.text: Ni iya Dawidi. Ni Zaburi.

verses.text: Uhoraho , niwumve ugusenga kwanje; ugutakamba kwanje nikugushikeko.
Ntumpishe mu nyonga hawe mu gihe ndi mu magorwa. Ntega ugutwi; ninagutakambira, unyishure vuba.
Kuko imisi yanje itumutse nk’umwotsi; amagufa yanje yaka nk’ikiyigira.
Umutima wanje ucitse intege ukabirana nk’ubwatsi, nibagira kurya indya zanje.
Mu magorwa yanje ndaniha cane urukoba rwanje rwafatanye n’amagufa.
Nabaye nk’igihuna co mu bugaragwa, nk’inyanana yo mu misaka.
Sintora agatiro; nabaye nk’inyoni iri ukwa yonyene ku gisenge c’inzu.
Abansi banje barantuka bukarinda bwira; abancokora bakoresha izina ryanje mu kuvumana.
Kuko ndya umunyota nk’indya nkavanga ivyo nywa n’amosozi
kubera uburake bwawe bwinshi, kuko wamfashe ukanterera i ruhande.
Imisi yanje yabaye nk’igitutu co ku mugoroba; nkabiranye nk’ubwatsi.
Ariko wewe, Uhoraho , uhangamye ibihe bidashira; uzokwama uri rurangiranwa uko urunganwe ruzokurikirana n’urundi.
Uzova hasi ugirire imbabazi Siyoni, kuko hageze ko uhagirira neza; igihe cashinzwe kirashitse.
Kuko amabuye yaho ari ay’igiciro ku basavyi bawe; n’umukungugu waho utuma bahumvira akagongwe.
Amahanga azokwubaha izina ry’ Uhoraho , abami bose bo mw’isi bazokwunamira kubera icubahiro cawe.
Kuko Uhoraho azosubira kwubaka Siyoni aseruke mu bwiza bwiwe.
Azokwishura ugusenga kw’umugorwa; ntazokwirengagiza ukwinginga kwiwe.
Ibi nivyandikirwe abo mu runganwe ruzoza, kugira ngo abataravuka baze bahimbaze Uhoraho bati:
“ Uhoraho yarungurutse ari ahera hiwe mw’ijuru, ari mw’ijuru yarungurutse isi,
ngo yumve ukuniha kw’imbohe kandi ngo abohore abaciriwe urwo gupfa.”
Nuko izina ry’ Uhoraho rizovugwa i Siyoni n’i Yerusalemu bazomuhimbaza
aho amoko yose n’ubwami bwose bazokoranira hamwe gusenga Uhoraho .
Ngeze hagati y’urugendo rwanje yamaze inkomezi; yagabanije imyaka yanje.
Nuko ndavuga nti: “Ntunkureho, Mana yanje, nkiri hagati y’imyaka yanje yo kubaho; wewe wamaho ibihe vyose.
Ubwa mbere na mbere washizeho amatanguriro y’isi, kandi amaboko yawe ni yo yaremye amajuru.
Bizoshira, ariko wewe wamaho; vyose bizosaza nk’impuzu. Uzobihindura nk’uwuhindura impuzu maze bishire.
Ariko wewe uhora uko wamye, kandi imyaka yawe ntigira iherezo.
Abana b’abasavyi bawe bazoba mu nyonga hawe; uruvyaro rwabo ruzokwama imbere yawe.”

headings.text: Ni isengesho ry’umunyamibabaro acitse intege maze agasuka intimba ziwe imbere y’ Uhoraho .

verses.text: Mutima wanje, himbaza Uhoraho ; namwe bimbamwo mwese, nimuhimbaze izina ryiwe ryera.
Mutima wanje, himbaza Uhoraho , ntiwibagire ivyiza yagukoreye vyose;
ni we aharira ivyaha vyawe vyose agakiza ingwara zawe zose,
ni we acungura ubugingo bwawe ngo ntibuje muri rwa rwobo akakwambika urukundo n’imbabazi nk’igitsibo,
ni we aguhaza ivyiza kugira ngo ubusore bwawe bwiyubure nk’ubw’inkona.
Uhoraho agirira ivyo kugororoka n’ivy’imanza zibereye abahahazwa bose.
Yamenyesheje Mose inzira ziwe, n’ibikorwa vyiwe kuri Isirayeli:
Uhoraho agira impuhwe n’ubuntu, ateba kuraka, akagira urukundo rwinshi.
Ntazokwama yagiriza, kandi ntazokwama aratse ibihe vyose;
ntadukorera ibikwiranye n’ivyaha vyacu canke ngo atugerere ibihwanye n’ibigabitanyo vyacu.
Kuko nk’uko amajuru yitanguriye isi, ni ko urukundo agirira abamwubaha rungana;
nk’uko ubuseruko bwitanguriye uburengero, ni ko yashiburiye kure yacu ibigabitanyo vyacu.
Nk’uko se agirira abana ikigongwe, ni ko Uhoraho agirira ikigongwe abamwubaha;
kuko azi iremwa ryacu, yibuka ko turi umukungugu.
Ubugingo bw’abana b’abantu ni nk’ivyatsi gusa, bamera nk’amashurwe yo ku misozi;
umuyaga uyahuhako akaba agiye, aho yahora ntihabe hacibukwa.
Ariko uhereye ibihe vyose ukageza ibihe vyose urukundo rw’ Uhoraho ruri ku bamwubaha, kandi ukugororoka kwiwe kuri ku ruvyaro rw’abana babo;
ku bitondera isezerano ryiwe bakibuka kwitondera ivyo yashinze.
Uhoraho yashinze intebe y’ubwami yiwe mw’ijuru, kandi ni umwami aganza vyose.
Nimuhimbaze Uhoraho , yemwe bamarayika biwe, yemwe banyenkomezi mukora ivyo ategetse, mwumvira ijambo ryiwe.
Nimuhimbaze Uhoraho , yemwe mwa nyenyeri zo kw’ijuru, yemwe basavyi biwe bakora ivyo agomba.
Nimuhimbaze Uhoraho , yemwe bikorwa vyiwe aho muri hose mu bwami bwiwe. Mutima wanje, himbaza Uhoraho .

headings.text: Ni iya Dawidi.

verses.text: Mutima wanje, himbaza Uhoraho . Uhoraho Mana yanje, urahambaye cane; wambaye icubahiro n’igitinyiro.
Uhoraho yitwikiriza umuco nk’umutamana; yubaka amajuru nk’ihema
agashinga inkingi z’inzu ziwe zo hejuru ku mazi menshi. Ahindura ibicu umukogote wiwe akagendera ku mababa y’umuyaga.
Ahindura imiyaga intumwa ziwe, abakozi biwe akabagira imbeya z’umuriro.
Ashinga isi ku matanguriro yayo; kandi ntiyigera inyiganyizwa.
Wayitwikirije amadamba y’amazi nk’impuzu; amazi yarenze udutwe tw’imisozi.
Ariko uvuze gusa amazi arahunga, yumvise uguturagara kwawe yaciye ahunga;
yaduze imisozi, amanuka mu biyaya, aho wayashingiye kuba.
Wayashingiye akarimbi atarenga; ntazosubira kurengera isi.
Atuma amasoko adudubiza amazi aja mu myonga; agatembera hagati y’imisozi.
Agaha amazi ibikoko vyose vyo mw’ishamba; indogoba z’inyeshamba zikimara inyota.
Inyoni zo mu kirere zubaka ivyari vyazo i ruhande y’amazi; ziririmbira mu mashami y’ibiti.
Avomerera imisozi ari mu nzu yiwe mw’ijuru; igihugu kigahazwa n’ibivuye mu bikorwa vyiwe.
Atuma ivyatsi bikura kubera amasho, n’ibiterwa birimwe n’abantu, kugira ngo isi bayikuremwo ivyokurya:
umuvinyu unezereza imitima y’abantu, amavuta atuma abantu bakayangana mu maso, n’umutsima ubaha inkomezi.
Ibiti vy’ Uhoraho bivomererwa neza, amasederi y’i Libani, ayo yateye.
Raba inyoni uko zijisha ivyari vyazo; agasoza kironkera inzu yako mu tujwari.
Mu misozi miremire ni ho impene z’inyeshamba zibera; ibitandara ni ubuhungiro bw’inkezi.
Yaremye ukwezi ngo kugene ibihe, n’izuba rirazi igihe rirengerako.
Uzana umwijima bukira, maze ibikoko vyo mw’ishamba bigaturuka.
Intambwe zikivuga zirondera ico zihiga zikarondera indya zazo ziva ku Mana.
Izuba ryaseruka, zikigira, zikisubirira kubunda mu bibundo vyazo.
Maze abantu bagasohoka bakaja ku bikorwa vyabo, bagakora bakaruha gushika ku mugoroba.
Uhoraho we, ese ingene ibikorwa vyawe ari vyinshi! Wabiremesheje ubwenge vyose; isi yuzuyemwo ivyaremwe vyawe.
Raba ikiyaga, ingene cagutse kikaba kinini, cuzuye ivyaremwe birenze urugero; ibiri n’ubuzima binini na bitoya.
Raba ubwato ingene buja hirya no hino, na Leviyatani, iyo waremye ngo ikiniremwo.
Ivyaremwe vyose biguhanga amaso ngo ubigaburire ivyokurya vyavyo mu gihe cavyo.
Iyo ubigaburiye, biregeranya indya; iyo upfunduruye ikiganza cawe, bihazwa ivyiza.
Uhishije mu nyonga zawe, vyicwa n’ubwoba; ubikuyemwo umwuka wavyo, birapfa bigasubira mu mukungugu.
Iyo urungitse Mpwemu wawe biraremwa, ugasubiza isi kuba nshasha.
Icubahiro c’ Uhoraho kiragahoraho ibihe vyose; Uhoraho ahimbariwe ibikorwa vyiwe;
we araba isi, na yo igahinda agashitsi, akora ku misozi, igapfunduka umwotsi.
Nzoririmbira Uhoraho ubuzima bwanje bwose; nzoririmba ishimwe ry’Imana yanje imisi yose nzoba nkiriho.
Icompa ukurimbura kwanje kugahimbara Uhoraho , kuko nezererwa muri we.
Ariko abanyavyaha nibaherengetere kw’isi, abanyakibi ntibasubire kubaho. Himbaza Uhoraho , ewe mutima wanje. Himbaza Uhoraho .
Nimuhimbaze Uhoraho , mwamamaze izina ryiwe; mumenyekanishe mu mahanga ivyo yakoze.
Nimumuririmbire, mumuhimbaze; muvuge ibikorwa vyiwe bihambaye.
Mwirate izina ryiwe ryera; imitima y’abarondera Uhoraho inezerwe.
Nimurondere Uhoraho n’inkomezi ziwe; mwame murondera mu nyonga hiwe.
Nimwibuke ibitangaza yakoze, utwumiza, n’imanza yaciye;
yemwe ruvyaro rwa Aburahamu, umusavyi wayo; yemwe bene Yakobo, abo yatoranije.
Uhoraho ni we Mana yacu; imanza ziwe ziri mw’isi yose.
Yama yibuka isezerano ryiwe ibihe vyose, n’ijambo yasezeranye, gushika ku runganwe rugira igihumbi,
Isezerano yagiranye na Aburahamu, indahiro yarahiye Isaka.
Yararyemeje kuri Yakobo nk’itegeko, no kuri Isirayeli nk’isezerano ry’intahava ngo:
“Nzoguha igihugu c’i Kanani, kibe umugabane wawe uzoragwa.”
Igihe bari bakiri inkehwa gusa, mbere ari inkehwa vy’ukuri, kandi ari inyambukira muri co,
Bagenda bangara bava mu gihugu baja mu kindi, bava mu bwami baja mu bundi.
Ntiyakundira umuntu n’umwe kubacinyiza; ku bwabo yakankamiye abami ati:
“Ntimukore ku bo narobanuje amavuta; ntimugirire nabi abavugishwa banje.”
Yahamagaye ikigoyi mu gihugu asambura ibigega vyabo vy’indya vyose;
maze urungika umuntu imbere yabo; ni Yosefu yagurishijwe nk’umugurano.
Baboshe amaguru yiwe mu minyororo, izosi ryiwe rishirwa mu vyuma,
kugeza ivyo yari yaravuze bishitse, kugeza ijambo ry’ Uhoraho ryemeje ko yavuze ukuri.
Umwami atumako baramurekura, abakuru bo mu bantu bamuha kwidegemvya.
Amuhindura uwuganza abo mu rugo rwiwe, uwuganza ivyo yari atunze vyose,
ngo yigishe abaganwa biwe nk’uko bimuhimbaye kandi ngo yigishe abatware baho ubwenge.
Maze Isirayeli yinjira muri Egiputa; Yakobo aba inyambukira mu gihugu ca Hamu.
Uhoraho atuma abantu biwe bagwira; atuma baba benshi ku bansi babo,
abo yatumye imitima yanka abantu biwe, ngo bagire inama yo kubagirira nabi.
Yatumye Mose umusavyi wiwe, na Aroni, uwo yari yaratoranije.
Bakora ibitangaza muri bo, n’utwumiza mu gihugu ca Hamu.
Yarungitse umwijima apfuka igihugu cabo cose; kuko bari bamugararije.
Yahinduye amazi yabo amaraso, bituma amafi yabo apfa.
Igihugu cabo cuzuye ibikere, biraduga no mu buriri bw’abatware babo.
Yaravuze, haca hatera ibibugu, imibu ikwira igihugu cose ca Egiputa.
Yahinduye imvura yabo urubura, imiravyo iboneka mu gihugu cabo cose;
yahungururiye hasi imizabibu n’imisukoni vyabo avunagura ibiti vyo muri Egiputa.
Yaravuze, maze inzige ziraza, intoteza zitagira igitigiri;
zirya ibitotahaye vyose vyo mu gihugu cabo, zirya ivyimburwa bimera kw’isi yabo.
Maze yica abana b’imfura bo mu gihugu cabo, ivyamwa vya mbere vyo mu buto bwabo.
Yasohoye Isirayeli, bagenda bikoreye ifeza n’inzahabu mu bo mu miryango yabo nta n’umwe yatsitaye.
Egiputa bari banezerewe igihe bagenda kuko bari batekewe n’ubwoba kubera Abisirayeli.
Yagaranzuye igicu co kubapfuka, n’umuriro wo kubamurikira mw’ijoro.
Barasavye, na we abaha inkware; yarabagaburiye barahaga umukate uvuye mw’ijuru.
Yasatuye igitandara, amazi aradudubiza; atemba nk’uruzi mu bugaragwa.
Kuko yibutse isezerano ryiwe ryera iryo yahaye umusavyi wiwe Aburahamu.
Yasohoye abantu biwe banezerewe, abo yitoranirije bavuza impundu z’umunezero;
yabahaye igihugu c’amahanga, barazwe ico abandi bahabiye;
