kugira ngo bitondere ivyo yihanikirije bagendere mu vyagezwe vyiwe. Uhoraho ahimbazwe.
Haleluya. Nimushime Uhoraho kuko ari mwiza; kuko urukundo rwiwe rwamaho ibihe bidashira.
Ni nde ashobora kumenyekanisha ivyo Uhoraho yakoze canke ngo amuhimbaze nk’uko bikwiye?
Hahiriwe abakora ibitunganye, bakama bakora ibigororotse.
Ewe Uhoraho , uranyibuka niwagirira imbabazi abantu bawe, uze untabare niwabakiza,
kugira ngo nezererwe amahirwe y’abo watoranije. Kugira ngo nsangire umunezero n’ihanga ryawe nifatanye n’ishamvu yawe mu kugutazira.
Twaracumuye, nk’uko ba sogokuruza bakoze; twakoze ibitabereye dukora ibibi.
Igihe ba sogokuruza bari muri Egiputa, ntibamenye ibitangaza wakoze; ntibibutse ivy’ukugira neza kwawe kwinshi, maze baragarariza bari ku kiyaga, Ikiyaga Gitukura.
Ariko arabakiza kubera izina ryiwe, ngo amenyekanishe ubushobozi bwiwe.
Yakankamiye Ikiyaga Gitukura, maze kiruma; yabacishije i bwina nko mu bugaragwa.
Yarabakijije abakura mu kuboko kw’umwansi; arabacungura abakura mu kuboko k’uwabagwanya.
Amazi arengera ababahiga; nta n’umwe wo muri bo yarokotse.
Nuko bizera amasezerano yiwe baririmba ishimwe ryiwe.
Ariko baca bibagira vuba ivyo yari yabakoreye ntibarindira ko ashira mu ngiro umugambi wiwe.
Mu bugaragwa bagiye mu vyo kwipfuza kwabo; mu bweranyange bagerageje Imana.
Nuko ibaha ivyo basavye, ariko ibarungikira ikiza gihonya.
Bari aho bacumbitse bagiriye ishari Mose hamwe na Aroni, uwari yatoranirijwe Uhoraho .
Isi irasama imira Datani; ihamba umugwi wa Abiramu.
Umuriro wadutse mu babakurikira; urubeya rwarigase abanyakibi.
I Horebu bacuze imasa basenga ikigirwamana cacuzwe mu butare.
Baguza Imana yabo y’ubwiza igishushanyo c’impfizi, irisha ubwatsi.
Bibagira Imana yabakijije, yakoze ibihambaye muri Egiputa,
ibitangaza mu gihugu ca Hamu n’ibikorwa bihambaye ku Kiyaga Gitukura.
Nuko avuga ko azobahonya; iyo Mose, uwo yatoranije, adahagarara mu gihengeri imbere yiwe kugira ngo uburake bwiwe ntibubarigate.
Mu nyuma banka igihugu ciza; ntibizera isezerano ryiwe.
Baridodomvye bari mu mahema yabo ntibubaha Uhoraho .
Aca arahira amanitse ukuboko kwiwe ko azobahonereza mu bugaragwa,
agatuma uruvyaro rwabo rugwa mu banyamahanga akabasanzariza mu bihugu.
Bifatanije na Bayali y’i Peyori maze barya ivyaterekerejwe imana zitagiramwo ubuzima;
bavyura uburake bw’ Uhoraho kubera ibikorwa vyabo bibi, haca haduka ikiza muri bo.
Ariko Finehasi arahaguruka ngo ahane uwacumuye, ico kiza gica kirahagarara.
Ivyo yabiharuweko nk’ukugororoka uko urunganwe ruzokurikirana n’urundi ibihe vyose.
Bashavuje Uhoraho bari ku mazi y’i Meriba, ivyago biza kuri Mose kubera bo;
kuko batumviye Mpwemu w’Imana, bituma Mose yadukana amajambo atiyumviriye.
Ntibaranduye amahanga nk’uko Uhoraho yari yababariye,
ariko bivanga n’ayo mahanga bigana ingeso zabo.
Basenga imana zabo, na zo zibabera umutego.
Bashikanira izo mana abahungu n’abakobwa babo.
Basesa amaraso y’abatagira icaha, amaraso y’abahungu n’abakobwa babo, abo bashikaniye ibigirwamana vy’i Kanani nk’ibimazi, maze ayo maraso ahumanya igihugu.
Bihumanishije ivyo bakoze; bacika abasambanyi kubera ibikorwa vyabo.
Ni co catumye Uhoraho ashavurira abantu biwe, azinukwa umugabane wiwe.
Yabarekuriye mu maboko y’amahanga, maze abansi babo barabaganza.
Abansi babo barabacinyiza baba musi y’ububasha bwabo.
Yabatabaye kenshi, ariko bashishikara kumugarariza kandi baguma bamucumurako.
Ariko yumvise umubabaro wabo igihe yumva ugutakamba kwabo;
Ku bwabo yibutse isezerano ryiwe maze kubera urukundo rwiwe rwinshi arigarura.
Yatumye ababagize abagurano babagirira akagongwe.
Dukize, Uhoraho Mana yacu, twegeranye udukure mu mahanga, kugira ngo dushime izina ryawe ryera Twongere tuguhimbaze.
Uhoraho , Imana ya Isirayeli, ahimbazwe, uhereye ibihe bidashira ukageza ibihe bidashira. Abantu bose nibavuge bati: “Amen.” Haleluya.
Nimushimire Uhoraho , kuko ari mwiza; urukundo rwiwe rwamaho ibihe bidashira.
Abacunguwe n’ Uhoraho nibashinge iyo intahe; abo yacunguye akabakura mu kuboko kw’umwansi,
abo yegeranije abakura mu bihugu, mu buseruko no mu burengero, mu buraruko no mu bumanuko.
Bamwe bayerera mu bugaragwa, kw’isi igadutse, ntibabona inzira yobashikana mu gisagara boshobora kubamwo.
Bari bashonje kandi banyotewe, bari bihebuye.
Maze mu magorwa yabo, batakambiye Uhoraho , na we arabakiza, abakura mu marushwa yabo.
Yabarongoreye mu nzira igororotse abajana mu gisagara bari bagiye kubamwo.
Abo nibashime Uhoraho ku bw’urukundo rwiwe rudashira, n’ibikorwa bihambaye yakoreye abana b’abantu,
kuko amara inyota abanyotewe agahaza ivyiza abashonje.
Bamwe bicara mu mwiza, umwijima w’urupfu, ari imbohe ziri mu mubabaro mu minyororo y’ivyuma,
kuko batumviye ivyo Imana yategetse bagakengera imigambi y’Iyisumbavyose.
Nuko ibashira ku bikebere; baratsitara, ntibaronka uwo kubatabara.
Maze mu magorwa yabo batakambira Uhoraho , na we arabakiza, abakura mu marushwa yabo.
Yabakuye mu mwijima, umwijima w’urupfu, acagagura iminyororo yabo.
Abo nibashime Uhoraho Ku bw’urukundo rwiwe rudashira, n’ibikorwa bihambaye yakoreye abana b’abantu,
kuko yamenye inzugi z’imiringa agacagagura ibihindizo vy’ivyuma.
Bamwe babaye ibipfu kubera inzira zabo mbi bagira amagorwa ku bwo kugabitanya kwabo.
Banka kurya indya zose bituma begereza ku marembo y’urupfu.
Maze mu magorwa yabo batakambira Uhoraho , na we arabakiza, abakura mu marushwa yabo.
Yarungitse ijambo ryiwe, arabakiza; arabatabara abakuye mu rupfu.
Abo nibashime Uhoraho Ku bw’urukundo rwiwe rudashira, n’ibikorwa bihambaye yakoreye abana b’abantu.
Nibamushikanire ibimazi vy’ishimwe bavuge ivyo yakoze mu ndirimbo z’umunezero.
Bamwe bagiye n’ubwato mu kiyaga; bari abadandaza hejuru y’amazi y’inkomezi.
Babonye ibikorwa vy’ Uhoraho , ibitangaza yakoreye i bwina.
Kuko yavuze akavyura umuyaga wavyuye imipfunda.
Baraduze baja hejuru bongera baramanuka i bwina; muri ayo marushwa barihebura.
Barazunguriwe, baradandabagirana nk’imborerwa; bari babaye nk’abatagira ubwenge.
Maze mu magorwa yabo, batakambiye Uhoraho , na we abakura mu marushwa yabo.
Yahagaritse ingunza y’amazi; imikuba iratekereza.
Baranezerewe aho catekereza, na we arabarongora abashitsa aho bipfuza gushika.
Abo nibashime Uhoraho Ku bw’urukundo rwiwe rudashira, n’ibikorwa bihambaye yakoreye abana b’abantu.
Nibamushire hejuru bari mw’ikoraniro ry’abantu bamuhimbarize mw’ikoraniro ry’abakuru.
Yahinduye inzuzi ubugaragwa, imigezi itemba ayihindura isi igadutse,
isi yimbuka nayo ayihindura igihugu c’umunyu, kubera ibibi vy’abahaba.
Yahinduye ubugaragwa amariba y’amazi n’isi igadutse ahantu h’amariba;
aho ni ho yahaye abashonje kubaho, maze bubaka igisagara aho kuba.
Babiba mu mirima batera n’imizabibu bimbura vyinshi;
abaha umugisha, n’ibitigiri vyabo birongerekana, kandi ntiyemera ko amasho yabo agabanuka.
Hanyuma igitigiri cabo kiragabanuka, bacishwa bugufi n’agahahazo, ivyago n’umubabaro;
Imana ituma abaganwa bamaramara ituma bangara mu bugaragwa butagira inzira.
Ariko yakuye abakene mu mubabaro wabo aca agwiza imiryango yabo nk’imikuku.
Abatunganye barabibona baranezerwa, ariko abanyakibi bazibwa akanwa.
Nihaba hariho umunyabwenge niyiyumvire kuri ivyo kugira ngo atahure ibikorwa vy’urukundo vy’ Uhoraho .

verses.text: Umutima wanje urashikamye ewe Mana; nzoririmba ncurarange n’umushaha wanje wose.
Ewe nanga nawe kembe, nimwikangure! Nzovyura umutwenzi.
Ewe Uhoraho , nzoguhimbaza mu moko menshi; nzokuririmba ndi mu mahanga.
Kuko urukundo rwawe ari rwinshi, rushika no mu majuru; ubwizigirwa bwawe bushika no mu birere.
Nushirwe hejuru, ewe Mana, hejuru y’amajuru; icubahiro cawe gikwire kw’isi yose.
Dutabarishe ukuboko kwawe kw’i buryo, kandi utwishure; kugira ngo abo ukunda bakire.
Imana yavugiye ahera hayo iti: “Mu kunesha kwanje nzogaburamwo ibice Shekemu, kandi nzogeresha umugozi ikiyaya c’i Sukoti.
Gileyadi ni uwanje, kandi Manase ni uwanje; Efurayimu ni we nkofero yanje, Yuda ni icumu ryanje ry’ubugabe.
Mowabu ni ibesani niyogeramwo, kuri Edomu ni ho nkunkumurira ibirato vyanje; Kuri Filisitiya ni ho nivugira amazina yo kunesha.”
Ni nde azonshikana mu gisagara gikikujwe inzitiro? Ni nde azondongora gushika kuri Edomu?
Mbega si wewe ga Mana wadutaye, Ntube ukijana n’ingabo zacu ku rugamba?
Dufashe kugwanya umwansi, kuko ugutabara kw’abantu ata co kumaze.
Turi kumwe n’Imana tuzonesha intambara, Kandi izosiribanga abansi bacu.

headings.text: Ni indirimbo. Ni Zaburi ya Dawidi.

verses.text: Mana, wewe mpimbaza, ntucereze,
kuko abantu babi kandi b’ingunge buguruye akanwa kabo ngo bangwanye; bavugishije indimi zabo bambeshera.
Barankikuje bavuga amajambo y’urwanko; banteye ata nyanduruko.
Aho kunkunda nk’uko ndabakunda, baranyagiriza, ariko ndi umuntu asenga.
Banyishuye ibibi ku vyiza nabakoreye, n’urwanko mu gishingo c’urukundo.
Tuma uwo kugwanya umwansi wanje; uwumwagiriza nahagarare i buryo bwiwe.
Niyacirwa urubanza, natsindwe, kandi amasengesho yiwe amutsindishe.
Ese imisi yiwe yoba mike; agasubirizwa mu mabanga yiwe y’uburongozi.
Ese abana biwe boba impfuvyi umugore wiwe na we akaba umupfakazi.
Ese abana biwe bokwama bangara basega; bakirukanwa bakava mu mazu yabo yahindutse imisaka.
Ese uwo aheraniye yofata ivyo afise vyose; abanyamahanga bagasahura ivyo yaruhiye vyose.
Ese yobura n’umwe amugirira neza canke ngo agirire akagongwe impfuvyi ziwe.
Ese uruvyaro rwiwe rwohona, amazina yabo agasibanganywa mu bo mu runganwe ruzoza.
Ese ukugabitanya kwa ba sekuruza kwokwibukwa imbere y’ Uhoraho ; icaha ca nyina nticigere gisibanganywa.
Ese ivyaha vyabo vyokwama imbere y’ Uhoraho imisi yose, kugira ngo asibanganye amazina yabo mw’isi.
Kuko atigeze yiyumvira ivyo kugira neza, ariko yababaje umukene gushika ku rupfu n’umugorwa n’uwufise umutima umenetse.
Yakunze kuvuma; nibimugarukeko. Ntiyanezererwa no guhezagira; nibibe kure yiwe.
Yambara kuvuma nk’impuzu; kwinjiye mu mubiri wiwe nk’amazi, no mu magufa yiwe nk’amavuta.
Nikube nk’ikoti izingiriwe kuri we, nk’umukanda akenyeje ibihe vyose.
Ivyo nibibe ingero Uhoraho aha abanyagiriza, abamvuga nabi.
Ariko wewe Uhoraho Nyeninganji, ntabara kubera izina ryawe; ku bwo kugira neza kw’urukundo rwawe, nkiza.
Kuko ndi umukene n’umugorwa, kandi umutima wanje unkomerekeyemwo.
Ndiko ndahera numva kurya kw’igitutu co ku mugoroba; bampiga nk’uko bahiga inzige.
Amavi yanje adendebuwe no kwisonzesha; umubiri wanje uranyankabiranye kubera kwonda.
Abanyagiriza barancokora; iyo bambonye bazunguza imitwe.
Mfasha, Uhoraho Mana yanje; unkize kubera urukundo rwawe rudashira.
Nibamenye ko ari wewe n’ukuboko kwawe Uhoraho , ko ari wewe wabikoze.
Nibavuma, wewe urahezagira; abantera nibakorwe n’isoni, ariko abasavyi bawe nibanezerwe.
Icompa abanyagiriza bakicwa n’isoni bakambara ibiteterwe nk’ikoti.
Nzoshira ijwi hejuru nshima Uhoraho ; nzomuhimbariza mw’ikoraniro rinini.
Kuko ahagaze i buryo bw’abakene, ngo abakize amaboko y’abagomba kubatsindisha.

headings.text: Yahawe umukuru w’abaririmvyi. Ni iya Dawidi. Ni Zaburi.

verses.text: Uhoraho yabariye umwami wanje ati: “Icara i buryo bwanje kugeza abansi bawe bose ndabashize musi y’ibirenge vyawe.”
Uhoraho azokuza icumu ry’ubugabe ryawe rihambaye kuva i Siyoni, avuga ati: “Ganza hagati y’abansi bawe!”
Ingabo zawe zizoba zifise ugushaka ku musi wawe w’intambara. Bashazishije ukwera, imisore yawe izoza aho uri imeze nk’ikime co mu gitondo ka kare.
Uhoraho ararahiye, kandi ntazohindura ico yavuze: “Uri umuherezi w’ibihe bidashira, mu buryo bwa Melekisedeki.”
Uhoraho ari i buryo bwawe; azomenagura abami ku musi w’uburake bwiwe.
Azocira urubanza amahanga, arundanye imivyimba amenagure abatware bo kw’isi yose.
Azonywa ku mugezi w’iruhande y’inzira, uko ni ko azoraramura umutwe wiwe.

headings.text: Ni Zaburi ya Dawidi.

verses.text: Himbaza Uhoraho . Nzohimbaza Uhoraho n’umutima wanje wose ndi mw’ikoraniro ry’abatunganye no mu bantu benshi.
Ibikorwa vy’ Uhoraho birahambaye; biserangurwa n’ababinezerererwa.
Ivyo akora birakayangana kandi bifise icubahiro, kandi ukugororoka kwiwe kwamaho ibihe bidashira.
Yatumye ibitangaza vyiwe vyibukwa; Uhoraho ni umunyabuntu kandi agira imbabazi.
Ategekanya ivyokurya ku bamwubaha; yibuka isezerano ryiwe ibihe vyose.
Yeretse abantu biwe inkomezi z’ibikorwa vyiwe, mu kubegurira igihugu cari ic’ayandi mahanga.
Ibikorwa vy’intoke ziwe ni ivyo kwizigirwa kandi biratunganye; ivyo yihanikirije vyose ni ivyo kwizigirwa.
Bihora bihamye ibihe vyose, kandi bishinzwe mu kwizigirwa no mu gutungana.
Yateguye gucungurwa ku bantu biwe; yashizeho isezerano ryiwe ry’ibihe vyose; izina ryiwe ni iryera kandi riteye ubwoba.
Ukwubaha Uhoraho ni kwo tanguriro ry’ubwenge; kandi abitondera ivyo yihanikirije bafise ugutahura gushitse. Uguhimbazwa kube ukwiwe ibihe vyose.
Himbaza Uhoraho . Hahiriwe abubaha Uhoraho , bakanezerererwa amabwirizwa yiwe.
Abana babo bazoba abanyenkomezi mu gihugu; urunganwe rw’abatunganye ruzogira umugisha.
Ubutunzi n’ibitayega biri mu mazu yabo, kandi ukugororoka kwabo kwamaho ibihe bidashira.
No mu mwijima umuco uzotambika ku batunganye, ku banyabuntu buzuye imbabazi bagororoka.
Ni vyiza ko umuntu agira ubuntu akagurana abandi, akadandaza mu kuri.
Ni ukuri abagororotsi ntibazokwigera banyiganyizwa; bazokwibukwa ibihe vyose.
Ntibazotinya inkuru mbi; imitima yabo irashikamye, kuko bizigiye Uhoraho .
Imitima yabo iri amahoro, ntibazotinya; kw’iherezo bazokwibonera ukuneshwa kw’abansi babo.
Batanze isabagire ku bakene, ukugororoka kwabo kwamaho ibihe bidashira; ihembe ryabo rizoshirwa hejuru mu cubahiro.
Abanyakibi bazobibona bababare, bazohekenya amenyo baherengetere; ivyo abanyakibi bipfuza nta co bizoshikako.
Himbaza Uhoraho . Nimuhimbaze Uhoraho , yemwe basavyi biwe; nimuhimbaze izina ry’ Uhoraho .
Izina ry’ Uhoraho nirihimbazwe, uhereye ubu ukageza ibihe vyose.
Uhereye iyo izuba riserukira ukageza iyo rirengera, izina ry’ Uhoraho rikwiye guhimbazwa.
Uhoraho ashizwe hejuru y’amahanga yose, icubahiro ciwe kiri hejuru y’amajuru.
Ni nde ameze nk’ Uhoraho Imana yacu, avyagiye ku ntebe y’ubwami iyo mw’ijuru,
yunamishwa no kuraba amajuru n’isi?
Akura umugorwa mu mukungugu, ashira hejuru umukene, amukuye mu mwavu;
akabicarikana n’abakomeye, abakomeye bo mu bantu biwe.
Ashira umugore w’ingumba mu nzu yiwe akamugira nyina w’abana ahiriwe. Himbaza Uhoraho
Aho Abisirayeli bava muri Egiputa, aho aba Yakobo bava mu bantu b’ururimi rudebagura,
I Buyuda hahindutse ahera h’Imana, muri Isirayeli hahindutse ubwami bwiwe.
Ikiyaga carabibonye kirahunga, Yorodani rusubira inyuma;
imisozi yarasimvye nk’amapfizi y’intama, uturambi na two nk’imyagazi y’intama.
Ni igiki catumye uhunga ga wa kiyaga we? Ni kuki wasubiye inyuma, ewe Yorodani?
Ni kuki, yemwe misozi, mwikinye amatavu nk’amapfizi y’intama, namwe turambi, nk’imyagazi y’intama?
Wa si we, hindira agashitsi imbere y’Uhoraho, imbere y’Imana ya Yakobo,
yahinduye igitandara kiba ikidengeri, urutare akaruhinduramwo isoko y’amazi.
Ntabe ari twebwe, ewe Uhoraho , ntabe ari twebwe ariko icubahiro kibe ic’izina ryawe, ku bw’urukundo rwawe n’ubwizigirwa bwawe.
Ni kuki abanyamahanga bavuga bati: “Imana yabo iri hehe?”
Imana yacu iri mw’ijuru; ikora ibiyihimbara vyose.
Ariko ibigirwamana vyabo ni ifeza n’inzahabu, vyakozwe n’intoke z’abantu.
Bifise akanwa, ariko ntibivuga, bifise amaso, ariko ntibibona.
Bifise amatwi, ariko ntivyumva, bifise amazuru, ariko ntibimoterwa.
Bifise intoke, ariko ntibikorakora, bifise ibirenge, ariko ntibigenda, kandi ntibishobora gusohora ijwi rivuye mu mihogo yavyo.
Ababicura bazomera nka vyo, co kimwe n’abavyizigira bose.
Ewe Isirayeli, nimwizigire Uhoraho ; ni we mutabazi wawe n’inkinzo yawe.
Ab’inzu ya Aroni nimwizigire Uhoraho ; ni we mutabazi wanyu n’inkinzo yanyu.
Yemwe abamwubaha mwese, nimwizigire Uhoraho ; ni we mutabazi wanyu n’inkinzo yanyu.
Uhoraho aratwibuka kandi azoduha umugisha: azoha umugisha abantu biwe ba Isirayeli, azoha umugisha inzu ya Aroni,
azoha umugisha abubaha Uhoraho ; aboroshe n’abahambaye.
Uhoraho naguhe gusagarara, wewe n’abana bawe.
Uragahabwa umugisha n’ Uhoraho , Umuremyi w’ijuru n’isi.
Ijuru risumba ayandi ni iry’ Uhoraho , ariko isi yayihaye abana b’abantu.
Si abapfuye bazohimbaza Uhoraho , abamanuka baja ahantu h’agacerere;
ni twebwe tuzoshira hejuru Uhoraho , uhereye none ukageza ibihe vyose. Himbaza Uhoraho .
Nkunda Uhoraho , kuko yumvise ijwi ryanje; yumvise ugutakamba kwanje.
Kuko yanteze ugutwi, nzomwambaza igihe cose nzoba nkiriho.
Imigozi y’urupfu yaranyizingiriyeko, umubabaro wo mu mva warandenze; narengewe n’umubabaro n’agahinda.
Maze nambaza izina ry’ Uhoraho nti: “ Uhoraho , nkiza!”
Uhoraho ni umunyabuntu kandi aragororotse; Imana yacu yuzuye imbabazi.
Uhoraho azigama ba nyarucari; aho nacishwa bugufi, yarantabaye.
Mutima wanje, subira utekane, kuko Uhoraho yakugiriye neza.
Kuko wewe Uhoraho , wankuye mu rupfu, amaso yanje ukayakiza kurira, ibirenge vyanje ukabikiza gutsitara,
kugira ngo ngendere imbere y’ Uhoraho mw’isi y’abazima.
Nari nizigiye Uhoraho aho navuga nti: “Ndababajwe cane”;
mu mubabaro wanje naravuze nti: “Abantu bose ni ababeshi.”
Uhoraho nzomwitura iki ku vyiza vyose yankoreye?
Nzoshira hejuru igikombe c’agakiza nambaze izina ry’ Uhoraho .
Nzoshitsa ivyo nasezeraniye Uhoraho imbere y’abantu biwe.
Mu nyonga z’ Uhoraho Urupfu rw’abizigirwa biwe ni urw’igiciro.
Vy’ukuri ndi umusavyi wawe, Uhoraho ; ndagukorera nk’uko mama yabikora; wankuye mu minyororo narimwo.
Nzogushikanira ikimazi co gushima nambaze izina ry’ Uhoraho .
Nzoshitsa ivyo nasezeraniye Uhoraho mu maso y’abantu biwe,
mu birimba vy’Ingoro yawe, Uhoraho ; hagati muri wewe, Yerusalemu. Himbaza Uhoraho .
Nimuhimbaze Uhoraho , yemwe mahanga mwese; mumushire hejuru, namwe moko yose.
Kuko urukundo adukunda ari rwinshi, kandi ukwizigirwa kw’ Uhoraho kwamaho ibihe vyose. Himbaza Uhoraho .
Nimushime Uhoraho kuko ari mwiza; Kuko urukundo rwiwe rwamaho ibihe bidashira.
Abisirayeli nibavuge bati: “Urukundo rwiwe rwamaho ibihe bidashira.”
Ab’inzu ya Aroni nibavuge bati: “Urukundo rwiwe rwamaho ibihe bidashira.”
Abubaha Uhoraho nibavuge bati: “Urukundo rwiwe rwamaho ibihe bidashira.”
Igihe nari nzigirijwe, natakambiye Uhoraho ; aca anshira ahagutse.
Uhoraho ari kumwe nanje; sinzotinya. None abantu buntu bongira iki?
Uhoraho ari kumwe nanje; ni we mutabazi wanje. Ni co gituma nzokwibonera ukuneshwa kw’abansi banje.
Ni vyiza guhungira k’ Uhoraho kuruta kwizigira abana b’abantu.
Ni vyiza guhungira k’ Uhoraho kuruta kwizigira abashizwe hejuru.
Amahanga yose yarankikuje, ariko mw’izina ry’ Uhoraho ndayarandura.
Yankikuje impande zose, ariko mw’izina ry’ Uhoraho ndayarandura.
Yarankikuje nk’inzuki, ariko batongotse vuba nk’umuriro w’amahwa; mw’izina ry’ Uhoraho ndabarandura.
Narasunitswe nsubizwa inyuma ngera hafi yo gutemba, ariko Uhoraho arantabara.
Uhoraho ni we nkomezi zanje n’indirimbo yanje; yampindukiye agakiza.
Impundu z’umunezero n’intsinzi zirumvikana mu mahema y’abagororotsi ngo: “Ukuboko kw’i buryo kw’ Uhoraho kwakoze ivy’inkomezi!
Ukuboko kw’i buryo kw’ Uhoraho gushizwe hejuru; ukuboko kw’i buryo kw’ Uhoraho kwakoze ibikomeye!”
Sinzopfa ariko nzobaho, maze nzokwamamaza ivyo Uhoraho yakoze.
Uhoraho yarampanye bikomeye, ariko ntiyandekuriye mu maboko y’urupfu.
Nyugururira amarembo y’abagororotsi; nzokwinjira maze nshimire Uhoraho .
Iri ni irembo ry’ Uhoraho iryo abagororotsi bakwiye kwinjiramwo.
Nzogushima, kuko wanyishuye; wampindukiye agakiza.
Ibuye abubatsi bagaye ni ryo ryahindutse irigumya imfuruka;
Uhoraho ni we yabikoze, kandi ni igitangaza mu maso yacu.
Uhoraho yabikoze kuri uwu musi nyene; tunezerwe uwu musi kandi duhimbarwe.
Uhoraho we, dukize! Uhoraho we, duhe intsinzi!
Harahezagiwe uwuje mw’izina ry’ Uhoraho . Turabahezagiye turi mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho .
Uhoraho ni Imana, kandi yatumye umuco wiwe udukayanganira. Dufate amashami mu ntoke, tuje mu rugendo rudushikana ku mahembe y’igicaniro.
Uri Imana yanje, nanje nzoguhimbaza; uri Imana yanje, nanje nzogushira hejuru.
Nimushime Uhoraho kuko ari mwiza; kuko urukundo rwiwe rwamaho ibihe bidashira.
Hahiriwe abatunganye mu nzira zabo, bagenda bisunga Ivyagezwe vy’ Uhoraho .
Hahiriwe abitondera ivyo yihanikirije, bakamuronderana umutima wabo wose;
ntibakora ibibi, ariko bagakurikira inzira ziwe.
Washizeho ivyo wihanikirije kugira ngo abantu bavyitondere.
Icompa inzira zanje zigatumbera mu kwitondera ivyo washinze!
Aho ni ho ntazomaramara ninashira umutima ku mabwirizwa yawe.
Nzogutazira n’umutima utunganye uko nzokwiga ivyagezwe vyawe bigororotse.
Nzokwumvira amategeko yawe; ntumpebe rwose! Beti
Ni gute umusore yoshobora kuguma mu nzira y’ugutungana? Ni mu kubaho nk’uko ijambo ryawe rivuga.
Nzokuronderana umutima wanje wose; ntuze undeke ngo mve mu mabwirizwa yawe.
Nabitse ijambo ryawe mu mutima wanje kugira ngo sindagucumureko.
Uhimbazwe, Uhoraho ; unyigishe ivyo wihanikirije.
Iminwa yanje isubiramwo ivyagezwe vyose biva mu kanwa kawe.
Jewe nezererwa kwitondera ivyo washinze nk’uko umuntu anezererwa ubutunzi bwinshi.
Jewe ndimbura ivyo wihanikirije kandi nshira umutima ku nzira zawe.
Jewe mpimbarwa n’ivyo washinze; sinzokengera ijambo ryawe. Gimeli
Girira neza umusavyi wawe umwanya nkiriho, kugira ngo numvire ijambo ryawe.
Humura amaso yanje kugira ngo mbone ibitangaza vyo mu Vyagezwe vyawe.
Ndi inyambukira kw’isi; ntumpishe amabwirizwa yawe.
Umutima wanje umazwe no kwipfuza ivyagezwe vyawe ibihe vyose.
Ukankamira abibone, bariko umuvumo, abazimira bakava mu mabwirizwa yawe.
Unkureko agacokoro n’agakengerwe, kuko nitondera ivyo wihanikirije.
Naho abatware bicara hamwe ngo bamvuge nabi, umusavyi wawe nzorimbura amategeko yawe.
Ivyo wihanikirije ni vyo bimpimbara; ni vyo bingira inama. Daleti
Ndyamye hasi mu mukungugu; zigama ubugingo bwanje nk’uko ijambo ryawe ryavuze.
Nakwiganiye ivy’inzira zanje, nawe uranyishura; nyigisha amategeko yawe.
Mpa gutahura inzira y’ivyo wihanikirije, kugira ngo ndimbure ku vyo wakoze bihambaye.
Umutima wanje uremerewe n’umubabaro; nkomeza nk’uko ijambo ryawe ryavuze.
Nshira kure y’inzira z’ubugunge, ngirira ubuntu unyigishe Ivyagezwe vyawe.
Nahisemwo inzira z’ukwizigirwa; umutima wanje nawushize ku vyagezwe vyawe.
Jewe numira ku vyo wihanikirije, ewe Uhoraho ; ntuze undeke ngo maramare.
Niruka mu nzira y’amabwirizwa yawe, kuko waguye ugutahura kwanje. He
Uhoraho , nyigisha inzira z’ivyo wihanikirije, kugira ngo ndazikurikire gushika kw’iherezo.
Numpe ugutahura, kugira ngo nitondere Ivyagezwe vyawe kandi ngo ndavyitondere n’umutima wanje wose.
Ntumbereza mu nzira y’amabwirizwa yawe, kuko aho ari ho mpimbarirwa.
Hindukiriza umutima wanje ku vyo wihanikirije ndawukure ku vy’inyungu mbi.
Hindukiriza amaso yanje kure y’ibitagira ikimazi; uzigame ubugingo bwanje nk’uko ijambo ryawe rivuga.
Shitsa isezerano ryawe ku musavyi wawe, kugira ngo wubahwe.
Shira kure ibiteterwe ntinya, kuko ivyagezwe vyawe ari vyiza.
Mbega ukuntu nipfuza ivyo washinze! Uzigamire ubugingo bwanje mu kugororoka kwawe. Wawu
Icompa urukundo rwawe rudashira rukanzako, ewe Uhoraho , n’agakiza kawe, nk’uko isezerano ryawe rivuga;
ni ho nzoshobora kwishura uwunkengereye wese, kuko nizigira ijambo ryawe.
Ntuze wigere ukura ijambo ryawe ry’ukuri mu kanwa kanje, kuko ivyizigiro vyanje nabishize mu vyagezwe vyawe.
Nzokwama nitondera Ivyagezwe vyawe, ibihe n’ibihe.
Nzogendera mu mwidegemvyo, kuko nize ivyo wihanikirije.
Nzovuga ivyo wigishije imbere y’abami kandi ntibizomaramaza,
kuko nezererwa amabwirizwa yawe, kandi ndayakunda.
Ntuma amaboko yanje amabwirizwa yawe nkunda, kugira ngo ndimbure ku vyo washinze. Zayini
Wibuke ijambo wabwiye umusavyi wawe, kuko wampaye ivyizigiro.
Ikindemesha mu mubabaro wanje ni iki: Isezerano ryawe rizigama ubugingo bwanje.
Abibone barancokora ata kigongwe, ariko simva mu Vyagezwe vyawe.
Uhoraho , nibuka ivyagezwe vyawe vya kera, maze bikandemesha.
Ndababara cane kubera abanyakibi, kuko bahevye Ivyagezwe vyawe.
Ivyo washinze ni vyo shimikiro ry’indirimbo yanje aho ndi hose nk’ingenzi.
Uhoraho we, mw’ijoro nibuka izina ryawe, kugira ngo ngumye Ivyagezwe vyawe.
Ng’iki ico nagize umwuga: ni ukwitondera ivyo wihanikirije. Heti
Uhoraho , ni wewe mugabane wanje; nasezeranye kwumvira amajambo yawe.
Narondeye mu nyonga hawe n’umutima wanje wose; ngirira ubuntu nk’uko wasezeranye.
Niyumviriye ku nzira zanje kandi nahindukirije intambuko zanje ku vyo wihanikirije.
Nzokwihuta kandi sinzotebagana kwitondera amabwirizwa yawe.
Naho abanyakibi bombohesha ibiziriko, sinzokwibagira Ivyagezwe vyawe.
Igicugu kigeze hagati nzovyuka ndagushimire ku bw’ivyagezwe vyawe bigororotse.
Ndi incuti y’abakwubaha bose, abakurikira ivyo wihanikirije bose.
Isi yuzuye urukundo rwawe, Uhoraho ; nyigisha amategeko yawe. Teti
Wagiriye neza umusavyi wawe nk’uko ijambo ryawe rivuga, Uhoraho .
Nyigisha ukumenya n’uguca iziroranye, kuko nizigiye amabwirizwa yawe.
Imbere yuko mbabazwa narazimiye, ariko ubu nitondera ijambo ryawe.
Uri mwiza, kandi n’ivyo ukora ni vyiza; nyigisha amategeko yawe.
Naho abibone banyambitse ibara bambeshera, nitondera ivyo wihanikirije n’umutima wanje wose.
Imitima yabo yarakomantaye nta co yumva, ariko jeho mpimbarwa n’Ivyagezwe vyawe.
Vyabaye vyiza kuri jewe kubabazwa kugira ngo nige amategeko yawe.
Ivyagezwe vyo mu kanwa kawe bindutira ibihumbi vy’ifeza n’inzahabu. Yodi
Intoke zawe ni zo zandemye zirambumba; numpe ugutahura ngo nige amabwirizwa yawe.
Abakwubaha baze banezerwe nibambona, kuko nizigiye ijambo ryawe.
Uhoraho , ndazi ko ivyagezwe vyawe bigororotse, kandi ko mu bwizigirwa bwawe wandetse ngo mbabazwe.
Icompa urukundo rwawe rukandemesha, nk’uko wasezeraniye umusavyi wawe.
Imbabazi zawe nizinzeko kugira ngo mbeho, kuko Ivyagezwe vyawe ari vyo bimpimbara.
Abibone nibamaramare kuko bangiriye nabi ata nyanduruko; ariko nzorimbura ivyo washinze.
Abakwubaha nibampindukirire, abatahura ivyo wihanikirije.
Ese icompa ngakurikira amategeko yawe n’umutima wose, kugira ngo sinze maramare. Kafu
Umutima wanje uciwe intege no kwipfuza agakiza kawe, ariko nizigiye ijambo ryawe.
Amaso yanje ararushe, ariko ararondera isezerano ryawe; ndavuga nti: “mbega uzompoza ryari?”
Naho meze nk’umukuza w’urusato mu mwotsi, sinibagira amategeko yawe.
Umusavyi wawe azogeza hehe kurindira? Uzohana abampama ryari?
Abibone bimvye ibinogo ngo bantege, binyuranye n’Ivyagezwe vyawe.
Amabwirizwa yawe yose ni ayo kwizerwa; ntabara, kuko ndiko ndahamwa ata nyanduruko.
Hari hasigaye gato bakankura kw’isi, ariko sinahevye ivyo washinze.
Mu rukundo rwawe rudashira zigama ubugingo bwanje kugira ngo nitondere ivyo wihanikirije n’akanwa kawe. Lamedi
Ijambo ryawe, Uhoraho , ni iry’ibihe vyose; rihora rihamye mw’ijuru.
Ukwizigirwa kwawe guhoraho uko urunganwe rukurikirana n’urundi; washizeho isi, kandi izokwamaho.
Ivyagezwe vyawe bihoraho kugeza uwu musi, kuko vyose bigukorera.
Iyo ntanezerererwa Ivyagezwe vyawe, mba narahitanywe n’umubabaro wanje.
Sinzokwigera nibagira ivyo wihanikirije, kuko ari vyo wazigamishije ubugingo bwanje.
Unkize kuko ndi uwawe; narondeye ivyo washinze.
Abanyakibi babundiye kunyica, ariko nzozigama ivyagezwe vyawe.
Ibitunganye vyose bifise aho bigarukira, ariko amabwirizwa yawe ntagira akarimbi. Memu
Ese ukuntu nkunda Ivyagezwe vyawe! Ndabirimbura bukarinda bwira.
Amabwirizwa yawe yamana nanje antera kuba umunyabwenge kuruta abansi banje.
Mfise ugutahura kurusha abanyigishije, kuko ndimbura ivyo washinze.
Mfise ugutahura kurengeye abahumure, kuko nubaha ivyo wihanikirije.
Narinze ibirenge vyanje ngo ntibije mu nzira mbi zose kugira ngo nitondere ijambo ryawe.
Sinavuye mu vyagezwe vyawe, kuko ubwawe ari wewe wanyigishije.
Ese ukuntu amajambo yawe ansosera mu kanwa, mu kanwa kanje asosa kurusha ubuki!
Nunguka ugutahura kuvuye mu vyo washinze; ni co gituma nanka inzira zose mbi. Nuni
Ijambo ryawe ni itara rimurikira ibirenge vyanje, ni umuco umurikira mu nzira yanje.
Nararahiye ndisiba, ko nzokurikiza ivyagezwe vyawe bigororotse.
Narababajwe bikomeye; zigama ubugingo bwanje, Uhoraho , nk’uko ijambo ryawe ryavuze.
Uhoraho , akira uguhimbaza kw’akanwa kanje kuvuye ku mutima, maze unyigishe ivyagezwe vyawe.
Naho ngendera hafi y’urupfu, sinzokwibagira Ivyagezwe vyawe.
Abanyakibi banteze umutego, ariko sinazimiye ngo mve mu vyo washinze.
Ivyo wihanikirije ni vyo mugabane wanje ibihe vyose; ni vyo binezereza umutima wanje.
Umutima wanje unezerwa no kwitondera amategeko yawe gushika no kw’iherezo. Sameki
Ndanka abantu b’imitima ibiri, ariko nkunda Ivyagezwe vyawe.
Ni wewe buhungiro bwanje n’inkinzo yanje; nashize ivyizigiro vyanje mw’ijambo ryawe.
Nimumve i ruhande, mwa nkozi z’ibibi mwe, kugira ngo nitondere amabwirizwa y’Imana yanje!
Nshigikira, ewe Mana yanje, nk’uko isezerano ryawe rivuga, ni ho nzobaho; ntureke ivyizigiro vyanje ngo bibe ivy’impfagusa.
Unshigikire, ni ho nzotabarwa; nzokwama nitwararika amategeko yawe.
Abazimira bakava mu mategeko yawe uzobaheba, kuko ubuhumvyi bwabo ata co buzoshikako.
Abanyakibi bose bo kw’isi uzobashibura nk’umwavu; ni co gituma nzokunda ivyo washinze.
Umubiri wanje uhinda agashitsi ku bwo kukwubaha; ivyagezwe vyawe birantangaza. Ayini
Nakoze ibigororotse n’ibitunganye; ntuntererane abancinyiza.
Nuhe umusavyi wawe kuroranirwa; ntureke ngo abibone bancinyize.
Amaso yanje ararushe, yiteze agakiza kawe, yiteze isezerano ryawe rigororotse.
Girira umusavyi wawe nk’uko urukundo rwawe ruri kandi unyigishe amategeko yawe.
Ndi umusavyi wawe; numpe ugusesangura kugira ngo ntahure ivyo washinze.
Uhoraho we, harageze ko ukora kuko ivyagezwe vyawe vyahonyanzwe.
Kuko nkunda amabwirizwa yawe kurusha inzahabu, inzahabu ikuwemwo imyanda yose,
kandi kuko nshira umutima ku vyo washinze, kandi nanka inzira yose mbi. Pe
Ivyo wihanikirije ni vyiza cane; ni co gituma ndavyitondera.
Iyo umuntu amenye ijambo ryawe, abona umuco; abadaciye ubwenge ribaha ugutahura.
Ndasamye kandi ndahuzagizwa, nipfuza amabwirizwa yawe.
Hindukira maze ungirire imbabazi, nk’uko wama ugirira abakunda izina ryawe.
Rongora intambuko zanje nk’uko ijambo ryawe ryavuze; ntureke ngo hagire ikibi kinganza.
Uncungure unkure mu gacinyizo k’abantu, kugira ngo nitondere ivyo wihanikirije.
Umurikishirize umusavyi wawe inyonga zawe unyigishe amategeko yawe.
Imigende y’amosozi itemba iva mu maso yanje, kuko abantu batumvira Ivyagezwe vyawe. Tsade
Uragororotse, ewe Uhoraho , kandi ivyagezwe vyawe biratunganye.
Ivyo washinze biragororotse; ni ivyo kwizigira rwose.
Ishaka ryanje ryaka muri jewe nk’umuriro, kuko abansi banje birengagije amajambo yawe.
Amasezerano yawe yaragejejwe rwose, ni co gituma nanje umusavyi wawe ndayakunda.
Naho ndi umunyantegenke n’inkengerwa, sinibagira ivyo wihanikirije.
Ukugororoka kwawe ni uko ibihe bidashira kandi Ivyagezwe vyawe ni ivy’ukuri.
Ivyago n’akabonge vyanjeko, ariko amabwirizwa yawe ni yo anezera.
Ivyo washinze vyama bigororotse; umpe ugutahura kugira ngo mbeho. Kofu
Ndakwambaje n’umutima wanje wose, nunyishure, ewe Uhoraho , nanje nzokwitondera amategeko yawe.
Ndagutakambiye; nkiza nanje nzokwitondera ivyo washinze.
Mvyuka umutwenzi utaratambika ngatakamba; nizigiye ijambo ryawe.
Nguma ndi maso ijoro ryose, kugira ngo ndimbure amasezerano yawe.
Niwumve ijwi ryanje nk’uko urukundo rwawe rungana; ukingire ubugingo bwanje, Uhoraho , nk’uko ivyagezwe vyawe biri.
Abagira imigabo mibi baranyegereye, ariko bari kure y’Ivyagezwe vyawe.
Ariko weho, Uhoraho , uri hafi yanje, kandi amabwirizwa yawe yose ni ay’ukuri.
Kuva kera nize mu vyo washinze ko wabishinze ngo bigume bihamye gushika ibihe vyose. Reshi
Raba umubabaro wanje maze untabare, kuko ntibagiye Ivyagezwe vyawe.
Mburanira kandi uncungure; uzigame ubugingo bwanje nk’uko wasezeranye.
Agakiza kari kure y’abanyakibi, kuko batarondera kumenya amategeko yawe.
Ikigongwe cawe, ewe Uhoraho , kirahambaye; zigama ubugingo bwanje nk’uko ivyagezwe vyawe bivuga.
Abampiga babaye benshi, ariko sinavuye mu vyo washinze.
Abatizera ndabarabana agakengerwe, kuko batumvira ijambo ryawe.
Raba uko nkunda ivyo wihanikirije; uzigame ubugingo bwanje, Uhoraho , ku bw’urukundo rwawe.
Amajambo yawe yose ni ay’ukuri; ivyagezwe vyawe vyose bigororotse vyamaho ibihe vyose. Sini na Shini
Abakomeye barampiga ata nyanduruko, ariko umutima wanje uhindira agashitsi ijambo ryawe.
Jewe nezererwa isezerano ryawe nk’uwironkeye iminyago myinshi.
Ndanka kandi ngakengera ibinyoma ariko nkunda Ivyagezwe vyawe.
Ndaguhimbaza incuro indwi ku musi ku bw’ivyagezwe vyawe bigororotse.
Abakunda Ivyagezwe vyawe bafise amahoro menshi, kandi ntagishobora kubatsitaza.
Uhoraho , niteze agakiza kawe, kandi nitondera amabwirizwa yawe.
Jewe nitondera ivyo washinze, kuko ndabikunda cane.
Jewe nitondera ivyo wihanikirije n’ivyo washinze, kuko inzira zanje zose uzizi. Tawu
Icompa ugutakamba kwanje kugashika imbere yawe, Uhoraho ; umpe ugutahura nk’uko ijambo ryawe rivuga.
Ukwinginga kwanje nigushike imbere yawe; undokore nk’uko wasezeranye.
Icompa iminwa yanje ikuzura ishimwe, kuko unyigisha ivyo washinze.
Icompa ururimi rwanje rukaririmba ijambo ryawe, kuko amabwirizwa yawe yose agororotse.
Icompa ikiganza cawe kikitegurira kuntabara, kuko nahisemwo ivyo washinze.
Ndipfuza rwose agakiza kawe, ewe Uhoraho , kandi Ivyagezwe vyawe bimpa kunezerwa.
Umpe kubaho ngo ndaguhimbaze, kandi ivyagezwe vyawe binshigikire.
Nazimiye nk’intama yatakaye. Rondera umusavyi wawe, kuko ntibagiye amabwirizwa yawe.
Mu magorwa yanje nambaza Uhoraho , na we akanyishura.
Nkiza, ewe Uhoraho , iminwa ibesha n’indimi z’ibinyoma.
Ewe wa rurimi rw’ibinyoma, mbega azogukorera iki, canke azoguhanisha ikindi nyabaki?
Azoguhanisha imyampi isongoye y’umuhizi, n’amakara y’umurotemu yaka.
Jewe ndagowe kuko mba i Mesheki, nkaba hagati mu mahema y’i Kedari!
Kuva kera cane nabaye hagati y’abanka amahoro.
Jewe nshaka amahoro; ariko iyo mvuze, bo bashaka intambara.

headings.text: Indirimbo yo mw’iduga.

verses.text: Ndunamurira amaso yanje ku misozi; ugutabarwa kwanje kuva hehe?
Ugutabarwa kwanje kuva k’ Uhoraho , Umuremyi w’ijuru n’isi.
Ntazoreka ibirenge vyawe ngo binyerere; uwukuzigama ntazohunyiza;
ni ivy’ukuri, uwuzigama Isirayeli ntazokwigera ahunyiza canke ngo asinzire.
Uhoraho ni we akuzigama; Uhoraho ni we gitutu cawe i buryo bwawe;
izuba ntirizokubabaza ku murango, canke ukwezi mw’ijoro.
Uhoraho azokurinda ikibi cose; azozigama ubugingo bwawe;
Uhoraho azokuzigama amaja n’amaza uhereye ubu ukageza ibihe vyose.

headings.text: Ni indirimbo yo mw’iduga.

verses.text: Naranezerewe igihe bambwira bati: “Tuje mu nzu y’ Uhoraho .”
Ibirenge vyacu bihagaze mu marembo yawe, Yerusalemu.
Yerusalemu hubatswe nk’igisagara cegeranye kandi gifatanye.
Aho ni ho imiryango iduga; imiryango y’ Uhoraho ; ngo bahimbaze izina ry’ Uhoraho nk’uko yabishingiye Isirayeli.
Aho ni ho hari intebe z’imanza, intebe z’inzu ya Dawidi.
Musabire Yerusalemu ironke amahoro muti: “Icompa abagukunda bakaba amahoro.
Icompa mu nzitiro zawe hakaba amahoro n’umutekano ukaba mu minara yawe.”
Kubera umuryango wanje n’abagenzi banje, nzovuga nti: “Amahoro abe muri wewe.”
Kubera inzu y’ Uhoraho Imana yacu, nzokwama ngusabira ivyiza.

headings.text: Ni indirimbo yo mw’iduga. Ni iya Dawidi.

verses.text: Ndunamurira amaso kuri wewe, wewe uvyagiye mw’ijuru.
Nk’uko abasavyi bahanga amaso ukuboko kwa shebuja, nk’uko abasavyikazi bahanga ukuboko ba inabuja, uko ni ko amaso yacu tuyahanze Uhoraho Imana yacu, kugeza aho azotugirira imbabazi.
Tugirire akagongwe, Uhoraho , tugirire akagongwe, kuko twakengererwe igihe kirekire.
Twacokowe igihe kirekire n’agacokoro k’abibone, twakengerewe n’abanyamanyama.

headings.text: Ni indirimbo yo mw’iduga.

verses.text: Iyo Uhoraho ataba mu ruhande rwacu; Abisirayeli nibavuge batyo;
iyo Uhoraho ataba mu ruhande rwacu igihe abantu badutera,
baba baratumize miyonzwa tukibona aho uburake bwabo bwatuziriringira,
isuri iba yaraturengeye, imipfunda iba yaraturenzeko,
amazi asuriranya aba yaradutembanye.
Uhoraho ahimbazwe, ataturetse ngo dutabagurwe n’amenyo yabo.
Ducitse mu mutego nk’inyoni tuvuye mu mutego w’umutezi; umutego uracitse, natwe tuwuvuyemwo turakira.
Ugutabarwa kwacu kuri mw’izina ry’ Uhoraho , Umuremyi w’ijuru n’isi.

headings.text: Ni indirimbo yo mw’iduga. Ni iya Dawidi.

verses.text: Abizigiye Uhoraho bameze nk’umusozi Siyoni, udashobora kunyiganyizwa, ariko uhora ushikamye ibihe vyose.
Nk’uko imisozi ikikije Yerusalemu, ni ko Uhoraho akikije abantu biwe uhereye ubu ukageza ibihe bidashira.
Icumu ry’ubugabe ry’umunyakibi ntirizokwama rishinze mu gihugu cahawe abagororotsi, kuko abagororotsi bohava bakoresha amaboko yabo ibibi.
Uhoraho , girira neza abeza, abatunganye mu mutima.
Ariko abahindukira bakaja mu nzira zigoramye Uhoraho azobirukanana n’inkozi z’ikibi. Amahoro abe kuri Isirayeli.

headings.text: Ni indirimbo yo mw’iduga.

verses.text: Hamwe Uhoraho yagarukana i Siyoni abajanwe ari inyagano, twari tumeze nk’abarota.
Akanwa kacu kari kuzuye ibitwengatwenge indimi zacu zari zuzuye indirimbo z’umunezero. Maze biravugwa mu mahanga ngo: “ Uhoraho yabakoreye ibikomeye.”
Uhoraho yadukoreye ibikomeye, natwe turanezerewe.
Uhoraho garukana abacu bajanywe ari inyagano, bamere nk’imigezi y’i Negebu.
Ababiba barira bazokwimbura baririmba.
Abasohoka barira, bajanye imbuto kubiba, bazogarukana indirimbo z’umunezero, bikoreye ivyimburwa.

headings.text: Ni indirimbo yo mw’iduga.

verses.text: Iyo Uhoraho atari we yubaka inzu, abubatsi baba baruhira ubusa. Iyo Uhoraho atari we arinze igisagara, abararirizi babera maso ubusa.
Muvyukira kare ubusa mukaryama mutevye, mucumukura ngo muronke ivyokurya; kuko abo ikunda ibibahera mw’itiro.
Abana ni umugabane uva k’ Uhoraho , uruvyaro ni impera atanga.
Nk’uko imyampi imera mu kuboko kw’umuhizi ni ko n’abana bo mu buto bamera.
Hahiriwe umuntu yujuje umutana wiwe imyampi nk’iyo. Ntibazomaramara nibahangana n’abababuranya mu bucamanza.

headings.text: Ni indirimbo yo mw’iduga. Ni iya Salomo.

verses.text: Hahiriwe uwubaha Uhoraho wese, akagenda mu nzira ziwe.
Uzorya ivyo ubutame bwawe bwamye; imigisha n’amahirwe bizoba ivyawe.
Umugore wawe azoba nk’umuzabibu wama cane mu nzu yawe; abana bawe bazoba nk’utugemwe twa elayo bakikuje imeza yawe.
Egome, uwo ni wo uzoba umugisha w’umuntu yubaha Uhoraho .
Uhoraho aguhe umugisha uva i Siyoni; uze ubone amahirwe ya Yerusalemu mu misi yose y’ukubaho kwawe.
Uze urambe kugira ngo wibonere abuzukuru bawe; amahoro abe kuri Isirayeli.

headings.text: Ni indirimbo yo mw’iduga.

verses.text: “Barangwanije cane kuva nkiri muto.” Abisirayeli nibavuge batyo:
“Barangwanije cane kuva mu buto bwanje, ariko ntibanesheje.
Abarimyi barimye ku mugongo wanje bahaciye imirongo miremire.
Ariko Uhoraho aragororotse; yacagaguye imigozi y’abanyakibi.”
Icompa abanka Siyoni bose bagasubira inyuma bamaramaye.
Icompa bakamera nk’ivyatsi vyameze ku nzu, vyuma bitarakura;
umwimbuzi ntashobora kuvyuzuza ibiganza vyiwe, canke uwegeranya ngo aronke ivyo guteruza amaboko;
Icompa ababarengana ntibababwire bati: “Umugisha w’ Uhoraho ubane na we; tubahezagiye mw’izina ry’ Uhoraho .”

headings.text: Ni indirimbo yo mw’iduga.

verses.text: Uhoraho ndagutakambira, bivuye i bwina;
Niwumve ijwi ryanje, ewe Mana. Utege amatwi ukwinginga kwanje.
Iyaba wama wibuka ivyaha, ewe Uhoraho , ni nde yohagarara?
Ariko ufise uguharira hafi yawe, kugira ngo dushobore kugukorera, tukwubashe.
Niteze Uhoraho , ubugingo bwanje bwose buramwiteze kandi ivyizigiro vyanje biri kw’ijambo ryiwe.
Niteze Imana kurusha uko abararirizi barindira ko buca, kurusha uko abararirizi barorera ko buca.
Ewe Isirayeli, niwizigire Uhoraho , kuko hafi yiwe ari ho urukundo rudashira ruri n’ugucungurwa gushitse.
Ni we ubwiwe azokwicungurira Abisirayeli abakure mu vyaha vyabo.

headings.text: Ni indirimbo yo mw’iduga.

verses.text: Umutima wanje ntiwishira hejuru, Uhoraho , amaso yanje ntiyibona; sinivanga n’ibintu vyo hejuru canke ibintu bindengeye.
Ariko naratekereje ndacereza, meze nk’umwana acutse ari i ruhande ya nyina; nk’umwana acutse uko ni ko ntekereje.
Ewe Isirayeli, niwizigire Uhoraho uhereye none kugeza ibihe vyose.

headings.text: Ni indirimbo yo mw’iduga. Ni iya Dawidi.

verses.text: Uhoraho , niwibuke Dawidi n’amarushwa yiwe yose.
Yarahiye Uhoraho indahiro, yasezeraniye Inyenkomezi ya Yakobo ati:
“Sinzokwinjira mu nzu yanje canke ngo nurire uburiri bwanje,
sinzokwemerera amaso yanje gusinzira canke ingohe zanje guhunyiza,
kugeza aho nzoronkera Uhoraho ikibanza, inzu y’Inyenkomezi ya Yakobo.”
Twavyumviye muri Efurata, twabisanze mu gahinga k’i Yayari ngo:
“Nimuze tuje mu ngoro yiwe, nimuze dusengere ku ndava yiwe, tuti:
‘Haguruka, ewe Uhoraho , uze mu buruhukiro bwawe, wewe n’Isandugu ari co ki kimenyetso c’inkomezi zawe.
Abaherezi bawe nibambare ukugororoka kwawe, abizigirwa bawe bavuze impundu.’ ”
Ku bwa Dawidi umusavyi wawe, ntushiburire kure uwo warobanuje amavuta.
Uhoraho yarahiye Dawidi indahiro, ni iy’ukuri ntazokwisubirako ngo: “Umwe wo mu ruvyaro rwawe nzomwimika ku ntebe yawe y’ubwami.
Abana bawe nibagumya isezerano ryanje n’ivyo nashinze nkabibigisha, nuko abana babo bazokwicara ku ntebe yawe y’ubwami ibihe vyose.”
Kuko Uhoraho yatoranije Siyoni, yavyipfuje ari iwe avuga ati:
“Aha ni ahantu hanje ho kuruhukira ibihe n’ibihe; aha ni ho nzovyagira nganze, kuko navyipfuje;
Nzohaha umugisha w’ibintu, abakene baho bazohazwa ivyokurya.
Nzokwambika abaherezi baho agakiza, n’abizigirwa baho bazokwama bavuza impundu!
Aha ni ho nzotuma ihembe rya Dawidi rikura kandi nzodomeka itara ry’uwo narobanuje amavuta.
Nzotuma abansi biwe bamaramara, ariko umutwe wiwe uzosharizwa n’urugori rukayangana.”

headings.text: Ni indirimbo yo mw’iduga.

verses.text: Ese ingene ari vyiza kandi bihimbaye iyo abantu b’Imana babana mu bumwe!
Bimeze nk’amavuta y’igiciro kinini asutswe ku mutwe, agatembera ku bwanwa, agatembera ku bwanwa bwa Aroni, no ku buyonga bw’ikanzu yiwe.
Ni nk’ikime co ku musozi Herumoni gitembera ku musozi Siyoni. Kuko aho ni ho Uhoraho asuka umugisha wiwe, mbere n’ubugingo kugeza ibihe vyose.

headings.text: Ni indirimbo yo mw’iduga; Ni iya Dawidi.

verses.text: Nimuhimbaze Uhoraho , yemwe basavyi b’ Uhoraho mwese, mwebwe mukorera mu nzu y’ Uhoraho mugakesha ijoro.
Nimutarike ibiganza vyanyu hejuru muri mu Ngoro, muhimbaze Uhoraho .
Uhoraho aguhezagire ari i Siyoni, ni we Muremyi w’ijuru n’isi.

headings.text: Ni indirimbo yo mw’iduga.

verses.text: Himbaza Uhoraho . Nimuhimbaze izina ry’ Uhoraho ; mumuhimbaze, yemwe basavyi biwe,
mwebwe mukorera mu nzu y’ Uhoraho , mu birimba vy’Ingoro y’Imana yanyu.
Nimuhimbaze Uhoraho , kuko Uhoraho ari mwiza; muririmbe mushima izina ryiwe, kuko ari vyo bihimbaye.
Kuko Uhoraho yatoranije Yakobo ngo abe uwiwe, Isirayeli ngo amubere inyegu yiwe.
Ndazi ko Uhoraho ahambaye, ko umwami wacu ahambaye asumba ibigirwamana vyose.
Uhoraho akora ibimuhimbaye vyose, mw’ijuru no mw’isi, mu biyaga no mw’idamba ryavyo.
Atuma ibicu biva ku mpera z’isi; atuma umuravyo n’imvura agasohora umuyaga awukuye mu bubiko bwawo.
Yishe imfura zo muri Egiputa, imfura zo mu bantu n’ibikoko.
Yarungitse ibimenyetso n’ibitangaza hagati muri mwebwe, muri Egiputa, kugwanya Farawo n’abasavyi biwe.
Yatsinze hasi amahanga yica abami bahambaye;
Sihoni umwami w’Abamori, Ogi umwami w’i Bashani, n’abami bose b’i Kanani;
maze atanga igihugu cabo ngo kibe umugabane, umugabane w’abantu biwe ba Isirayeli.
Izina ryawe, Uhoraho ryamaho ibihe vyose, no kuba rurangiranwa kwawe, ewe Uhoraho , uko urunganwe ruzokurikirana n’urundi.
Kuko Uhoraho azocira iziroranye abantu biwe agirire akagongwe abasavyi biwe.
Ibigirwamana vy’amahanga ni ifeza n’inzahabu, vyakozwe n’intoke z’abantu.
Bifise akanwa, ariko ntibivuga, bifise amaso, ariko ntibibona.
Bifise amatwi, ariko ntivyumva, kandi nta mpwemu ziri mu kanwa kavyo.
Ababicura bazomera nka vyo, co kimwe n’abavyizigira bose.
Yemwe Bisirayeli mwese nimuhimbaze Uhoraho ; ab’inzu ya Aroni, nimuhimbaze Uhoraho ;
Ab’inzu ya Lewi, nimuhimbaze Uhoraho ; abamwubaha mwese, nimuhimbaze Uhoraho .
Uhoraho ahimbarizwe i Siyoni, Uhoraho aba i Yerusalemu. Himbaza Uhoraho .
Nimushimire Uhoraho , kuko ari mwiza. Urukundo rwiwe rwamaho ibihe bidashira.
Nimushimire Uhoraho aganza imana zose. Urukundo rwiwe rwamaho ibihe bidashira.
Nimushimire Umwami aganza abami: Urukundo rwiwe rwamaho ibihe bidashira.
Ni we wenyene akora ibitangaza, Urukundo rwiwe rwamaho ibihe bidashira.
Ni we yaremesheje amajuru ubwenge, Urukundo rwiwe rwamaho ibihe bidashira.
Uwashanje isi hejuru y’amazi, Urukundo rwiwe rwamaho ibihe bidashira.
Uwaremye ivyaka binini, Urukundo rwiwe rwamaho ibihe bidashira.
Izuba ryo kuganza umurango, Urukundo rwiwe rwamaho ibihe bidashira.
Ukwezi n’inyenyeri vyo kuganza ijoro, Urukundo rwiwe rwamaho ibihe bidashira.
Uwahoneje imfura zo muri Egiputa, Urukundo rwiwe rwamaho ibihe bidashira.
Agakura Isirayeli muri bo, Urukundo rwiwe rwamaho ibihe bidashira.
Abakujeyo ukuboko kw’inkomezi kuramvuye, Urukundo rwiwe rwamaho ibihe bidashira.
Yagabuyemwo kabiri Ikiyaga Gitukura, Urukundo rwiwe rwamaho ibihe bidashira.
Agacisha Isirayeli hagati muri co, Urukundo rwiwe rwamaho ibihe bidashira.
Ariko agatsinda Farawo n’ingabo ziwe mu Kiyaga Gitukura, Urukundo rwiwe rwamaho ibihe bidashira.
Ni we yarongoye abantu biwe mu bugaragwa, Urukundo rwiwe rwamaho ibihe bidashira.
Ni we yatsinze hasi abami bahambaye, Urukundo rwiwe rwamaho ibihe bidashira.
Akica abami bakomeye, Urukundo rwiwe rwamaho ibihe bidashira.
Sihoni umwami w’Abamori, Urukundo rwiwe rwamaho ibihe bidashira.
Na Ogi umwami w’i Bashani, Urukundo rwiwe rwamaho ibihe bidashira.
Agatanga igihugu cabo ngo kibe iragi, Urukundo rwiwe rwamaho ibihe bidashira.
Iragi ry’umusavyi wiwe Isirayeli, Urukundo rwiwe rwamaho ibihe bidashira.
Yaratwibutse igihe twari dusuzuguritse, Urukundo rwiwe rwamaho ibihe bidashira.
Adukiza abansi bacu, Urukundo rwiwe rwamaho ibihe bidashira.
Agaburira ivyaremwe vyose, Urukundo rwiwe rwamaho ibihe bidashira.
Nimushime Imana yo mw’ijuru. Urukundo rwiwe rwamaho ibihe bidashira.
Ku nzuzi z’i Babiloni ni ho twicara tukarira twibutse Siyoni.
Ku biti vy’imilebeni vyaho ni ho twamanika inanga zacu,
kuko aho ni ho abatujanye nk’inyagano badusabira kubaririmbira, abatugaraguza agati badusaba indirimbo z’umunezero; bavuga bati: “Nimuturirimbire imwe mu ndirimbo z’i Siyoni!”
Twoshobora gute kuririmba indirimbo z’ Uhoraho turi mu gihugu c’ikinyamahanga?
Yerusalemu, ninakwibagira, ukuryo kwanje kwibagire gucuraranga.
Ururimi rwanje rufatane n’amagage nintakwibuka, nintiyumvira kuri Yerusalemu ibihimbaro vyanje.
Uhoraho , niwibuke ivyo Abanyedomu bakoze ku musi Yerusalemu hasambuka. Basemerera ngo: “Hasambure, samburira hasi amatanguriro yaho!”
Mukobwa w’i Babiloni, uzosamburwa, hahiriwe uwukwishura ibihwanye n’ivyo wadukoreye.
Hahiriwe uwufata inzoya zawe akazihonda ku bitandara.
Uhoraho , nzoguhimbaza n’umutima wanje wose; imbere “y’ibigirwamana” nzokuririmbira ishimwe.
Nzokwunama ntumbereye Ingoro yawe yera, maze mpimbaze izina ryawe kubera urukundo rwawe rudashira n’ukwizigirwa kwawe, kuko washize hejuru izina ryawe n’ijambo ryawe ubirutisha ibindi bintu vyose.
Igihe nahamagara, waranyishuye; maze urandemesha mu kunyongera inkomezi.
Abami bose bo kw’isi nibaguhimbaze, Uhoraho , nibumva ivyo washinze.
Baze baririmbe ivy’inzira z’ Uhoraho , kuko icubahiro c’ Uhoraho gihambaye.
Naho Uhoraho ashizwe hejuru, ararabana ubugwaneza abaciye bugufi; naho ari uwuhambaye, ababonera kure.
Naho ngendera hagati y’amarushwa, uzigama ubugingo bwanje; uramvurira ukuboko kwawe kugwanya abangwanya; unkirisha ukuboko kwawe kw’i buryo.
Uhoraho azoshitsa ivyo yasezeranye ku bugingo bwanje; urukundo rwawe, Uhoraho , rwamaho ibihe vyose; ntuhebe ibikorwa vy’intoke zawe.

headings.text: Ni iya Dawidi.

verses.text: Uhoraho we, waransuzumye, ugirako uramenya.
Urazi iyicara ryanje n’iva hasi ryanje; umenyera kure ivyo niyumvira.
Umenya iyo ngendagenda n’iyo ndyamye; umenyereye inzira zanje zose.
Ijambo ritarashika ku rurimi rwanje wewe, Uhoraho , uba warimenye ido n’ido.
Unkikuje imbere n’inyuma, kandi unshizeko ikiganza cawe.
Ukumenya bene uko ni igitangaza kuri jewe, gushika kure aho ntoshika.
Mbega Mpwemu wawe nomuhungira hehe? Noja he ngo mpunge mu nyonga hawe?
Noja mw’ijuru, ni ho uri; nokwubaka uburiri bwanje i bwina, ni yo uri.
Nova hasi nkaja ku mababa y’umutwenzi, noja kuba hirya kure hakurya y’ikiyaga,
naho nyene ikiganza cawe cohandongorera, ukuboko kwawe kw’i buryo kwoncakira.
Novuga nti: “Ni ukuri umwijima ugiye kumpisha n’umuco uhinduke ijoro ahankikuje,”
n’umwijima na wo nyene ntiwoba umwijima kuri wewe; ijoro rizokayangana nk’umurango, umwijima na wo ni nk’umuco kuri wewe.
Kuko ari wewe waremye ibimbamwo vyose; wanteranirije mu nda ya mama;
Ndaguhimbaza kuko naremwe mu buryo buteye ubwoba kandi butangaje; ivyo ukora biratangaje, ivyo ndabizi neza.
Igikankara canje nticari gihishijwe inyonga zawe igihe naremerwa mw’ibanga, igihe nateranirizwa i bwina mw’isi.
Amaso yawe yarabona umubiri wanje ukiri amazi; imisi wanshingiye yari yanditswe mu gitabu cawe imbere yuko habaho n’umwe.
Ese ukungene ivyiyumviro vyawe ari ivy’igiciro, ewe Mana! Ese ukungene ari vyinshi!
Nobiharura, vyoruta umusenyi; iyo nikanguye, nsanga nkiri kumwe na we.
Ese icompa akaba ari wewe wenyene, ewe Mana, wica abanyakibi! Mva i ruhande mwa binywamaraso mwe!
Bakuvugako ibibi; abansi bawe bakoresha nabi izina ryawe.
Mbega sinanka abakwanka, ga yewe Uhoraho , kandi sinkengera abakugarariza?
Nta kindi mfise atari urwanko ndabanka; ndababona nk’abansi banje.
Nsesa, ewe Mana, umenye umutima wanje; ungeze umenye ivyiyumviro vyanje.
Raba ko hoba hari inzira y’icaha iri muri jewe, kugira ngo undongorere mu nzira y’ibihe bidashira.

headings.text: Yahawe umukuru w’abaririmvyi. Ni iya Dawidi. Ni Zaburi.

verses.text: Ntabara, Uhoraho , unkize inkozi z’ibibi; undinde abanyamuryano,
bagira imigambi mibi mu mitima yabo bakavyura intambara imisi yose.
Indimi zabo bazisongora nk’iz’inzoka; ubumara bw’inzoka buri mu kanwa kabo.
Uhoraho , undinde amaboko y’abanyakibi; undinde abanyamuryano, bagira imigabo yo kuntsinda hasi.
Abibone banteze umutego wo mu mpisho; bamaze gutega insenga zabo no gushinga imitego yabo mu nzira ncamwo.
Ndabwira Uhoraho nti: “Uri Imana yanje.” Uhoraho , niwumve ugutakamba kwanje.
Uhoraho Nyeninganji, mutabazi wanje w’inkomezi, wambika inkinzo umutwe wanje ku musi w’intambara.
Uhoraho , ntuhe abanyakibi ivyo bipfuza; ntureke ngo imigambi yabo ishirwe mu ngiro.
Abankikuje bazunguza imitwe yabo mu bwibone; amajambo mabi y’akanwa kabo abasubire ku mitwe.
Amakara yaka asukwe ku mitwe yabo; nibatererwe mu muriro, batererwe mu vyobo vy’amazi, ntibigere bavayo.
Abavuga abandi nabi ntibagume mu gihugu; ivyago nibihige abantu b’umuryano.
Ndazi ko Uhoraho aburanira abakene agakiranira aboro.
Ni ukuri abagororotsi bazohimbaza izina ryawe, kandi abatunganye bazoba mu nyonga zawe.

headings.text: Yahawe umukuru w’abaririmvyi. Ni aburi ya Dawidi.

verses.text: Uhoraho , ndagutakambiye, tebuka uze aho ndi; unyumve ninagutakambira.
Ugusenga kwanje nigushike imbere yawe nk’umubavu; ugutarika amaboko kwanje kube nk’ikimazi co ku mugoroba.
Ushire umurinzi ku munwa wanje, Uhoraho ; ugume uteramye ku rugi rw’iminwa yanje.
Ntureke umutima wanje ngo uje mu bibi ngo nifatanye n’inkozi z’ibibi mu bikorwa bibi; ntundeke ngo nsangire na bo ivyo bakunda kurya.

Reka umugororotsi aze ankubite; kuko azoba ariko arangirira neza; aze ampane; kuzoba ari ukunsiga amavuta ku mutwe. Umutwe wanje ntuzovyanka, kuko isengesho ryanje rizokwama rigwanya ibikorwa vy’inkozi z’ibibi.
Abaganza babo nibatembagarizwe ku bitandara, maze abanyakibi ni ho bazomenya ko amajambo yanje yari ay’ukuri.
Bazovuga bati: “nk’uko umuntu arima agashitsa isuka, ni ko amagufa yacu yasanzariye ku munwa w’imva.”
Ariko amaso yanje ndayahanze wewe, Uhoraho Nyeninganji; muri wewe ni ho mpungiye; ntundeke ngo mpfe.
Undinde kugwa mu mitego yatezwe n’inkozi z’ibibi, mu mitego bateze imbere yanje.
Abanyakibi nibagwe mu mitego bateze ubwabo, nanje ndengane mu mahoro.

headings.text: Ni Zaburi ya Dawidi.

verses.text: Ndatakambira Uhoraho n’ijwi rirenga; nzoshira ijwi hejuru ntakambira Uhoraho .
Ndasuka amajojwa yanje imbere yiwe; ndavuga ivyago vyanje imbere yiwe.
Iyo impwemu yanje icikiye intege muri jewe, ni wewe urinda inzira yanje. Mu nzira ngenderamwo abantu banteze umutego.
Birabe ubibone, nta n’umwe ari i buryo bwanje; nta n’umwe anyitayeho. Singira ubuhungiro; nta n’umwe yitayeho ubugingo bwanje.
Ndagutakambiye, Uhoraho ; ndavuga nti: “Uri ubuhungiro bwanje, umugabane wanje mw’isi y’abazima.”
Niwumve ugutakamba kwanje, kuko ngowe cane; ntabara unkize abampiga, kuko bandusha inkomezi.
Umbohore unkure mw’ibohero ndimwo, kugira ngo mpimbaze izina ryawe. Maze abagororotsi bazokoranira aho ndi, kuko unyeretse ukugira neza kwawe.

headings.text: Ni masikili ya Dawidi. Aho yari mu kinogo. Ni isengesho.

verses.text: Uhoraho , niwumve ugusenga kwanje, wumvirize ugutakamba kwanje; mu bwizigirwa bwawe no mu kugororoka kwawe nuze untabare.
Ntujane umushumba wawe imbere y’intahe, kuko ata n’umwe mu bakiri bazima agororotse imbere yawe.
Umwansi arampiga, antsinze hasi; atumye mba ahantu h’umwijima nk’abapfuye kera.
Ni co gitumye impwemu yanje impondobereramwo; umutima wanje ukaba wiheburiye muri jewe.
Ndibuka imisi ya kera; ndimbura ibikorwa vyawe vyose nkiyumvira ku vyakozwe n’intoke zawe.
Ndakugaranzurira amaboko; ndakunyotewe nk’uko isi igadutse inyotererwa amazi.
Uhoraho unyishure vuba; umushaha wanje ucitse intege. Ntumpishe mu nyonga hawe kuko noca mba nk’abamanuka baja muri rwa rwobo.
Igitondo nikinzanire ijambo ry’urukundo rwawe rudashira, kuko nakwizigiye. Nyereka inzira nkwiye kujana, kuko ubugingo bwanje ari wewe nabujeje.
Ntabara unkize abansi banje, Uhoraho , kuko muri wewe ari ho ninyegeje.
Nyigisha gukora ivyo ugomba, kuko uri Imana yanje; icompa Mpwemu wawe mwiza akandongorera ahantu hagororotse.
Ku bw’izina ryawe, Uhoraho , kingira ubugingo bwanje; mu kugororoka kwawe, nkura mu vyago.
Mu rukundo rwawe rudashira, ziba akanwa k’abansi banje; honya abangwanya, kuko ndi umusavyi wawe.

headings.text: Ni Zaburi ya Dawidi.

verses.text: Uhoraho igitandara canje ahimbazwe, yigisha amaboko yanje kugwana, n’intoke zanje kuja mu ntambara.
Ni Imana yanje y’urukundo n’igihome kinkingira, umunara nihishamwo n’umurokozi wanje, inkinzo yanje, uwo mpungirako, acisha bugufi amoko musi y’ibirenge vyanje.
Uhoraho , abantu ni iki aho ubitwararika, canke abana b’abantu aho ubiyumvirako?
Bameze nk’impwemu zihumetswe; imisi yabo ni nk’igitutu kirengana gusa.
Uhoraho , ugurura ijuru ryawe, umanuke kw’isi; kora ku misozi, kugira ngo ipfunduke umwotsi.
Rungika umuravyo usanzaze umwansi; rasa imyampi yawe ubasanzaze.
Ramvura ukuboko kwawe uri iyo mw’ijuru; untabare undokore unkize amazi asuriranya, unkure mu kuboko kw’abanyamahanga;
akanwa kabo kuzuye ibinyoma, amaboko yabo y’i buryo arimwo ivy’ubugunge.
Mana yanje, nzokuririmbira indirimbo nsha, nzogucurarangira inanga y’imirya cumi,
wewe uha abami intsinzi, ugakiza umusavyi wawe Dawidi inkota yica.
Ndokora untabare; unkure mu maboko y’abanyamahanga akanwa kabo kuzuye ibinyoma, amaboko yabo y’i buryo ni ingunge.
Maze abahungu bacu, mu buto bwabo, bazomera nk’imivyaro yatabiwe neza, abakobwa bacu na bo bazoba nk’inkingi zabarijwe gushariza ikirimba.
Ibigega vyacu bizokwuzura ivyimburwa vy’ubwoko bwose. Intama zacu zizogwira incuro ibihumbi, incuro ibihumbi cumi ziri ku misozi yacu;
inka zacu zizokwega imitwaro iremereye. Nta birengero bizoba mu mpome zacu, nta bazojanwa nk’inyagano, nta bazoniha bari mu mayira yacu.
Hahiriwe ihanga ibi bizoshikako; hahiriwe ihanga rifise Uhoraho nk’Imana yaryo.

headings.text: Ni iya Dawidi.

verses.text: Nzogushira hejuru, Mana yanje, wewe Mwami; nzohimbaza izina ryawe ibihe bidashira.
Imisi yose nzoguhimbaza nshire hejuru izina ryawe ibihe n’ibihe.
Uhoraho arahambaye kandi abereye gushimwa; nta n’umwe yomenya ubukuru bwiwe.
Urunganwe rubwira urundi ivyiza wakoze; bavuga ivy’inkomezi wakoze.
Bavuga ugukayangana kw’ubwiza bw’icubahiro cawe; nanje nzorimbura ibikorwa vyawe bitangaje wakoze.
Bavuga ivy’ubushobozi bw’ibihambaye wakoze; nanje nzokwamamaza ibikorwa vyawe bihambaye.
Bazohimbaza ukugira neza kwawe kwinshi, baririmbane umunezero ivy’ukugororoka kwawe.
Uhoraho agira impuhwe n’ubuntu, ateba kuraka akagira urukundo rwinshi.
Uhoraho agirira bose neza; agirira imbabazi ivyo yaremye vyose.
Uhoraho , ibikorwa vyawe vyose biraguhimbaza; abizigirwa bawe bagushira hejuru.
Bavuga icubahiro c’ubwami bwawe kandi bavuga ivy’inkomezi wakoze,
kugira ngo abantu bose bamenye ibikorwa vyawe bihambaye n’ugukayangana kw’ubwiza bw’ubwami bwawe.
Ubwami bwawe ntibuzogira iherezo, n’ukuganza kwawe guhoraho uko urunganwe ruzokuranwa n’urundi. Uhoraho ni uwo kwizigirwa mu vyo asezerana vyose kandi ni umwizigirwa mu vyo akora vyose.
Uhoraho ashigikira abaguye, akavyura abacishijwe bugufi.
Bose baguhanga amaso, nawe ukabahaza ivyokurya mu gihe gikwiye.
Upfundurura ikiganza cawe ugahaza ukwipfuza kw’ibiri n’ubuzima vyose.
Uhoraho aragororotse mu nzira ziwe zose kandi ni umwizigirwa mu vyo akora vyose.
Uhoraho aba hafi y’abamwambaza bose, abamwambaza mu kuri bose.
Ashitsa ivyo abamwubaha bipfuza; yumva ugutakamba kwabo maze akabakiza.
Uhoraho azigama abamukunda bose, ariko abanyakibi azobahonya.
Akanwa kanje kazovuga ivyo guhimbaza Uhoraho . Ivyaremwe vyose nibihimbaze izina ryiwe ryera ibihe bitazoshira.

headings.text: Ni Zaburi yo gushima. Ni iya Dawidi.

verses.text: Haleluya. Mutima wanje, himbaza Uhoraho .
Nzohimbaza Uhoraho ubuzima bwanje bwose; nzoririmba izo guhimbaza Imana yanje nkiriho.
Ntimukishimire abahambaye, canke abana b’abantu, badashobora gukiza.
Iyo impwemu yabo ibavuyemwo, basubira mw’ivu, kuri uwo musi nyene imigambi yabo igahinduka ubusa.
Hahiriwe abahungira ku Mana ya Yakobo, ivyizigiro vyabo bikaba k’ Uhoraho Imana yabo.
Ni we yaremye ijuru n’isi, ikiyaga n’ibiri muri vyo vyose; aguma ari umwizigirwa ibihe bidashira.
Ni we aburanira abacinyizwa akagaburira abashonje. Uhoraho ni we abohora imbohe,
Uhoraho ni we ahumura impumyi, Uhoraho ni we ashira hejuru abaciye bugufi, Uhoraho ni we akunda abagororotsi.
Uhoraho azigama inyambukira agashigikira impfuvyi n’umupfakazi, ariko inzira z’abanyakibi arazigoramika.
Uhoraho aganje ibihe bidashira, Imana yawe, ewe Siyoni, iraganje uko urunganwe ruzokurikirana n’urundi. Haleluya.
Haleluya. Ese ukuntu ari vyiza guhimbaza Imana yacu, ese ukuntu bihimbaye kandi bibereye kuyihimbaza!
Uhoraho yubaka Yerusalemu; yegeranya aba Isirayeli bari barashwiragiye.
Akiza abafise imitima imenetse agapfuka inguma zabo.
Aharura igitigiri c’inyenyeri agahamagara imwimwe yose mw’izina.
Umwami wacu arahambaye kandi ni umuhizi mu nkomezi: ugutahura kwiwe ntikugira akarimbi.
Uhoraho ashigikira abaciye bugufi agacisha bugufi abanyakibi akabashitsa hasi.
Nimuririmbire Uhoraho indirimbo yo gushima; nimucurarangire inanga Imana yacu.
Apfukisha ijuru ibicu; agaha isi imvura akameza ivyatsi ku turambi.
Ategurira amasho ivyokurya n’ivyana vy’ibikona iyo bijwiragiye.
Ntahimbarwa n’inkomezi z’ifarasi, canke ngo yishimire amaguru y’umuhizi;
Uhoraho ahimbarwa n’abamwubaha, abishimira urukundo rwiwe rudashira.
Nushime Uhoraho , ewe Yerusalemu; uhimbaze Imana yawe, ewe Siyoni.
Ni we akomeza imyugariro yawe agaha umugisha abantu baba muri wewe.
Atanga impore ku mbibe zawe, akaguhaza ingano nziza cane.
Atuma amabwirizwa yiwe kw’isi, ijambo ryiwe rikagenda rinyaruka.
Akwiragiza shelegi nk’ubwoya bw’intama, ugukanya akagusanzaza nk’umunyota.
Arekura urubura rwiwe nk’amabuye. Ni nde yoshobora kurinda imbeho yiwe?
Atuma ijambo ryiwe ngo riyashongeshe; atuma umuyaga wiwe, amazi agashonga.
Yahishuriye Yakobo ijambo ryiwe, ivyagezwe vyiwe n’amategeko yiwe yabihishuriye Isirayeli.
Nta rindi hanga na rimwe yakoreye nk’ivyo; ntibazi ivyagezwe vyiwe. Haleluya.
Haleluya. Nimuhimbarize Uhoraho iyo mw’ijuru; mumuhimbarize ahasumba amajuru.
Mumuhimbaze, yemwe bamarayika biwe; mumuhimbaze, namwe nyenyeri zo kw’ijuru.
Nimumuhimbaze, zuba n’ukwezi; mumuhimbaze yemwe nyenyeri zaka mwese.
Nimumuhimbaze, yemwe majuru asumba ayandi namwe mazi yo hejuru.
Abo nibahimbaze izina ry’ Uhoraho , kuko yategetse bikabaho,
kandi yabishingiye aho kuba ibihe bidashira; yashinze itegeko ritazokwigera rivaho.
Nimuhimbaze Uhoraho mw’isi, yemwe vyaremwe bininibinini vyo mu kiyaga namwe madamba y’ibiyaga,
miravyo, rubura, shelegi namwe bicu, mwa bihuhusi mwumvira itegeko ryiwe,
yemwe misozi n’uturambi twose, biti vyama n’amasederi yose,
bikoko vyo mw’ishamba n’amasho yose, ivyaremwe bitobito n’inyoni zo mu kirere,
bami bo kw’isi n’amahanga yose, yemwe baganwa n’abatware bose bo kw’isi,
yemwe basore n’inkumi, batama namwe bana.
Abo nibahimbaze izina ry’ Uhoraho , kuko izina ryiwe ryo nyene ari ryo rishizwe hejuru; icubahiro ciwe kiri hejuru y’isi n’ijuru.
Kandi yahagurukirije ihembe abantu biwe, ishimwe ry’abasavyi biwe bose bizigirwa, rya Isirayeli, ihanga riri ku mutima wiwe. Haleluya.
Haleluya. Nimuririmbire Uhoraho indirimbo nsha, mumuririmbire ishimwe mw’ikoraniro ry’abera biwe.
Isirayeli nibanezerererwe Umuremyi wabo; ab’i Siyoni nibanezerererwe Umwami wabo.
Nibahimbaze izina ryiwe batamba bamuvugirize umurya w’inanga n’umurisho w’ingoma.
Kuko Uhoraho ahimbarirwa abantu biwe; yambika abaciye bugufi ukunesha nk’igitsibo.
Abera biwe nibanezererwe icubahiro ciwe bamuvugirize impundu bari ku mariri yabo.
Uguhimbaza Imana kube mu kanwa kabo bafise inkota y’ubugi bubiri mu ntoke,
kugira ngo bihore amahanga bahane amoko,
bongere baboheshe iminyororo abami bayo, abaganwa bayo bababoheshe imigozi y’ivyuma,
maze bashitse urubanza bandikiwe ko bazohanwa; ico ni co cubahiro c’abera biwe. Haleluya.
Haleluya. Nimuhimbarize Imana ahera hayo; muyihimbarize no mu majuru yayo yuzuye inkomezi.
Nimuyihimbarize ivy’inkomezi yakoze; muyimbarize ubukuru bwayo buhambaye.
Nimuyihimbarishe ijwi rirengera ry’inzamba, muyishimishe inanga n’ikembe,
muyihimbarishe umurisho w’ingoma n’imvyino, muyihimbarishe imirya y’inanga n’umwironge,
muyihimbaze muvuza ivyuma bisamirana. Muyihimbarishe ijwi rirengera ry’ivyuma bisamirana.
Ibihumeka vyose nibihimbaze Uhoraho . Haleluya.
